title: Fullstack Engineer
description:

title: Data Analyst, Clinical Data Effectiveness
description:

As we grow our data ecosystem, expanding across legacy interoperability networks, QHIN/TEFCA connectivity, and direct HIE integrations, we need rigorous analytical ownership to ensure the clinical data powering our platform is complete, reliable, and actionable.

You will serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for clinical data completeness and effectiveness at Counterpart Health. Sitting within the Data Products pillar, this role owns the end-to-end understanding of our clinical data lifecycle: where data comes from, where it breaks down, and how each vendor or integration pathway performs across our customer markets. Your analysis will directly shape vendor strategy, facility targeting, and data pipeline investments, thus ensuring that the clinical evidence our care teams depend on is consistently available and trustworthy.

As a Data Analyst, you will:

  • Proactively identify and monitor which healthcare facilities consistently generate high-quality, usable clinical documents (e.g., EHRs, discharge summaries, procedure notes) to precisely locate and quantify data gaps.
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses by mapping and correlating facility-specific data across disparate sources like structured claims, clinical care summaries (CCDAs), and ADT messages to uncover systematic patterns of missingness, latency,
  • Experience with TEFCA/QHIN frameworks and evolving national interoperability standards.
  • Familiarity with vendor-specific data exchange platforms (e.g., Bamboo Health, HSX, Particle Health, Kno2).
  • Background in value-based care, population health, or clinical data operations.
  • Experience with claims-clinical data reconciliation (e.g., matching EOBs to clinical encounter records).
  • Comfort working with Python or similar tools for data manipulation and automation.
  • or incongruence in clinical records.
  • Establish and maintain clear, transparent reporting on ADT coverage across key geographic, organizational, and technological dimensions (e.g., by county, facility, and underlying EMR system).
  • Based on rigorous analysis of data flow and quality, recommend and guide the implementation of optimal technical configurations for existing data vendors (e.g., Bamboo Health, PCC, Experian, HSX).
  • Conduct comprehensive evaluations and proof-of-concepts for potential new data integration technologies (e.g., Kno2 vs. Particle Health) to assess viability, quality improvements, and strategic fit.

Container, virtualisation and cloud infrastructure have become essentials of modern software deployments. We invest in open source related to application isolation, workload orchestration, system or OCI containers, micro service architecture or cloud infrastructure.

Here are some examples of projects under way at Canonical.

RustVMM has great potential as a new hypervisor for Linux. We are building a team to work on this, with an emphasis on performance, security and operability. Work in Rust and bring your expert knowledge of VMM and related kernel networking and storage capabilities.

Canonical is in a good position to publish a portfolio of outstanding Docker images. Our Rockcraft team is designing and implementing an elevated Docker image experience for the open source community.

LXD is a modern system container and virtual machine manager that is widely used on Ubuntu, ChromeOS and other Linux platforms. LXD engineering spans the entire software stack from low-level kernel work on namespaces, confinement, security, filesystems, VMMs and networking, to the high level management REST API and CLI.

Members of the Kubernetes product team build MicroK8s for on-rails K8s, and Charmed Kubernetes for more sophisticated integration. We work on K8s itself and on the operations tooling around it.

The OpenStack team deliver Charmed OpenStack, OVN / OVS and Ceph. This work brings cloud platform technologies to large-scale computing environments.

Du willst Systemadministrator Linux nicht einfach administrieren, sondern selbst entscheiden, wie eine moderne Open Source IT Landschaft aussehen soll?🚀

Dann bekommst du hier den Freiraum dafür. Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes, familiengeführtes Technologieunternehmen aus Freiburg, das Hard- und Softwarelösungen für die industrielle Bildverarbeitung und Automation entwickelt. Die eigenen Systeme kommen heute in mehr als 15.000 Maschinen weltweit zum Einsatz.

Als Systemadministrator Linux verstärkst du einen bewusst klein gehaltenen IT Bereich und bekommst entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Statt starrer Konzernstrukturen erwarten dich kurze Wege, direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung und die Möglichkeit, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten. 

Der technologische Fokus liegt konsequent auf Linux und Open Source. In den kommenden Jahren stehen spannende Themen an: bestehende Anwendungen sollen auf Open Source Alternativen migriert, Cyber Security und Resilience weiter ausgebaut und ein eigener interner Linux basierter KI Server kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden. 

Wenn Linux dein fachliches Zuhause ist und du lieber neue Lösungen entwickelst, als nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen zu halten, kannst du hier eine IT Landschaft langfristig mitprägen. 

Deine Benefits

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Entscheide aktiv mit, wie sich die interne IT in den Bereichen Linux, Open Source, Cyber Security, Resilience und Automatisierung

Toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä asiakkaiden, tuotannon sekä muiden liiketoiminnan avainhenkilöiden kanssa varmistaen asiakkaiden tarpeita vastaavat ratkaisut ja pitkäjänteisen yhteistyön.        Päästäksesi tavoitteisiisi sinun tulee:      Vahvistaa asiakkuuksien kokonaisvaltaista kehittämistä ja asiakassuhteita     Kehittää myynnin ja tarjoustoiminnan yhteistyötä sekä tarjouslaskentaa sovittujen parametrien mukaisesti     Tunnistaa asiakkaiden liiketoimintatarpeita ja rakentaa ratkaisuja yhteistyössä sisäisten asiantuntijoiden kanssa     Vastata sopimusneuvotteluista sekä kaupallisten ehtojen valmistelusta ja läpiviennistä     Seurata asiakkuuksien kannattavuutta, kasvua ja asiakastyytyväisyyttä sekä käynnistää kehitystoimenpiteitä     Analysoida myyntidataa, markkinatrendejä ja kilpailutilanteita sekä laatia toimenpide-ehdotuksia     Laatia asiakkuuskohtaisia suunnitelmia sekä koordinoida ja raportoida niiden toteutusta     Tukea uusasiakashankintaa sekä edistää oman vastuualueesi myynnillistä kasvua          Odotamme sinulta      Toivomme, että sinulla on vahva kaupallinen ote, kyky rakentaa pitkäjänteisiä asiakassuhteita sekä ymmärrystä logistiikkaliiketoiminnasta. Olet oma-aloitteinen, tuloshakuinen ja osaat hyödyntää dataa päätöksenteon tukena.        Edellytämme:      Soveltuvaa kaupallisen tai logistiikka-alan koulutusta tai vähintään viiden vuoden kokemusta vastaavista myynti- tai asiakkuudenhallinnan tehtävistä     Kokemusta asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä, myynnistä tai asiakkuusjohtamisesta     Hyviä neuvottelu-, vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja     Ymmärrystä kuljetusratkaisuista, logistiikkapalveluista ja niiden kustannusrakenteista     Kykyä analysoida liiketoimintaa, tunnistaa asiakaspotentiaalia ja tehdä johtopäätöksiä datan pohjalta     Hyviä organisointi- ja koordinointitaitoja sekä kykyä hallita useita kokonaisuuksia samanaikaisesti     Oma-aloitteisuutta ja kykyä viedä asioita itsenäisesti eteenpäin     Sujuvia järjestelmä- ja raportointityökaluvalmiuksia     Englannin kielen sujuvan suullisen ja kirjallisen taidon     Vahvan Excel-osaamisen sekä ERP- ja CRM-järjestelmien tuntemuksen          Tarjoamme sinulle:        Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa myynnin kasvuun ja asiakaskokemukseen sekä keskeisen roolin yrityksemme tärkeimpien asiakkuuksien kehittämisessä     Monipuolisen tehtävänkuvan, jossa yhdistyvät myynti, analytiikka ja asiakkuusjohtaminen     Mahdollisuuden kehi

title: E-commerce Customer Experience Manager
description: Hey there!     We’re looking for a proactive  E-commerce Customer Experience Manager  to join Sereni Parenting.  You’ll manage our customer support team, monitor performance, investigate recurring customer issues, and improve the systems behind customer service.     During your first 2 weeks, you’ll work closely with the founder to review the current customer support operation, investigate issues, improve processes, and build the systems you’ll eventually take ownership of.      Who We Are   Sereni Parenting is a growing e-commerce brand creating products that support children and families.  Our mission is to make everyday life easier for families raising children with autism, ADHD, and sensory needs. We want to build a brand parents genuinely trust and a customer experience that makes them feel supported, understood, and cared for.      Key Responsibilities    Manage and support our existing customer service team.  Monitor response times, resolution times, refunds, complaints, reviews, and other key support metrics.  Investigate recurring customer issues and find the root cause.  Improve SOPs, canned responses, escalation rules, and support processes.  Review tickets and make sure customers are receiving accurate and helpful responses.  Handle difficult customer escalations.  Identify issues like shipping delays, stock problems, or fulfilment issues before they create more complaints.  Report key customer service problems to the founders and recommend what should be fixed.  Help improve refunds, returns, and complaint handling.  Use AI and automation to improve reporting, monitoring, and repetitive support tasks.  Work with fulfilment partners and internal team members when customer problems are caused by operational issues.       Required Experience    2+ years in customer service, customer experience, or e-commerce support.  Expeirence with customer service metrics and reports.  Experience creating or improving SOPs, canned responses, and support processes.  Experience managing or supervising a customer support team.  Experience working in e-commerce.  Experience with  Shopify .  Experience with  Commslayer, Gorgias, Zendesk, or a similar customer support platform .  Experience handling refunds, returns, order tracking, and customer escalations.  Experience using  AI tools .       Role Details    Full-time  Remote  Monday–Friday  Long-term position  Open to candidates in Malaysia or the Philippines  Salary based on experience       Why You’ll Love Working With Us     Fully Remote & Flexible:  Work from home with flexible hours.   Dynamic Environment:  Work with a fast-moving team that values innovation and improvement.   Career Growth:  Take on more responsibility and grow into more senior roles over time.   Real Impact:  Your work will directly influence the customer experience and growth of the company.   Competitive Compensation:  Salary based on experience and capability.

title: Consumer Engagement Manager
description: Summary   We are looking for a  Consumer Engagement Manager  to lead initiatives that strengthen the relationship between the brand and its consumers across the customer journey.  This role sits at the intersection of  CRM, digital marketing, customer experience and community engagement . Rather than relying heavily on traditional paid advertising, the focus is on building meaningful consumer touchpoints through  organic digital channels, customer data, content, events, referrals and lifecycle engagement .  You will be responsible for understanding consumer behaviour, identifying engagement opportunities and creating initiatives that move consumers from awareness and consideration through to purchase, ownership and advocacy.      Key Responsibilities    Develop and execute  consumer engagement and CRM strategies  across the customer journey.  Drive organic engagement through social media, digital platforms, content and community initiatives.  Analyse consumer behaviour and identify opportunities to improve  engagement, conversion and retention .  Develop customer lifecycle, referral and advocacy programmes.  Work closely with Sales, Retail and Customer Experience teams to improve consumer touchpoints.  Monitor engagement and customer data to identify trends and drive improvements.  Support consumer events, experiences and community-building initiatives.       Requirements    Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or related field.   4–7 years of experience  in CRM, consumer marketing, digital marketing, customer experience or related areas.  Strong understanding of  customer journey, consumer behaviour and organic digital marketing .  Experience working with customer data/CRM systems and developing engagement initiatives.  Strong communication, analytical and project management skills.  Proactive, creative and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.    Ideal background:  CRM, Lifecycle Marketing, Consumer Marketing, Digital Marketing, Customer Experience, Community or Brand Engagement.     For Faster Response, Kindly  email to alfred.lim@jobscoper.com.my  or  Whatsapp 018 403 2862

title: Manager, Consumer Moments /Membership Korea

title: Product Led Growth Manager
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Led Growth Manager based in Austria.   This is a high-impact growth product role focused on building and optimizing self-serve acquisition journeys for technical audiences.  You’ll own the customer funnel from signup and trial through activation, conversion, expansion, and product-led sales handoffs.  You’ll also serve as product owner for the website and application experience, shaping priorities and working closely with engineering and design. Optimize product-led growth journeys originating in developer ecosystems, open source, documentation, SDKs, code examples, and emerging AI-agent ecosystems. Requirements     5–8+ years of experience in growth, growth product management, lifecycle marketing, or funnel-focused product roles. title: Sales Support and Capability Manager
description: About The Role   Open Country Dairy is looking for an experienced Sales Support and Capability Manager to lead the Sales Support function and help strengthen the systems, processes and capability that support accurate, on-time order delivery in a fast-paced export environment.  This role combines hands-on team leadership, operational governance and continuous improvement, with responsibility for establishing a structured pathway to develop future talent across Sales Operations.   What You’ll Be Doing     Lead, coach and develop the Sales Support team while managing workload, priorities, service levels and escalations to deliver accurate, customer-focused outcomes.  Oversee sales order governance from quote to sales ready, ensuring customer requirements, documentation, shipping instructions, system accuracy and compliance obligations are met.  Identify and implement process, reporting and system improvements that improve productivity, visibility, risk management and service quality.  Develop and implement a structured succession programme framework, including intake, rotations, learning objectives, mentoring, competency milestones and progress reporting.     About You   You will be a confident people leader with strong operational discipline, sound commercial judgement and a practical, solutions-focused approach. You will be comfortable working across teams, managing complexity and maintaining high standards in a busy export environment.  You will ideally have:    Experience in sales support, export documentation, customer service or a related operational environment, with a strong understanding of export sales processes, documentation requirements and compliance controls.  Proven people leadership capability, including coaching, developing and coordinating team performance in a busy operational setting. title: Delivery Manager SI Industriel H/F

Vous intervenez au sein d'environnements complexes, fortement réglementés, sur des projets stratégiques liés au  Chantier Numérique , à la digitalisation des processus métiers, à l'intégration des systèmes d'information industriels et au pilotage de solutions digitales à forte visibilité.  En lien avec les directions métiers, les équipes d'ingénierie, les architectes de solutions, les éditeurs et les partenaires, vous assurez le pilotage de projets de transformation depuis le cadrage jusqu'au déploiement opérationnel.   Vos principales missions     Piloter des projets stratégiques de transformation digitale dans des environnements industriels complexes.  Définir et piloter la feuille de route projet en garantissant les coûts, délais, qualité et risques.  Comprendre les besoins métiers et les traduire en solutions concrètes et partagées.  Construire et maintenir une planification réaliste des activités de réalisation.  Coordonner les différentes parties prenantes (métiers, ingénierie, DSI, architectes, éditeurs, intégrateurs et fournisseurs).  Assurer le pilotage transverse de plusieurs équipes intervenant sur un même programme.  Garantir la cohérence des interfaces entre les différents outils du SI industriel (PLM, solutions chantier, GED, outils métiers, plateformes data...).  Accompagner le déploiement de nouvelles solutions digitales et assurer leur adoption par les utilisateurs.  Identifier les risques, proposer les arbitrages nécessaires et sécuriser les décisions projet.  Contribuer à la gouvernance des projets et produire les indicateurs de pilotage destinés aux instances de décision. title: Technical Manager and Projects
description: Hvis du motiveres af at være den person, der kan samle teknik, projekter, salg og HQ – og hvis du trives med at have fingrene nede i teknikken samtidig med, at du holder det store overblik – så kan dette være den rigtige næste rolle for dig.      For vores klient Georg Fischer A/S søger vi en stærk og struktureret profil til en rolle som ”Technical Manager og Projects” ansvarlig.      Du får en helt central rolle på tværs af teknik, projekter og salg   Fra Georg Fischer A/S´ kontor i Roskilde bliver dit stærke overblik og din evne til at skabe struktur helt afgørende for din succes i rollen. Du skal sikre fremdrift i projekterne, involvere de rette personer på det rette tidspunkt og sørge for, at relevant information bliver omsat og koordineret mellem salg, teknik, kunde og HQ.     Det er en rolle for dig, der trives med mange bolde i luften, kan holde det store overblik og samtidig har teknisk forståelse nok til at gå ned i detaljen, når det er nødvendigt.     Du bliver en central person i organisationen og det naturlige tekniske og projektmæssige bindeled mellem virksomhedens eksterne og interne salg, kunder, rådgivere og HQ i Schweiz.     Du får det overordnede projektmæssige og tekniske overblik på tværs af Danmark – ansvaret bliver stort og omfatter bl.a.:   Teknisk sparring til salgsorganisationen  Projektkoordinering på tværs af Danmark  Kontakt og koordinering med HQ i Schweiz  Teknisk afklaring med kunder, rådgivere og samarbejdspartnere  Koordinering af større projekter fra idé til løsning  Sammen med salgschefen sikre fremdrift i projekter og opgaver       Din baggrund   Vi forestiller os, at du har en ingeniør- eller maskinmesterbaggrund – alternativt en anden relevant teknisk uddannelse eller erfaring, der giver dig en stærk forståelse for tekniske systemer, installationer og projekter.     Har du erfaring med kølesystemer til datacentre, er det en klar fordel.     Du skal have en solid forståelse for plastrørsystemer og de komponenter, der får et komplet system til at fungere, herunder at kunne forstå samspillet mellem:    Rørsystem → ventil → aktuator → styring → proces.       Du skal derfor have erfaring med – ventiler, aktuatorer og deres funktion i komplette systemløsninger.     En vigtig del af rollen bliver at kunne forstå og udføre relevante tekniske beregninger. Du skal kunne forstå tallene og bruge dem til at træffe de rigtige tekniske beslutninger.     På IT-siden SKAL du have erfaring med SAP og være stærk i Excel. Du taler og skriver engelsk ubesværet – kan du tysk er det en fordel men ikke et krav.      Dig som person   Vi forventer ikke, at du kan alt. Faktisk forventer vi, at du ikke kan alt. Til gengæld skal du have en stærk lyst til at lære.     Du skal være typen, der tænker:  “Det har jeg ikke arbejdet med før – men det skal jeg nok få styr på.”     Du skal kunne sætte dig ind i nye produkter, teknologier, beregningsmetoder og applikationer – og derefter omsætte din nye viden til noget, resten af organisatione

title: Implementation Manager Japan
description: Ready to take your career global?   Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Implementation Manager to join our Customer Experience team and help us unleash the potential of our business.   What You’ll Own     Possess expert level of knowledge on all relevant products and services.   This is a customer-facing role, you’ll be responsible for supporting our customers in integrating with Worldpay suite of payment services.  As a go-to expert, you’ll work directly with the customer and Account Management team to fully understand the business and deliver the solutions that are fit for purpose.  Support the customer and their relevant technical team to integrate to our suite of products, designing and setting up their accounts, providing technical guidance, as well as assistance in troubleshooting and resolving incidents.  You will be responsible for defining the finalized scope and managing the project right through completion and post live monitoring, following clear and well-maintained project plans. You will keep all relevant stakeholders updated with regular scheduled meetings to identify any risk early and ensure that the project is going to plan.  You’ll use your exceptional project management skills and experience to work on a high number of projects at any one time.  You’ll also plan and deliver customer demos and training on product functionality, to help maximize the value add to their businesses.  Build awareness of changing technical trends within the payment processing industry as well as wider technical trends such as security, web/browser technologies, mobile technologies etc.  Other related duties as assigned.    What you’ll bring    5 years and up experience and proven background in managing projects and delivering customer technical integrations.  Confidence and experience in managing relationships between internal and external stakeholders. Possess strong communication and interpersonal skills. Speak up in meetings and contribute positively.  Creative and forward thinking with a good aptitude for problem solving.  Be curious, ability to capture customer requirements and familiar with funneling techniques.  Technical expertise in XML, JSON API is preferred.  Experience with implementation involving Web and Mobile SDKs, React Native and JavaScripts  Knowledge of Database technologies: Oracle / SQL. Esposizione a progetti complessi e internazionali.  Elevata autonomia operativa e importanti prospettive di crescita manageriale.  Forte flessibilità organizzativa e smart working. title: Senior Stress & Thermomechanical FEA Engineer - Propulsion Battery System (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

As Senior Stress & Thermomechanical FEA Engineer – Propulsion Battery System (all genders) you will join VÆRIDION’s Technology division within the Mechanical Design & Integration team and lead the structural, stress, and thermomechanical finite element analysis (FEA) of the propulsion battery system for VÆRIDION’s CS-23 all-electric aircraft.

You will own the computational modelling of battery packs, power distribution units (PDUs), and their internal hardware, predicting how every component behaves under nominal and emergency conditions – including thermal runaway, the DO-160 environmental qualification conditions applied to the pack and PDU as airborne equipment (temperature and altitude, temperature variation, humidity, operational shocks and crash safety, and vibration), flight loads, and durability over service life. Your analysis will provide engineering evidence that the propulsion battery system is structurally robust, thermally safe, and certifiable.

Within the Mechanical Design & Integration team, you will collaborate with Mechanical Design, Materials & Processes, Test, HV Electrical Systems, Airborne Electronics, Thermal Systems, Aircraft Structures, Certification, Safety, and Quality teams to define analysis methods, apply the material property allowable required for your analyses, and substantiate the qualification of the propulsion battery pack and PDU. You will be the structural and thermomechanical analysis authority for the propulsion battery system, responsible for checking and releasing design against the applicable stress and thermomechanical requirements.

Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION’s mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

title: Senior Battery Algorithms Engineer (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

We are developing a next-generation electric aircraft propulsion system, with the propulsion battery designed, developed, and validated in-house. Accurate real-time observation and prediction of the battery’s State of Function (SoF), the energy and power actually accessible for safe flight and landing, is the safety-critical output of the battery system, and the basis for pre-flight planning, in-flight energy management, and the energy information presented to the crew.

SoF is built on the underlying battery states that your algorithms observe and predict: state of charge (SoC), state of health (SoH), state of power (SoP), state of energy (SoE), and state of balance (SoB). Erroneous observation or prediction of SoF is classified as a catastrophic condition, since it can lead the crew to commit to a flight or an approach the battery cannot support. This makes the function certification-critical and places exacting demands on the accuracy, robustness, and verifiability of every algorithm you deliver.

As a Senior Battery Algorithms Engineer (all genders), you will join the VÆRIDION Technology team and take ownership of the development and validation of the state observers, estimators, and predictors that determine SoF for our lithium-ion propulsion battery systems.

This is a hands-on senior role in which you lead the modeling, simulation, algorithm development, test-data analysis, and validation behind these states, and set the methodology the team works to.

Your work will shape the high-voltage battery system at the center of VÆRIDION’s electric propulsion architecture and carry it through to certification.

title: Associate Product Owner
description:
TL;DR

Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM.

Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature.
Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself.

The problem you'll be solvingA corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder.
GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.


What we're looking for

You have personally written the tickets.
3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off.
You are technical enough to argue with engineers.
AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better.
You can write.
A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second.

We’re looking for a hands-on Head of Brand Marketing to own how Goodlord shows up in the world - from our brand and content to PR, corporate affairs, thought leadership and the conversations shaping the future of renting.

Reporting directly to our Marketing Director, you’ll lead a talented team of four across content, SEO and design, manage our external PR agency, and work closely with colleagues across Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Sales and the wider business.

title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux - CDD de 18 mois
description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux pour rejoindre le département COMELEC à Télécom Paris.

Les fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (Hollow-Core Photonic Crystal Fibers, HCPCF) ont récemment franchi une étape technologique majeure, avec des pertes de propagation pouvant atteindre 0.1 dB/km à 1550 nm, comparables, voire inférieures, à celles des fibres télécoms standards [1–2]. La lumière se propageant principalement dans l’air, les HCPCF présentent une latence réduite de 30 à 40 %, une dispersion ultra-faible et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables. Ces propriétés uniques en font des technologies particulièrement prometteuses pour les systèmes de télécommunications de nouvelle génération, la distribution quantique de clés (Quantum Key Distribution, QKD) sur longue distance et les applications de détection distribuée.

title: Onboard Software Engineer - Peripheral Services
description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft’s Onboard Software group provides the on-orbit software that powers our satellite fleet — from the Linux services running on the Hub’s onboard computers, to the containerized workloads executing customer applications in low Earth orbit.

The Peripheral Services team owns the software that integrates third-party devices and payloads into Loft’s standardized satellite platform. We enable the control and monitoring of many key spacecraft components, including optical payloads, radios, power controllers, and GNSS receivers. Many of these components are reused across all satellite programs and form the building blocks of our onboard architecture.

The applications developed by our team handle the low-level communication protocol details, exposing the connected devices behind standardized APIs used across mission operations. The team is also responsible for the automation and orchestration that allows Loft to safely and reliably operate the equipment at scale.

In this role, you’ll help develop the software that connects diverse spacecraft hardware to the rest of the platform, and ultimately enables successful missions in orbit.

title: Quadrants: Compiler Lead
description:
What Quadrants is

Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research.

The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton.

It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public.

The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast.

The role

You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap.

Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further.

It calls for two things at once:

title: Genesis-World: Core Physics Engineer
description:
What we're building

Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future.

Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI. One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available (paper). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact (paper) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise.

Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright.

By owning our end-to-end operations and developing our technology in-house, we are able to deliver a customer experience built around freshness, speed, reliability and a broad assortment of both local and international products.

As we continue to scale, we are looking for a Senior Vice President Operations to lead the next stage of our operational development across Europe.

title: Head of Finance Automation/ AI Agentification
description:
Finance at Rohlik is being rebuilt to run on AI. We already have agents in production that chase overdue payments, process invoices, allocate cash and clear the team's inbox. The pieces work. What we need now is one person to own the whole thing and make it deliver at scale.

 

Role Overview

This is a new role that owns how AI and automation reshape the finance operating model across the Group. You will take a programme that is already live across procure to pay, order to cash and our shared services centre, and turn it from a set of promising experiments into the way finance actually runs.

You report to the Group CFO. You inherit a small team and a live roadmap, and you own the result. You decide what gets automated first, you build and ship with AI tools when that is the fastest way, and you hold every workstream to a number.

The role is deliberately hands on. You should be close enough to the work to build an agent or connect two systems through an API with AI assistance, even though you are not a software developer. You should also be senior enough to redesign how finance works and bring the rest of the business with you.

 

Why this role is exciting

  • You’ll inherit a live AI programme with real agents, real data and real impact from day one — not a greenfield slide deck.

  • You’ll shape how Finance actually runs across the Group as we move toward the next stage of growth — including the journey toward IPO readiness.

description:

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. title: Territory Sales Partner
description:
Build Your Own Sales Business with Omada.ai

Omada.ai is the AI-powered marketing platform built for small businesses. We handle social media, email marketing, ads, and reputation management — so local business owners can stop being reluctant marketers and get back to doing what they love.

We’re venture-backed by HubSpot Ventures and Crosslink Capital, growing fast, and looking for independent, ambitious sales partners across the UK who want to earn serious money introducing local businesses to Omada.

The Opportunity

This isn’t a job — it’s a partnership. As an Omada Territory Sales Partner, you run your own independent sales operation. You choose your hours, your territory, your approach. We provide the product, the resources, and a compensation structure that means you’re never working for free.

  • Guaranteed Weekly Draw: £500/week guaranteed minimum — as long as you’re hitting your trial targets. This isn’t commission-only.

  • Commission: £250–£350 per closed account (tier-dependent) with uncapped earnings. Top partners earn £4,000–£8,000+ per month.

  • Structure: Self-employed (sole trader or limited company). You invoice us. You manage your own tax.

  • Location: Your local city. Must be based in the United Kingdom.

  • Schedule: Entirely your own. Work when it suits you — mornings, eve

title: Senior Deep Learning Research Engineer
description:
At Plumerai, we make it easy and affordable for developers to add highly accurate AI to their camera devices, enabling them to create amazing new products. Major brands deploy our advanced computer vision models on millions of smart home cameras in the field and we're rapidly expanding into other sectors, such as commercial security, elderly care and retail. title: Office Manager
description:
Our Mission

At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails, and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved.

We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility.

The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it. We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. title: Senior Credit Underwriter | UK
description:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp is looking for a Senior Underwriter to join our Underwriting team in Europe. You’ll evaluate businesses applying to Ramp, make credit and risk decisions, and help improve how we assess customers across our products.

This is an early regional role supporting EU and US applicants. We’re looking for someone with strong financial judgment who can work independently, make clear decisions with incomplete information, and help us build scalable underwriting processes.

What You’ll Do

  • Review applications for Ramp’s corporate card and bill pay products across the EU and US.

  • Analyze financial statements, bank data, bureau information, and other risk signals

This is a hands-on, product-minded role built for someone who's sat close to a product, noticed something the roadmap was missing, and pushed to change it. It's a growth path into product management, product marketing, or deployment.

Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work.

title: Office Manager CDD
description:
About Pelico

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.

Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

What You'll Do

  • Facility Operations: Own the daily life of our Paris office. Keep the space running, well stocked and pleasant to work in, and act as the main point of contact with our building management, suppliers and service providers.

title: Internship - Founders' Office
description:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

We’re hiring a hands-on Security Lead to strengthen the security of Langdock’s product, infrastructure, and internal systems.

AI is the biggest transformation of our lifetime. Most companies know they need to move. Few know how. This is where you come in.

As an Enterprise Deployments Engineer at Langdock, you own the infrastructure that powers our enterprise AI platform across dozens of customer cloud environments. You build the systems that make deploying, monitoring, and operating Langdock scalable, turning what today takes weeks into a repeatable, automated process that works across AWS, Azure, GCP, and self-hosted cloud configurations.

This is not a back-office infrastructure role. Customer-facing work is a core part of what you do. You work directly with IT, security, networking, and compliance teams at some of Europe's largest enterprises, translating their requirements into working infrastructure and navigating their approval processes to move deployments forward. As we scale into the world's largest regulated financial institutions, identity and access management (IAM), authorization, and fine-grained permissions have become foundational to our enterprise readiness.

Joining us, you'll design and build permission models and access controls end-to-end, from the React/TypeScript access-management and admin UIs down to the Python (FastAPI) authorization services. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. Transforming 50M+ daily events into real-time actionable dashboard insights

The Dashboards team is responsible for the systems and interfaces that define our partners' daily operations. Our External Statistics API aggregates data from Druid, Athena, and DynamoDB into self-serve publisher dashboards and daily reports. description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. Identifying fraudulent patterns across 400 Million Daily Events

More than 440 million ad events flow through our systems daily, and the Advertising Analytics team is responsible for understanding, improving, and safeguarding that ad delivery system.

With over 2,000 games from top studios around the world, Anti-Fraud Data Analysts dig into the behavioural and technical data points. Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

  • The go-to anti-fraud person for business stakeholders. You'll own the first line of technical knowledge for our Anti-Fraud unit, working directly with business stakeholders. You translate complex data findings into clear, actionable recommendations.

Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers.

We build the mission-critical engine that powers real-time navigation for Mapbox's largest global customers. We process petabytes of geospatial data through a sophisticated blend of high-scale backend services, data pipelines, and AI Agentic workflows to detect, validate, and deliver live road updates - from traffic jams to road closures. Are you ready to work on solutions that deliver more than promises—solutions that improve the quality of life for thousands of households every day? At Enpal, the work you do today helps deliver clean energy tomorrow and creates a lasting impact on the way we generate, manage, and use energy.

title: Werkstudent:in Content & Social Media (m/w/d)
description:
Worum es geht

Wir sind OK ROGER. Im Kern eine Markenberatung: Unsere Kunden können etwas — nur sieht man es ihnen oft nicht an. Zwischen dem, was sie sind, und dem, was ankommt, liegt Rauschen. Wir räumen es weg.

Aber Markenberatung ist nur eine Sparte. Wir wachsen gerade stark und unternehmerisch, in mehrere Richtungen gleichzeitig. Für dich heißt das: Du steigst über einen klaren Bereich ein — und bleibst nicht darauf beschränkt.

Dein Einstieg ist die Content-Produktion für unsere Social-Media-Kunden. Das ist der Anfang, nicht die Decke. Weil wir wachsen, wächst die Rolle mit — in mehr Verantwortung, in neue Bereiche, so weit du willst.

Was du bei uns machst

Dein Einstieg: Content für unsere Kunden.

  • Du produzierst Content: Redaktionsplanung, Grafik und Text, fertige Posts — mit eigener Handschrift.

  • Du bringst eigene Ideen mit. Formate, Aufhänger, Posts — nicht nur Umsetzung, sondern Einfälle.

  • Am Anfang arbeitest du eng an unserer Seite. Nach dem Onboarding übernimmst du eigene Kunden — du planst, produzierst und verantwortest ihren Auftritt, wir schauen nur noch an den richtigen Stellen drauf.

  • Du holst Freigaben bei Kunden ein und stimmst Operatives ab. Die Kundenbeziehung selbst bleibt bei uns.

  • Du hältst die Qualität, auch im Detail. Bei uns liest der Markt Sorgfalt als Substanz.

Dein Blick über den Tellerrand.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit uns zusammen und bekommst Einblick, wo andere Werkstudierende nie hinkommen: wie eine Beratung geführt wird, wie Entscheidungen fallen, wie aus einer Idee ein Unternehmen wird.

  • Konkret packst du beim Aufbau eines weiteren unternehmerischen Projekts mit an, das wir gerade hochziehen.

  • Ja, manches davon ist Organisieren und Mitdenken im Alltag. Aber nichts davon ist Beschäftigung — jede Aufgabe zeigt dir ein Stück davon, wie Unternehmen entstehen.

title: Palvelupäällikkö taloushallinnon tiimiin Ouluun
description: Johda tiimiä ja kehitä asiakkuuksia   Haluatko yhdistää tiimin ja asiakkuuksien johtamisen sekä kehittämistyön roolissa, jossa pääset oikeasti vaikuttamaan? Meillä pääset vetämään asiantuntevaa tiimiä ja rakentamaan sujuvaa arkea sekä asiakkaille että omalle porukallesi.  Haemme taloushallinnon tiimiin palvelupäällikköä vakituiseen työsuhteeseen vahvistamaan ammattilaistemme joukkoa Oulussa ja lähipaikkakunnilla. Työntekopaikkana toimii Oulun seutu ja odotamme työskentelyä pääosin Oulun tai lähikuntien toimistollamme.      Mitä työ pitää sisällään?    Tiimin toiminnan johtaminen annettujen tavoitteiden mukaisesti   Töiden organisointi ja resursointi  Asiakkuuksien johtaminen, kehittäminen ja asiakashuolenpito  Asiantuntijoiden sparraus ja osaamisen kehittäminen  Palvelun laadun varmistaminen  Toimintatapojen ja palveluiden kehittäminen sekä muutosten jalkauttaminen omassa tiimissä       Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?    Vastuullisen ja monipuolisen roolin, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan  Osaavan ja tukevan kollegaverkoston, esihenkilön ja hallinnon palvelutiimit  Mahdollisuuden kehittää sekä omaa että tiimisi osaamista  Kilpailukykyiset edut: laajennettu työterveys, suoritukseesi perustuva tulospalkkio sekä joustavat hyvinvointiedut (liikunta, kulttuuri, hyvinvointi, työmatkat...)       Tunnistatko itsesi tästä?    Sinulla on kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä ja asiakkuuksien johtamisesta  Osaat organisoida, priorisoida ja delegoida  Johdat mielelläsi esimerkillä ja innostat muita onnistumaan  Viestit selkeästi ja rakennat sujuvaa yhteistyötä  Haluat kehittää toimintaa ja viedä asioita eteenpäin       Meillä pääset osaksi yhteisöä, jossa    yhdessä tekeminen näkyy arjessa  tukea saa aina, ja ilmapiiri on avoin ja kannustava  arvostamme kehittämishalua, vastuullisuutta ja aitoa kiinnostusta ihmisten johtamiseen       Toimimme Aallon arvojen mukaisesti:  Osaan, Palvelen, Huolehdin, Kehityn.  Yhdessä  muodostamme tilitoimiston – monimuotoisen työyhteisön, työpaikan ja asiantuntijaorganisaation, jossa jokainen meistä voi työskennellä ylpeyttä, tyytyväisyyttä ja turvallisuutta tuntien. Yhteistyö kanssamme perustuu molemminpuoliseen kunnioitukseen, luottamukseen ja rehellisyyteen. Uskomme menestyksen kumpuavan tyytyväisistä asiantuntijoista, jotka mahdollistavat tyytyväiset asiakkaat. title: Palvelupäällikkö valtakunnalliseen asiakkuuteen Vantaalle
description: RTK-Palvelu Oy on suomalainen kiinteistöpalvelujen monialayhtiö jo 50 vuoden kokemuksella. Yhtiön 3000 ammattilaista antaa asiakkailleen päivittäin mahdollisuuden keskittyä olennaiseen. Olemme aidosti ylpeitä liiketoimintamme jalommasta tarkoituksesta, jonka myötä olemme omistajamme kautta jo vuosikymmenten ajan tukeneet lasten ja nuorten urheilua ja hyvinvointia valtakunnallisesti.   Tehtävänkuva ja odotukset Haemme valtakunnalliseen asiakkuuteen palvelupäällikköä, joka osallistuu niin asiakkuuden ohjausryhmätyöskentelyyn kuin kentän operatiiviseen toimintaan. Tuet nimetyn siivousasiakkuuden palvelutuotantoa, esihenkilöitä ja henkilöstöä eri puolilla Suomea sekä huolehdit siitä, että sovitut toimintatavat toteutuvat yhdenmukaisesti. Toimipisteesi sijaitsee pääkaupunkiseudulla, mutta tarvitset tehtävässä B-luokan ajokorttia, sillä työ edellyttää säännöllistä matkustamista eri paikkakunnille.Sinulla on vahvat yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaidot sekä kyky rakentaa pitkäjänteisiä asiakassuhteita. Toimit luontevasti asiakkaan, oman organisaation ja eri yksiköiden kanssa ja viet sovitut asiat käytäntöön. Tehtävä edellyttää sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.Tehtävässä tarvitset kokemusta tiimien johtamisesta, henkilöstön innostamisesta ja yhteistyöstä yli organisaatiorajojen. Osaat johtaa toimintaa tavoitteellisesti sekä tukea esihenkilöitä ja henkilöstöä muuttuvissa tilanteissa. Arvostamme pitkää esihenkilökokemusta siivousalalta ja siivousalan erikoisammattitutkintoa.Tunnet siivouksen operatiivisen toiminnan, asiakkuuksien hoidon ja palvelusopimusten vaatimukset. Hallitset työssä tarvittavat järjestelmät ja hyödynnät tietoa toiminnan seurannassa, raportoinnissa, päätöksenteossa ja kehittämisessä. Varmistat palvelun laadun, sovittujen tavoitteiden toteutumisen ja arjen sujuvuuden yli yksikkörajojen. Tarvittaessa osallistut myös käytännön työhön kentällä.Kehität omaa työtäsi, palvelutuotantoa ja asiakkuutta pitkäjänteisesti yhdessä asiakkaan ja organisaation eri toimijoiden kanssa. Etsit käytännön ratkaisuja, joilla parannetaan laatua, tehokkuutta ja asiakaskokemusta. Työsi tueksi saat koko yrityksen tuen, ja työtä tehdään oikeasti yhdessä yli yksikkörajojen.   Tarjoamme Pääset osaksi motivoitunutta ja yhteistyökykyistä tiimiä, jossa arvostetaan jokaisen panosta. Yhteisömme ilmapiiri on avoin ja kannustava, mikä luo parhaat mahdolliset edellytykset onnistumiseesi.Pidämme huolta henkilöstömme osaamisen kehittämisestä sekä työhyvinvoinnista. Pyrimme siihen, että työntekijämme työskentelevät meillä tyytyväisinä ja pitkään.Panostamme työturvallisuuteen vahvasti – tarjoamme esimerkiksi työturvallisuuskorttikoulutuksia sitä tarvitseville, ja kehitämme turvallisia työskentelytapoja jatkuvasti.Tarjoamme monipuolisia henkilöstöetuja, jotka tukevat hyvinvointiasi sekä arkeasi – etuihimme kuuluu lounasedun lisäksi muun muassa matkailuun, hyvinvointiin ja autoiluun liittyviä etuja. Virike-edulla haluamme kannustaa sinua liikkumaan ja palautumaan

title: Myymäläpäällikkö
description: Hae tähän työpaikkaan  Myymäläpäällikkö  Innostutko muiden onnistumisen mahdollistamisesta, tavoitteellisesta myynnistä ja tiimin johtamisesta? Tule tekemään kanssamme suomalaisten silmistä maailman onnellisimmat! Etsimme Loimaa, Forssa ja Somero -tiimiin myymäläpäällikköä, joka johtaa tiimiä esimerkillä ja innostavalla otteella. Tarjoamme työn, jossa pääset toimimaan vahvan asiantuntijuuden, avoimen yhteistyön ja asiakkaiden tarpeita kuuntelevan kulttuurin keskellä.   Esimerkillä johtamista ja henkilöstön kehittämistä   Myymäläpäällikön roolissa yhdistyy myynnillinen tekeminen ja valmentava esihenkilötyö. Valmennat 16 näkemisen asiantuntijasta koostuvan tiimisi toimintaa kokonaisvaltaisesti ja varmistat omalla esimerkilläsi, että tekeminen on Silmäaseman konseptin mukaista ja etenee tavoitteiden suuntaisesti. Rakennat ja ylläpidät tiimiisi kulttuuria, jossa autetaan toisia, jaetaan osaamista ja onnistutaan yhdessä. Myymäläpäällikkönä vastaat myymälöidesi toiminnasta, tuloksesta ja tiimin onnistumisesta.  Tulet osaksi Länsi-Suomen myymäläpäällikkötiimiä, jossa työskentelee 11 kollegaasi. Arjessa tukenasi ovat apulaismyymäläpäällikkö sekä esihenkilösi, aluejohtaja Joni Viili.   Myymäläpäällikkönä     Johdat tiimisi tavoitteita ja varmistat niiden saavuttamisen yhdessä apulaismyymäläpäällikön sekä tiimisi kanssa  Viihdyt myymälässä tiimisi kanssa, johdat tekemistä arjen tilanteissa ja johdat esimerkillä  Vastaat myynnin seurannasta, kehittämisestä ja tuloksellisesta tekemisestä  Valmennat ja sparraat tiimiäsi systemaattisesti sekä käyt jatkuvaa ja säännöllistä vuoropuhelua  Käyt keskusteluja tiimiläistesi kehittymisestä: meillä tavoitekeskustelut, perehdytyskeskustelut ja suoritukseen liittyvät keskustelut ovat osa arkea  Suunnittelet resurssit, laadit työvuorolistat sekä varmistat toiminnan tehokkuuden  Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä myymäläverkoston ja silmäsairaaloiden kanssa    Toimit esihenkilönä tiimillesi ja luot edellytykset onnistumiselle, tuet, ohjaat ja mahdollistat jokaisen kehittymisen. Olet tärkeä esimerkki muille ja varmistat, että tekeminen on asiakaslähtöistä, tavoitteellista ja sujuvaa joka päivä.  Tehtävä on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Aloituspäivä sovitaan yhdessä tehtävään valitun henkilön kanssa, toivomme, että voisit aloittaa marraskuun alussa. Vastuullasi ovat Loimaan, Forssan ja Someron myymälät, joiden välillä liikut säännöllisesti. Työ painottuu vahvasti myymälöihin ja tiimin arkeen, mutta osa työstä on mahdollista tehdä joustavasti myös etänä. Käytännössä vietät suurimman osan työajasta myymälöissäsi valmentaen ja kehittäen tiimisi osaamista. Pyrkimys on päästä käyttämään 60 % ajasta tiimisi valmentamiseen, 20 % hallinnollisten tehtävien parissa ja 20 % suunnittelutyöhön   Tulevalta kollegalta odotamme seuraavia ominaisuuksia   Meillä Silmäasemalla menestyt, kun suhtaudut työhösi asiakaslähtöisesti, olet utelias oppimaan uutta ja toimit luontevasti osana tiimiä. title: US Operations Manager
description: "한국의 이야기를 미국의 언어로, Babechat의 첫 미국 유저 경험을 함께 만들어갈 당신을 기다립니다."     안녕하세요, AI 캐릭터 채팅 서비스 'Babechat'과 'Tookit'을 성공적으로 선보이고 운영해 온 주식회사 일레븐입니다. 우리는 사용자와 AI 캐릭터 간의 경계 없는 소통을 통해 새로운 즐거움과 관계의 가능성을 만들어가고 있습니다.     한국과 일본, 대만에 이어 이제 미국 시장으로 향합니다. 미국 유저가 Babechat을 처음 만나는 순간부터 계속 머무르는 경험까지, 서비스 운영과 콘텐츠 현지화를 한 손에 쥐고 이끌어 갈 US Operation Manager를 찾습니다.     📌 이런 일을 해요 (주요 업무)   미국 서비스 출시를 준비하고, 런칭 이후 운영 전반을 오너십을 갖고 담당해요.  미국 유저의 문의(CS)와 피드백을 모니터링하고, 운영 이슈에 빠르게 대응하며 유저의 목소리를 팀에 전달해요.  헬프데스크·FAQ·유저 가이드 등 CS 채널을 처음부터 구축하고 관리해요.  디스코드·레딧 등 영어권 커뮤니티를 운영하며, 유저가 머무르고 싶은 공간을 만들어요.  현지 크리에이터와 소통하며 미국 유저에게 맞는 콘텐츠 소싱을 지원해요.  미국 시장 트렌드와 경쟁 서비스를 모니터링하며, 인사이트를 운영에 반영해요.  국내 콘텐츠·마케팅·제품팀과 긴밀하게 소통하며 한국과 미국을 잇는 다리 역할을 해요.         🎯 이런 분을 찾아요 (자격 요건)   한국어와 영어로 원활하게 업무할 수 있는 분  미국 문화와 온라인 콘텐츠에 대한 이해도가 높은 분  꼼꼼하게 운영 업무를 관리하고, 이슈에 빠르게 대응할 수 있는 분  AI 캐릭터챗, 웹소설, 웹툰, 게임 등 콘텐츠 서비스에 관심이 있는 분         ✨ 이런 분이면 더 좋아요 (우대 사항)   미국향 앱·웹 서비스 운영 경험이 있는 분  디스코드·레딧 등 영어권 커뮤니티 운영 경험이 있는 분  초기 서비스에서 다양한 업무를 주도적으로 수행해 본 분  콘텐츠 번역 또는 현지화 경험이 있는 분         🤝 합류 여정  서류 전형 → 1차(실무진) 인터뷰 → 2차(리더십) 인터뷰 → 레퍼런스 체크 → 최종 합격 및 오퍼 미팅     이력서와 함께 번역·현지화 또는 서비스 운영 경험을 보여줄 수 있는 자료(번역 샘플, 운영 사례 등)가 있다면 함께 제출해 주세요.        🎁 최고의 동료와 함께, 성장에만 집중하세요 (복지 및 문화)   📈 성장을 위한 전폭적인 지원    업무 관련 성장을 위한 식대, 교육, 도서, 소프트웨어 구독 비용은 법인카드로 자율적으로 사용해요.  업계 최고 사양의 장비와 유료 소프트웨어를 지원하며, 회사 인근 주차도 지원해 드려요.  매월 10만 원의 체력단련비와 연 1회 프리미엄 건강검진으로 건강까지 든든하게 챙겨요.    💻 유연하고 효율적인 근무 문화    주 2일 오피스 출근을 기본으로, 나머지 요일은 원격 근무로 유연하게 일해요.  코어타임 외 자율적인 시간 조율, 별도 승인 없는 자율 휴가제로 신뢰 기반의 문화를 만들어요.    💰 성과에 대한 확실한 보상    개인의 기여를 투명하게 반영하여 매년 1회 연봉을 협상해요.  분기별 목표 달성 시 현금 인센티브를 제공하고, 2년마다 유급 리프레시 휴가와 휴가비를 지원해요.         Babechat의 미국 진출을 최전선에서 함께 이끌어 갈 동료를 기다립니다. 많은 지원 부탁드립니다!

title: [쿠팡] CX Program Manager (경력 5년 이상)
description: 회사 소개   쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.  쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.  쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.      직무 소개   CCX Planning 팀은 CX 성과 지표를 관리하고, 조직 목표를 달성하는데 전념합니다. 데이터 기반으로 현재 상황을 분석하고 인사이트를 도출하며, 목표를 달성하기 위한 종합적인 계획을 수립합니다. 주요 이해 관계자와 긴밀히 협력하여 전략적인 솔루션을 제안하고 효과적인 실행을 지원합니다. 또한, 조직의 문화 활동을 지원하여 최고의 조직으로 성장하는데 기여합니다.      업무 내용   CCX performance metrics 수립, 관리, 분석을 통한 insight & action item 도출   고객 여정(Customer Journey) 분석 및 데이터 기반 Pain Point 발굴  CX 개선 프로젝트를 end-to-end로 기획, 실행 및 성과 관리  비즈니스 우선순위를 기반으로 CX 로드맵 수립 및 실행 관리   주요 이해 관계자로부터 비즈니스 우선순위를 명확히 이해하고 목표를 달성할 수 있도록 관련 데이터를 분석을 통해 효과적인 솔루션 제안 및 이행  Ad-hoc 프로젝트성 업무에 참여하여 개발, 데이터, 프로그램, 운영팀 등 여러 부서와의 협업을 통해 프로젝트 추진하여 최고의 고객 경험 창출에 기여      자격   요건    PM / 프로젝트 관리 경력 5년 이상 있으신  디테일에 민감하며 심층 분석에 대한 의지가 있으신 분  분석적이며 구조적인 사고의 보유자로서 여러 데이터에 대한 이해도가 높고 인사이트를 도출하실 수 있는 분  빠르게 변화하는 환경/업무를 즐기고 멀티태스킹이 가능하신 분  능동적인 업무처리하고 항상 기존에 것에 대한 질문을 품고 최적화 하실 수 있는 분  다양한 이해관계자 관리 능력 있으신 분  소비자 지향적 사고방식 지니신 분       우대   사항    재무 / 컨설팅쪽 유관 경력이 있으신 분  프로젝트 기획 / 운영 경험이 있으신 분  비즈니스 영어가 가능하신 분  CS 관련 업무 경험이 있으신 분       전형 절차 및 안내 사항    전형절차    서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격  전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.  전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.    참고사항    본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.  지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.  취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.  직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.  채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.  고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.    개인정보 처리방침    쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/    서류 반환 정책    본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.  당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.  위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.  당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.  단, 위 1

title: Delivery & Project Manager
description: Kan du holde mange initiativer i luften på én gang, uden at tabe overblikket?      Comm2ig søger en Delivery & Project Manager til vores Services & Delivery organisation. Vores serviceforretning er i vækst, og vi udvider leveranceorganisationen for at følge med efterspørgslen fra både nye og eksisterende kunder.     Du bliver omdrejningspunktet, når en aftale går fra salg til leverance. Du får også en central rolle i, hvordan vores serviceportefølje udvikler sig. Det er ikke ét stort projekt ad gangen; det er typisk fem til ti forløb i forskellige faser, som alle skal holdes i bevægelse. Du arbejder tæt sammen med salg, koordinatorer og de tekniske specialister i vores organisation.      Primære ansvarsområder:    Drive onboarding af nye kunder på vores managed services fra kontrakt til stabil drift  Lede implementerings- og udrulningsprojekter hos kunder  Være kundens primære kontaktpunkt i leverancefasen  Holde styr på scope, tidsplan, økonomi og fremdrift på tværs af din portefølje  Drive og bidrage til design og videreudvikling af services sammen med vores tekniske specialister  Sikre at nye services er klar til at blive leveret i skala, inden de går på markedet  Understøtte salgsorganisationen med leveranceperspektiv i tilbud og kundedialog  Identificere muligheder for at udvide samarbejdet med eksisterende kunder       Hvem er vi?   Comm2ig er blandt Danmarks største leverandører af it-infrastruktur og samarbejder med nogle af landets mest betydningsfulde private og offentlige organisationer. Vi er i dag omkring 170 medarbejdere fordelt på vores lokationer i Allerød, Aarhus V, Svenstrup J. og Kokkedal. Med en omsætning på ~1.5 mia. kroner i seneste regnskabsår står vi stærkt i markedet.      Arbejdssted   Stillingen besættes med primært arbejdssted i  Aarhus  eller  Svenstrup J . Der må påregnes rejseaktivitet til kunder og til vores øvrige lokationer.      Vi tilbyder    En central rolle i en serviceforretning i vækst  Bred kontaktflade til kunder, salg, tekniske specialister og koordinatorer  Reel indflydelse på, hvordan vores serviceportefølje udvikler sig  Et fagligt stærkt miljø med høj trivsel og uformelt arbejdsmiljø  Fleksibilitet i hverdagen og plads til at præge både stillingen og vores løsninger       Er det dig?   Du har bred erfaring med it-leverancer og nok teknisk fundament til at tale med både specialister og kunder uden en oversætter. Du behøver ikke selv kunne bygge løsningen. Du skal kunne gennemskue den, udfordre den og forklare den. Du trives med mange bolde i luften og med at prioritere skarpt, når noget skal vente.      Kompetencer    Erfaring med projektledelse og leverance af it-løsninger eller services, gerne fra leverandør- eller MSP-side  Projektledelsesværktøjskassen i orden – og pragmatisk sans for, hvor meget metode den enkelte opgave kræver  Kommerciel forståelse: du ka

Dans ce contexte, nous créons notre  Customer Service européen  afin d’accompagner au mieux nos distributeurs, grossistes et pharmacies.     Nous recherchons un  Customer Service Manager  capable de structurer cette organisation et d’en piloter la performance.     Ce rôle s’adresse à un profil attiré par  la construction, la transformation et l’impact opérationnel .      Votre mission :      Rattaché(e) au Global Supply Chain Director, vous aurez un rôle clé dans la structuration et la montée en maturité du Customer Service européen.     Concrètement, vous serez en charge de :    Structurer et stabiliser l’organisation Customer Service   Mettre en place des processus robustes et scalables   Piloter la gestion des commandes, litiges et flux financiers   Sécuriser le chiffre d’affaires en anticipant les risques opérationnels   Accompagner le déploiement des outils (SAP, CRM, EDI)   Recruter, structurer et développer une équipe de 7 collaborateurs    Vous serez au cœur de l’interface entre  Business, Supply Chain et Finance .            Description du profil :    Votre profil :       Vous combinez  vision structurante et sens de l’exécution .     Vous avez notamment :    Une expérience confirmée en Customer Service B2B   Une expérience dans un environnement en croissance ou en transformation   Une expérience de management d’équipe   Une bonne maîtrise des environnements ERP / CRM (SAP idéalement)   Une compréhension des flux Supply Chain et logistiques    Une expérience dans les secteurs  cosmétique, pharmaceutique ou FMCG  est un plus.      Pourquoi ce poste ?     Construire une organisation européenne en forte croissance   Avoir un rôle clé dans la sécurisation du business   Travailler dans un environnement dynamique et entrepreneurial   Contribuer directement à la performance d’une marque internationale    Si vous êtes motivé(e) par  les environnements en construction et les défis de transformation , nous serions ravis d’échanger avec vous.

title: Service Development Manager
description: Gapit Nordics  is a Norwegian technology company headquartered in Drammen, with offices in Kongsberg. While our roots are in the Nordics, our work reaches clients across the globe.  We specialize in Operational Technology and Information Technology, bridging the gap between the two by delivering manufacturer-independent, open-source–based solutions for monitoring, data collection, visualization, and management of critical infrastructure and data center environments. Where the Service Manager owns day-to-day delivery, this role builds the capability behind it: developing the service portfolio, establishing processes and systems that scale, and preparing the organization to take on new customers, sites and service agreements. title: Contact Center manager
description: Wyser è il brand globale che si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive di Gi Group Holding, la prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro e una tra le principali realtà che offrono servizi e consulenza HR a livello globale.      Posizione: Manager Contact Center      Per nostra azienda cliente ricerchiamo un Manager con esperienza comprovata nella supervisione di team inbound e outbound, con focus sulla gestione delle lead e sull’implementazione di strategie di vendita. Ti occuperai di coordinare un team dinamico contribuendo al raggiungimento degli obiettivi di business attraverso l’organizzazione e il miglioramento dei processi operativi.      Responsabilità principali:          Gestione di un team numeroso, garantire alte performance e un ambiente di lavoro positivo.  Coordinare le attività di qualificazione, follow-up e conversione dei lead per massimizzare le opportunità di vendita.  Pianificazione operativa: organizzare turni, definire obiettivi di performance e KPI, monitorare i risultati e implementare azioni correttive.  Ottimizzazione delle campagne collaborando con i reparti di marketing per migliorare le strategie di lead generation.  Monitorare e analizzare le performance, individuando aree di miglioramento e intervenendo di conseguenza.  Supportare lo sviluppo delle competenze del team attraverso formazione continua.  Utilizzare e ottimizzare strumenti di CRM, dialer e altre tecnologie, in collaborazione con i team dedicati.  Assicurare il rispetto delle normative vigenti sulla privacy e sulla gestione dei dati, inclusi GDPR e policy aziendali.    Requisiti e competenze:          Esperienza consolidata nel ruolo, preferibilmente in contesti strutturati e in evoluzione.  Ottime capacità di leadership e problem solving.  Conoscenza approfondita di strumenti di CRM e analisi dei dati.  Attitudine all’organizzazione, pianificazione  Forte orientamento ai risultati e capacità di lavorare per obiettivi.  Eccellenti doti comunicative e di teamwork.       Luogo di lavoro : Roma  Inquadramento livello Quadro  Range economico: 65.000/75.000  MBO aziendale  Benefit aziendale  Full office  Luogo di lavoro: Roma     L’offerta si intende rivolta a candidati ambosessi, nel rispetto del D.Lgs. n. 198/2006 e ss.mm.ii. e dei Decreti Legislativi n. 215 e n. 216 del 2003 sulle parità di trattamento.   I candidati sono invitati a leggere l’informativa privacy ai sensi degli artt. 13 e 14 del Reg. title: Customer Success Specialist
description: Vill du vara med och bygga en av Sveriges nästa startup-succéer?        Trots sin unga ålder har Elvy redan åstadkommit stordåd. Intresset för vår energilösning - med solceller, batteri och värmepump på abonnemang   -   är större än vad vi för närvarande kan leverera. Vi har branschens ögon på oss och investerarnas uppmärksamhet. Därför söker vi ännu en stjärna för att stärka vårt Customer Success-team.       Rollen: Customer Success Specialist    Du är kundens främsta kontaktperson och vårt öra mot rälsen. Du kommer att vara med och sätta standarden för hur vi arbetar - och fånga upp det vi som företag behöver göra bättre för att skapa en A+ kundupplevelse.       Du kommer att:     Vara kundens primära kontaktperson efter att våra energilösningar har installerats.    Ge snabb, professionell och hjälpsam support via telefon, mejl och andra kanaler.    Samarbeta nära med våra tekniker, installatörer och interna team för att lösa problem.    Aktivt bidra till att förbättra våra processer och lyfta kundupplevelsen till nya höjder.    Respresentera företaget i diverse digitala forum.        Vi tror att du:     Har tidigare erfarenhet av kundservice och älskar att hjälpa människor.    Kommunicerar tydligt och professionellt på svenska och engelska.    Klarar av att hantera många bollar i luften samtidigt.    Har ett öga för detaljer och en inre motor som alltid vill leverera på topp.    Gillar att bygga något från en tidig fas.    Har koll på – eller ett intresse för – solenergi, hållbarhet eller teknik (bonus, men inget krav).        Vad du får hos oss:     En central roll i ett av Sveriges mest snabbväxande energy-techbolag.    Mycket goda möjligheter till personlig utveckling.    Snabba beslutsvägar, stort mandat och högt i tak.    En chans att förändra hur hushåll konsumerar energi - på riktigt.        Låter det som något för dig? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag - vi intervjuar löpande.       Plats:   På plats i Stockholm     Start:   Snarast     Omfattning:   Heltid

title: Customer Growth Specialist
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Customer Growth Specialist based in Sweden.   The Customer Growth Specialist will own retention and expansion for an assigned segment of smaller video businesses.  You will be accountable for the revenue that stays within your customer cohort and the opportunities to grow it.  Rather than managing a traditional 1:1 customer portfolio, you will design coaching programs that can support customers at scale.  You will use customer data to identify businesses at risk, understand growth barriers, and determine which interventions can make a measurable difference.  Your coaching will cover practical growth decisions including pricing, packaging, positioning, offers, email strategy, funnels, and retention.  As the first person in this role, you will build the playbooks, programs, and operating model that can eventually scale across the segment.  The role combines customer coaching, data analysis, facilitation, experimentation, and commercial ownership in a remote global environment. Advise customers on revenue-driving decisions such as pricing, packaging, positioning, offer design, email and funnel strategy, and retention mechanics.  Monitor customer data and cohort behavior to identify accounts showing signs of risk before they churn.  Analyze retention curves, funnel performance, and customer behavior to determine which coaching interventions are producing meaningful results.  Build repeatable playbooks, coaching formats, and processes that can become the foundation for scaling customer growth programs.  Share customer insights and recurring patterns with Product and Customer Success teams to help improve the broader customer experience.  Use AI tools to support research, session preparation, customer analysis, and the creation of coaching resources.  Provide customers with clear, practical, and honest guidance, including when difficult conversations or assessments are necessary. Demonstrated experience helping online businesses, solo operators, founders, or small teams improve growth and revenue. Our mission is to build beautiful, long-lasting products that reflect true craftsmanship and respect for materials, people, and the environment. title: Asiakkuusvastaava
description: Kasvun myötä haemme nyt Fennoalle toista aktiivista ja kasvuhaluista  Asiakkuusvastaavaa  kokoaikaiseen ja vakituiseen tehtävään. Tehtävä sopii hyvin kaupallisen uransa alkuvaiheessa olevalle henkilölle. Olisitko sinä etsimämme hiomaton timantti kasvamaan osaksi kokenutta ja ammattitaitoista asiakkuustiimiämme?💎   Mistä tehtävässä on kyse? 🔍   Tehtävässä toimit sinulle nimetyn portfolion ensisijaisena yhteyshenkilönä ja vastaat asiakkuuksien tyytyväisyydestä sekä kasvattamisesta. Portfoliosi koostuu jo olemassa olevista asiakkaista, joihin olet aktiivisesti yhteydessä etäkanavia hyödyntäen (puhelin, Teams ja sähköposti), tarjoten heille apua ja lisäarvoa. Analysoit saatavilla olevaa tietoa ja hyödynnät tunnuslukuja sekä AI:ta asiakkuuksien hoitamisessa. Asiakastyön lisäksi rooliin kuuluu sisäisissä projekteissa työskentely ja avustaminen esim. viestiliikeenteeseen liittyvissä tehtävissä.  Asiakkuuksien hoitaminen on kuitenkin tiimityötä ja saatkin selkänojaksi työllesi esihenkilön sekä erittäin osaavan 8 hengen asiakkuustiimin tuen. Tässä tehtävässä sinulla on loistava mahdollisuus kehittyä, oppia uutta ja kasvaa tulevaisuudessa kohti laajempia vastuita.   Millaisia taitoja ja osaamista arvostamme?   Tehtävässä hyvin menestymistä pohjustaa soveltuva koulutustausta (esim. KTM tai Tradenomi) sekä mahdollinen aikaisempi työkokemus B2B-kentästä asiakkuudenhoidon ja/tai myynnin tehtävien parista. Aiempi työkokemus vastaavista tehtävistä ei kuitenkaan ole välttämätöntä, vaan etsimme ennen kaikkea henkilöä, joka on valmis oppimaan ja kasvamaan tehtävässä.  Tärkeimpiä ominaisuuksia, mitä toivomme sinulta, ovat proaktiivisuus, asiakaslähtöinen työskentelyote, erinomaiset vuorovaikutustaidot ja halu kehittyä. Olet vahva tiimipelaaja ja näet, että asiakkuuksien menestyksekäs hoitaminen on tiimityötä. Olet analyyttinen ja kiinnostunut hyödyntämään aktiivisesti myös dataa ja AI:ta asiakkuuksien hoitamisessa. Lisäksi aito kiinnostus seurata toimialan trendejä ja halu oppia uutta auttaa sinua menestymään.   Mistä lähdetään liikkeelle?   Haluamme varmistaa, että saat parhaan mahdollisen startin ja ensimmäinen askel perehdytysjakson jälkeen onkin Fennoan tuotteeseen ja tilitoimistomarkkinaan tutustuminen.  Fennoalla et jää yksin: tukenasi ovat tiiminvetäjä ja Asiakkuusjohtajamme Jesse, kokenut asiakkuustiimi sekä muut loistavat myynti- ja markkinointiosastomme kollegat, jotka kaikki auttavat ja sparraavat sinua matkan varrella.  Asiakkuusvastaavan palkkamalli koostuu kuukausipalkasta (3000-3500€/kk) sekä tavoitteisiin perustuvasta kvartaalibonuksesta, mikä antaa sinulle mahdollisuuden kasvattaa ansioitasi oman menestyksesi perusteella.   Miksi Fennoa?   Fennoa on täysin etäorganisaatio, joten meillä voit työskennellä mistä päin Suomea tahansa. Tarjoamme kotitoimistollesi kaiken tarvittavan sähköpöydästä langattomiin kuulokkeisiin ja maksamme myös kodin internet-yhteytesi, jotta työskentely olisi mahdollisimman sujuvaa missä tahansa oletkin.
