title: Customer Excellence Specialist
description: Location: Seoul, Korea OR Singapore OR New Delhi, India  Department: Customer Excellence – Data  Reports to: Customer Excellence Manager  Employment type: Permanent  Work model: Hybrid (shift-based including 1 weekend shift per month, no night shifts)  Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required).     Why this role matters   Deliver seamless, high-quality customer experiences across APAC region by managing the complete order-to-delivery process for ICEYE’s satellite radar data.  As a Customer Excellence Specialist, you will ensure customers receive timely and accurate Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery, balancing technical insight, proactive communication, and operational precision. You will work closely with our satellite operations, product, and analytics teams to make sure every delivery meets ICEYE’s world-class standards and customer expectations.   Who We Are   ICEYE is the global leader in synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite operations for Earth Observation, persistent monitoring, and natural catastrophe solutions. We own and operate the world’s largest SAR constellation, acquiring images of Earth at any time — even through clouds or darkness — to help commercial and government partners make data-driven decisions.  Our satellites and analytics support critical sectors, including maritime, disaster management, insurance, and finance. ICEYE’s mission is to improve life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.  Headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates from offices in five international locations and employs over 600 people from nearly 60 countries, united by our passion for innovation, teamwork, and impact. Prepare comprehensive feasibility studies for satellite imagery, ensuring customer requirements are met.     Satellite Resource Planning     Plan satellite resources for capturing Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) images.  Perform SAR image quality control to maintain high standards.     Customer Interaction     Resolve customer inquiries and complaints promptly.  Collaborate with cross-functional teams (satellite operators, sales, analytics, product software) to address project and customer-related issues.  Serve as a vital interface between clients and ICEYE, ensuring effective communication and interaction.     Process Improvement     Contribute to the enhancement of existing processes and documentation.  Report to management on key performance metrics and anomalies.     Product Knowledge     Maintain a thorough understanding of the company’s products, support, and services.     Governmental And Commercial Contracts     Serve as the point of contact for APAC governmental contracts and commercial clients.  Conduct feasibility studies and effectively communicate results

title: Customer Success Lead till Svea Billing Services
description: Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens kundupplevelse inom Billing Services? Vi befinner oss i en spännande förändringsresa där vi stärker vårt erbjudande, utvecklar våra arbetssätt och bygger en ännu mer kundfokuserad organisation. Nu söker vi en Customer Success Lead som vill ta en central roll i att utveckla kundresan, skapa struktur och säkerställa att våra kunder får maximalt värde av våra lösningar.  Det här är inte en traditionell Customer Success-roll, utan vi söker dig som kombinerar strategisk höjd med operativ handlingskraft och som trivs med att driva förändring genom samarbete och inflytande.   Om rollen   Som Customer Success Lead ansvarar du för att utveckla och samordna kundarbetet genom hela kundresan, från onboarding och implementation till långsiktig kundutveckling, retention och ökat kundvärde. Du kommer att jobba nära den kommersiella verksamheten, produktorganisationen och utvecklingsteamet. Rollen innebär såväl deltagande i det dagliga kundbemötandet och operativa arbetet, liksom fokus på att skapa effektiva arbetssätt, förbättra kundupplevelsen och säkerställa att vi arbetar proaktivt med våra kunder. Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden:    Utveckla kundresan och stärka kundvärdet genom hela kundlivscykeln.  Driva kundutveckling i nära samarbete med affär, produkt och utveckling.  Identifiera och prioritera initiativ som ökar kundnöjdhet och lojalitet.  Omsätta kundinsikter till förbättrade erbjudanden, processer och arbetssätt.  Bygga struktur, uppföljning och KPI:er för ett datadrivet kundarbete     Vem är du?   För att lyckas i rollen är du en prestigelös person som trivs med att växla mellan strategiskt utvecklingsarbete och operativt genomförande. Du är drivande och initiativtagande, tar ansvar för att föra arbetet framåt och ser vad som behöver göras utan att invänta instruktioner.  Du är också en naturlig lagspelare som bygger förtroende, skapar engagemang och får människor att samarbeta mot gemensamma mål. Samtidigt har du ett analytiskt och lösningsorienterat förhållningssätt, där du identifierar förbättringsmöjligheter och omsätter idéer till konkreta resultat.    Minst 5 års relevant erfarenhet inom Customer Success, Customer Experience (CX) eller liknande område  Erfarenhet från SaaS-, tech- eller produktbolag  Erfarenhet av onboarding, implementation och kundutveckling  Förmåga att arbeta tvärfunktionellt mellan kund, affär, produkt och teknik  Erfarenhet av att utveckla processer, arbetssätt och kundflöden  Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift    Det är meriterande om du även har:    Erfarenhet av fintech, betalningslösningar eller närliggande branscher  Erfarenhet av projektledning eller implementeringsprojekt  Erfarenhet av kundnöjdhetsarbete, retention och användardata  Erfarenhet av att leda genom inflytande utan formellt personalansvar  Kunskaper i norska eller finska      Om Svea     Svea Bank är en finansiell koncern med över 2000 anställda och verksamhet i fle

title: Yhteyspäällikkö, Kuopio
description: Mandatum on rahan ja hengen erikoisosaamisen yhdistävä merkittävä finanssipalvelujen tarjoaja. Yhtiö tarjoaa asiakkailleen laajan valikoiman palveluita kattaen omaisuuden- ja varainhoidon, säästämisen ja sijoittamisen, palkitsemisen ja sitouttamisen, eläkeaikaan varautumisen sekä henkilövakuuttamisen. Mandatumin liiketoiminnan menestyksen keskiössä ovat osaava henkilöstö, vahva brändi ja onnistuminen sijoitustoiminnassa.       Mandatumissa panostetaan inspiroivaan ja hyvinvoivaan työyhteisöön ja toimitaan yhtenä joukkueena. Työ meillä on tavoitteellista, mielenkiintoista ja täynnä haasteita. Monipuolisissa tehtävissämme työskentelee yli 600 innostunutta ja kehittymisestään kiinnostunutta rahan ja hengen ammattilaista.       Haluatko rakentaa pitkäaikaisia asiakassuhteita ja luoda kasvua? Hae yhteyspäälliköksi Kuopioon ja tule rakentamaan menestystä yhdessä asiakkaidemme kanssa.       Sinun roolisi      Yhteyspäällikön tehtävässä toimit yritysasiakkaidemme luotettuna kumppanina auttaen heitä hyödyntämään Mandatumin asiantuntemusta riski- ja eläkevakuuttamisen, varainhoidon sekä henkilöstön palkitsemisen ratkaisuissa. Asiakkaasi koostuvat yrittäjistä sekä pienistä ja keskisuurista yrityksistä, ja työsi painottuu aktiiviseen asiakashankintaan, asiakkuuksien kehittämiseen ja pitkäjänteisten kumppanuuksien rakentamiseen.     Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä Mandatumin asiantuntijoiden kanssa, kuten yksityisvarainhoitajien, palkitsemiskonsulttien ja juristien kanssa. Vastaat asiakkaiden tarpeiden tunnistamisesta ja oikeiden asiantuntijoiden osallistamisesta asiakkuuksien kehittämiseen.      Onnistumisen edellytykset      Olet tavoitteellinen ja asiakaslähtöinen myynnin ammattilainen, joka innostuu uusien mahdollisuuksien löytämisestä ja asiakkaiden liiketoiminnan ymmärtämisestä. Sinulla on näyttöjä tuloksellisesta myyntityöstä sekä halu kehittää osaamistasi finanssialan asiantuntijaympäristössä.     Lisäksi toivomme, että   sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva kaupallinen koulutus  hahmotat laajoja kokonaisuuksia ja osaat esittää ne selkeästi  sinulla on erinomaiset vuorovaikutus-, kuuntelu- ja esiintymistaidot  työskentelet oma-aloitteisesti ja viet asioita määrätietoisesti eteenpäin  nautit asiakaskohtaamisista ja aktiivisesta asiakastyöstä.       Johda urasi Mandatumiin       Panostamme palkittuun työntekijäkokemukseemme. Mandatum on valittu useasti Great Place to Work -tutkimuksessa Suomen parhaiden työpaikkojen joukkoon suurten organisaatioiden sarjassa ja on viime vuosina ansainnut Siqni-henkilöstökyselyyn perustuvan Future Workplaces -sertifikaatin erinomaisesta työntekijäkokemuksesta.  Osaamispääoman kasvattaminen. Tuemme työtä huolellisella perehdytyksellä ja jatkuvalla osaamisen kehittämisellä. Tukenasi on valmentava esihenkilö sekä positiivinen ja motivoitunut tiimi.   Työyhteisössämme positiivisuus ja tekemisen asenne tarttuu. Menestyäksemme tarvitsemme toisiamme ja ammattitaitoisia kollegoita. Työskentelemme joustavassa hybridityömallissa

title: Head of Account Management
description: Om JP/Politikens Hus og Business Media   JP/Politikens Hus er en af Skandinaviens førende medievirksomheder og tæller udgivelser som Politiken, Jyllands-Posten, Ekstra Bladet, samt Politikens Forlag, Saxo og distributionsvirksomheden Dao. JP/Politiken Business Media er en særskilt forretningsenhed i JP/Politikens Hus med omkring 500 medarbejdere. Vi er et  house of brands  og driver en vifte af digitale, abonnementsbaserede titler, herunder Watch Medier, Finans, Marketwire, Dezeen og senest Altinget og Mandag Morgen. Vores titler og vidensprodukter henvender sig til professionelle aktører i erhvervslivet i hele Norden samt i Tyskland og UK. Til en ny kommerciel rolle i Århus søges en:      Head of Account Management   Vil du stå i spidsen for at udvikle en moderne og datadrevet Account Management organisation med fokus på at fastholde og vækste nogle af JP/Politiken Business Medias største kunder? Og motiveres du af muligheden for at præge processer, målepunkter, organisation og ledelse? Så kan denne nye rolle hos JP/Politiken Business Media være et naturligt næste karriereskridt for dig.  JP/Politiken Business Media søger en ambitiøs kommerciel leder, der kan løfte arbejdet med kunder på tværs af Danmark, Norge og Sverige. Du får ansvaret for Account Growth på tværs af Watch Medier, Finans, MarketWire og Monitor Medier med fokus på at fastholde kunder, udvikle relationerne og skabe vækst gennem øget penetration, upsell og cross-sell.     Forretningen har gennem de senere år gennemgået en markant kommerciel transformation fra klassisk mediesalg mod skalerbare abonnements-, data- og enterpriseforretninger. Det stiller nye krav til arbejdet med kunder, data og kommercielle processer.      En central rolle i udviklingen af Account Management   Som Head of Account Management bliver din vigtigste opgave at udvikle en professionel og skalerbar Account Management organisation, hvor processer, systemer og data understøtter en systematisk udvikling af eksisterende kunder. Du får 10-15 medarbejdere i direkte reference på tværs af tre lande og betydelig mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på organisationen, arbejdsmetoderne og den kommercielle tilgang.     En central del af rollen bliver at videreudvikle Account Management processer, CRM-governance, pipeline management, forecast og KPI-strukturer. Du skal definere best practice og arbejdsmetoder, og samtidig sikre en mere strategisk udvikling af de største kunder gennem segmentering, stakeholder mapping og account plans.     Brugerdata, abonnementsmønstre og kundeindsigter bliver vigtige værktøjer til at identificere potentialet hos den enkelte kunde. title: Head of Customer Success
description: Desde Nuclio Talent buscamos un/a Head of Customer Success para incorporarse a una compañía especializada en salud hormonal masculina.     Se trata de una oportunidad para liderar una función estratégica en una empresa en pleno crecimiento, donde tendrás la responsabilidad de diseñar la estrategia de Customer Success, construir el equipo y garantizar una experiencia excelente para los pacientes durante todo su ciclo de vida.     ¿Cuáles son las funciones y responsabilidades de un/a Head of Customer Success?     • Definir y liderar la estrategia de Customer Success alineada con los objetivos de la compañía.  • Crear, desarrollar y liderar el equipo, impulsando su crecimiento y evolución.  • Diseñar y optimizar el customer journey para mejorar la experiencia del paciente.  • Definir y analizar los principales KPIs del área (NPS, CSAT, Churn, Retención, LTV, etc.).  • Desarrollar iniciativas para mejorar la fidelización y el engagement de los clientes.  • Identificar oportunidades de mejora continua y optimización de procesos.  • Colaborar estrechamente con los equipos de Marketing, Producto, Operaciones y Clínica para ofrecer una experiencia diferencial.  • Implantar herramientas y metodologías que permitan escalar el área de Customer Success.     ¿Qué skills debo tener para ser un buen Head of Customer Success?     • Experiencia de al menos 5 años en Customer Success, Customer Experience o áreas afines.  • Experiencia liderando y desarrollando equipos.  • Background en compañías B2C.  • Capacidad analítica y orientación a resultados.  • Experiencia trabajando con herramientas CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zendesk o similares).  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, liderazgo e influencia.  • Nivel alto de español e inglés.     Para destacar en este rol, necesitas:     • Haber participado en la creación o escalado de equipos de Customer Success.  • Experiencia en compañías HealthTech, salud hormonal, medicina estética o healthcare (muy valorable).  • Mentalidad estratégica con capacidad de ejecución.  • Orientación al cliente y pasión por ofrecer una experiencia excelente.  • Capacidad para desenvolverte en entornos dinámicos y en constante crecimiento.     ¿Por qué debería aplicar a la oferta de un/a Head of Customer Success?     Porque tendrás la oportunidad de incorporarte a una compañía con una propuesta de valor innovadora y un ambicioso plan de crecimiento. title: Head of Support Excellence & Transformation
description: Department:  Customer Support   Employment Type:  Permanent   Location:  Madrid   Reporting To:  Christian Wolf   Description    About osapiens   osapiens helps global companies build transparent, compliant, and sustainable supply chains.  Our platform powers 2 500 + enterprise clients — from leading DAX and S&P 500 companies, to key players in manufacturing, to most major retailers, and all the way down the supply chains to cacao farmers in some of the most remote regions of the world.  If our systems are down, imports into Europe could halt, production lines across industries would stop, and thousands of trucks could no longer deliver worldwide. Our holistic platform for supply-chain transparency, resilience, and automation helps businesses grow responsibly — with sustainability and scalability always in focus.  That’s why our Support organization is mission-critical. When we perform well, global supply chains keep moving; and sustainability goals become reality.   The Challenge   Our Support team currently handles around 2000 tickets per month, ranging from simple knowledge questions to production-critical incidents. We trade with global suppliers and distribute to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade and distribution end-to-end: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, and embedded financing.   • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover

title: Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows.
You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

What you will work on

  • Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics  and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
  • Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on.
  • Cloud infrastructure on GCP. Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you.
  • Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now  and bringing the rest of the team along with it.

description:

  • 27 600 € bruts annuels de variable cible, à 100 % des objectifs

  • Développer durablement votre secteur grâce à une prospection régulière et structurée

title: Senior Embedded Linux Engineer (all genders) - Yocto · Python · IoT Edge
description:
This position sits close to the embedded world, but it isn't traditional microcontroller firmware work. You'll own the operating system foundation and platform layer of our IoT devices - building and evolving our next-generation embedded Linux image - and develop the Python application layer that runs on top of it, inside our dockerized main application.

You'll work down at the OS and hardware boundary while shipping features up in the application layer. Typical areas include:

  • Designing and maintaining our Yocto-based Linux distribution for ARM devices with limited compute

  • Security on device, inter-process communication, networking, scheduling, observation

  • Over-the-air (OTA) updates for both the OS and applications

  • Integrating peripherals - watchdog, modem, AI accelerator - and improving their observability

  • Bridging the system layer and the application layer through Python and Bash

The work spans from driver- and kernel-level integration in C/C++, to adapting our Linux distribution with Yocto to the underlying hardware layer, to debugging system-level failures such as memory leaks, up to writing the Python software that turns hardware capabilities into product features.

🎤 Founders Associate - a letter from the person you'd work with

Most job ads are written by no one, for everyone. I want to do this differently.

I'm Marius, Chief of Staff at voize. This role reports to me, and whoever takes it will work more closely with me than anyone else in the company. So instead of a template, here's what this job is, how I work, and how you can decide whether you'd want to work with me.

💡 What this job actually is

voize is growing fast, and fast-growing companies produce a specific kind of work: topics that matter but belong to no one. A new market needs operational groundwork. An org-wide process needs to be built. A decision needs a sharp analysis behind it. We're building a CEO Office to own exactly this work. You'd be its first hire.

I’ll be honest about the range. One week you’re working on a question that I and the rest of the management team will decide the company’s direction on. The next you're doing operational groundwork nobody will ever applaud. Both matter equally, it's the nature of building an early-stage company. If you need every task to feel glamorous, stop reading here. If "done" is your favorite word, keep going.

To make it concrete, your first months could look like this: you own the operational groundwork for one of our new markets end-to-end - research, vendor and partner setup, local operations - until things simply run. And you build one company-wide process from scratch, for example how cross-functional projects get scoped, prioritized, and tracked, and roll it out across the org. Different altitude, same job: you drive it to done.

title: Control System Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Your role

You’ll shape how our robots move, sense, and respond, turning control theory into real-world performance

You’ll push existing products further and bring new prototypes to life with both state-of-the-art and experimental methods. In practice, that means: 

  • Exploring advanced algorithms, controllers, calibration, digital signal processing and finding what actually works on hardware
  • Implementing those algorithms in C++ and Python (and Matlab/Simulink when it fits)
  • Designing and running test benches that reveal true system performance
  • Building software for data acquisition and processing
  • Identifying dynamic system properties
  • Connecting the stack end to end: embedded firmware, middleware, backends, and analysis platforms
  • Hunting down and fixing interoperability issues across systems and devices


Your experience and qualifications

  • 3+ years as a control system engineer or mathematician

description: About EVERYANGLE   EVERYANGLE is a retail Vision AI company built on an agentic core. description: Customer Care zorgt voor Customer Success   Als Manager Customer Care ben je verantwoordelijk voor de klanttevredenheid van ruim 100 gemeenten die gekozen hebben voor onze software. Samen met je team zorg je dat de investering die ze deden zich ook uitbetaalt. Het initiatief ligt bij ons: van reageren naar vooruitdenken.      Samenlevingszaken   Bij Samenlevingszaken maken we software waarmee gemeenten hun dienstverlening in het sociaal domein toekomstbestendig organiseren. Denk aan vraagstukken rond werk, inkomen en participatie. Met iSamenleving ondersteunen we de consulent, met iParticipatie de inwoner. Zo helpen we gemeenten om overzicht te houden en sneller te handelen, zodat inwoners de ondersteuning krijgen op de momenten die ertoe doen.      Jouw opdracht   Klantvertrouwen ontstaat niet door goede bedoelingen, maar door duidelijkheid. Door afspraken die helder zijn en resultaten die zichtbaar worden gehaald. Jij weet als eerste waar klanten vastlopen en waar meer mogelijk is, en vertaalt die signalen naar wat de organisatie moet oppakken. Daarmee stuur je op tevreden klanten die iedere keer opnieuw voor ons kiezen.     Concreet werk je aan:      Klantsucces: jij zorgt dat gemeenten hun doelen halen met onze software. Denk aan een inwoner die sneller weet of hij een uitkering krijgt, of een gemeente die eerder ziet wie hulp nodig heeft.  Adoptie: jij maakt adoptie een vast onderdeel van het klantcontact, en laat klanten zien wat er nog meer mogelijk is.  Servicemanagement: SLA's, rapportages en periodiek overleg. Jij maakt zichtbaar wat we leveren, en wat we van klanten nodig hebben om dat te kunnen.  Escalatiemanagement: als een gemeente vastloopt in haar eigen dienstverlening, sta jij vooraan. Niet alleen om het op te lossen, maar om de oorzaak weg te nemen.  Doorontwikkeling van je team: van meldingen afhandelen naar meedenken met klanten. Jij haalt het routinewerk eruit, onder meer met AI, en geeft je team de ruimte om zich inhoudelijk te ontwikkelen.  De operatie: je zit zelf bij gemeenten aan tafel en springt bij als het ergens vastloopt.       Positie in de organisatie   Als lid van ons managementteam geef je leiding aan een team van 6 fte, bestaande uit Customer Care specialisten, een Customer Success Manager en Functioneel Beheer. De unit telt zo'n 70 collega's. Je werkt intensief samen met Productmanagement, Professional Services, Sales en Development, en rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Managing Director. Samenlevingszaken is onderdeel van PinkRoccade Local Government; met de kracht van het beursgenoteerde CSI en TSS achter ons combineren we de slagkracht van een grote organisatie met de wendbaarheid van het MKB.      Wat mag jij van ons verwachten?   Deze rol is nieuw. Customer Care krijgt een eigen plek in het managementteam. Wat er moet gebeuren is duidelijk. Hoe je dat aanpakt, bepaal jij.     Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:      Een dienstverband van 32 tot 40 uur per week.  Een competitief vast salaris met een resultaatafh

Mit unseren Plattformen  Opinary  und  mCanvas  unterstützen wir Marken dabei, ihre Zielgruppen mit innovativen digitalen Werbelösungen zu erreichen.   Von interaktiven Umfragen über CTV bis hin zu Rich-Media-Formaten entwickeln wir Kampagnen, die Kreativität mit Technologie verbinden und Marken helfen, ihre Kommunikationsziele zu erreichen.   Für unser Account Management Team in Deutschland suchen wir Verstärkung. Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden, Sales und unseren internen Teams zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass Kampagnen erfolgreich umgesetzt werden.  Aufgaben  Als  Specialist   Account Management  bist du die Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden und internen Teams. Du begleitest Kampagnen, analysierst Ergebnisse und unterstützt Kunden dabei, unsere Produkte  Opinary  und  mCanvas  erfolgreich einzusetzen.    Deine Aufgaben      Du betreust Kunden im europäischen Markt und bist Ansprechperson für laufende Kampagnen und Projekte   Du unterstützt Kunden bei der Planung und Umsetzung unserer Werbelösungen.   Du analysierst Kampagnen-Ergebnisse und gibst Empfehlungen zu Formaten, KPIs und Optimierungen.   Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Sales Team zusammen, damit Kampagnen reibungslos umgesetzt werden.   Du erkennst Möglichkeiten, Kunden weiterzuentwickeln und zusätzliche Lösungen einzubringen.   Du pflegst CRM-Daten und nutzt Kunden-Insights, um Aktivitäten strukturiert zu begleiten.    Qualifikation     1–2 Jahre Berufserfahrung  im Account Management, Customer Success, Digital Marketing, Media oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.   Erste Erfahrung mit digitalen Kampagnen oder Werbeformaten wie Display, Video, CTV und Rich Media.   Interesse an digitaler Werbung und daran, wie Marken ihre Zielgruppen erreichen.   Eine strukturierte, zuverlässige Arbeitsweise und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden.   Datenaffinität und idealerweise erste Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen wie  HubSpot  sowie LLMs, wie z. Bsp Claude.   Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.    Benefits    Ein internationales Unternehmen mit über 600 Mitarbeitenden weltweit.   Flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten mit Hybrid-Modell – im Büro oder remote.   Viel Eigenverantwortung, kurze Entscheidungswege und Raum für eigene Ideen.   Die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.   Ein internationales Team mit enger Zusammenarbeit über verschiedene Standorte hinweg.     Wir freuen uns auf Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven. Vielfalt, Chancengleichheit und Inklusion sind für uns selbstverständlich.

title: Graduate Customer Success Manager at Dublin Tech Company (€30-45k base salary + Hybrid)
description: Looking for a job is f*cking hard!   You send off tons of applications only to get ghosted by recruiters and to never get any feedback. We understand how tough it is and that’s why we created Tangent - so you can  get help to get hired.        What is Tangent?       Tangent lets you bypass the recruiters by connecting you directly with your future colleagues. They commit their time to mentor you through the job search process, review your CVs, offer career advice, and  refer you into exclusive job opportunities at their company  (that’s recommending you internally to the recruitment team).       How does it work?        Easy Apply - we don’t make you waste time repeating what’s in your CV  Complete your video intro - just 1 question for 1 min  Connect with the Mentors - get referred and coached through the interview process at their company      Did you know?! If you are referred for a job you’re  9x more likely to be hired  vs applying direct on a job board.       The role:          Graduate Customer Success Manager  at one of Dublin's leading tech employers  You'll be responsible for building strong relationships with customers to ensure they achieve their desired outcomes while using a company's product or service. Your role combines  customer support, account management, and proactive engagement  to drive satisfaction, retention, and growth  Experience in  account management, customer support, sales, training, and project management  translates well into a Customer Success role. Strong  relationship-building, problem-solving, and communication skills  are essential. Backgrounds in  consulting, SaaS, or marketing  can also be valuable, especially if they involve helping clients achieve their goals.  Job Type: Full-time  Salary: €30,000.00-€45,000.00 per year        What do I need?        You must be able to work in the Ireland without needing sponsorship/visa  Be able to work in office or hybrid in Dublin  Excited by the opportunity to connect with mentors and get referred       T he companies we work with typically look for people who are:      Highly proactive and willing to learn  Excellent communicators (written or verbally)  Happy working in a fast-paced environment  Natural relationship-builders  Motivated and driven to achieve outcomes

title: Client Servicing Team Lead
description: About the Opportunity   Clearwater Analytics is growing, and we want you to be part of it! This is an exciting opportunity to lead from the front, at the intersection of people leadership and client delivery. description: Note: The listed salary range is based on the salary range for the Netherlands. Salary ranges may vary by location.  Our Team Lead for Customer Onboarding is responsible for ensuring a world-class onboarding experience for our customers across all products and segments. This is a new role with the focus of centralising our regional Customer Onboarding operations and implementing global onboarding processes, metrics, digital journeys and internal workflows to increase customer satisfaction, efficiency, and time to value. Collaboration: You’ll be part of the CS Leadership team, collaborating closely with them on departmental topics, and will also collaborate on a daily basis with partners in Sales, Support and Product to share guidance, manage requests, plan Onboarding capacity, and support with enablement. Our services are specifically designed to improve not only the school process but also community culture and student learning outcomes.  Compass is a product that genuinely provides students, teachers, and parents with an improved educational experience. DeleteMe is the leader in proactive privacy protection. We help security teams reduce their human attack surface by continuously monitoring and removing exposed personal data (PII) from the open web — the very data threat actors use to launch social engineering, phishing, Gen-AI deepfake, doxxing campaigns, physical threats, and identity fraud.

Operating as a fast-paced, global SaaS company, DeleteMe serves both consumers and enterprises. title: Sektionschef Kund och kommunikation
description: Hos oss är du med och driver utveckling av både verksamhet och ledarskap för att skapa värde för Skatteverkets kunder. Du har en avgörande roll i vår förändringsresa. Upptäck ett mångsidigt uppdrag!   Om jobbet   Som chef och ledare på Skatteverket ser du till helheten, skapar förutsättningar och agerar medvetet i vardagen. Tillsammans med andra arbetar du för att skapa värde med fokus på kunden, med grund i vårt samhällsbärande uppdrag. I ditt ledarskap möjliggör du utveckling och lärande genom att ge mandat och skapa stort handlingsutrymme; du förstärker och följer upp de beteenden och den kultur som behövs för att vi tillsammans ska kunna genomföra vårt uppdrag. Du förväntas agera och leda även om svaren inte är givna, vägvalen inte tydliga och arbetssätten inte självklara. Med mod och insikt utmanar du våra invanda tankesätt och arbetssätt och är själv öppen för att låta dig utmanas.  Du är chef för sektion 1 på enhet för kundstrategi och riskanalys på kund- och kommunikationsavdelningen. Du har personalansvar för 18 medarbetare, ingår i enhetens ledningsgrupp och rapporterar till enhetschefen. På enheten arbetar vi väldigt integrerat. Enheten ansvarar för att på övergripande nivå styra utvecklingen av kundmötet samt följa upp att det sker i linje med Skatteverkets strategi och målbild. Enheten ska säkra enhetligheten i det som är gemensamt för Skatteverket och ta fram ramar, riktlinjer och övergripande mål- och behovsbild för det direkta, indirekta och samverkande kundmötet.  Enheten ansvarar även för att analysera externa efterlevnadsrisker och tillsammans med övergripande kundbehov ta fram en samlad kunskapsbild som underlag för prioritering och beslut om vägval och åtgärder i de operativa avdelningarna.  Strategiska bemötande- och tonalitetsfrågor ingår också i enhetens ansvarsområde, liksom övergripande samordning av extern samverkan.  Din placeringsort blir Sundbyberg, Uppsala, Örebro eller Linköping.  Enhetsledningen håller sina ledningsmöten i Sundbyberg och vi ser gärna att du kan delta på dessa på plats.  Vår verksamhet är i ständig utveckling och förändring. Vi har en gemensam syn på hur ledarskapet bidrar till det, hur vi når resultat och främjar en förändringskultur. Som chef och ledare hos oss är du med och driver utveckling av både verksamhet och ledarskap.   Om dig   För att göra ett bra jobb och trivas hos oss på Skatteverket behöver du vara lyhörd, tänka nytt och ta ansvar. I arbetet är gott omdöme och förståelse för rättssäkerhet och säkerhet viktigt. Du ska också leva upp till vår medarbetarpolicy. title: Service Manager
description: Do you want to lead and develop a technical service function that plays a central role in customer satisfaction and long-term customer value?  Nel Hydrogen is looking for an experienced and collaborative Service Manager to lead our technical support and service team. In this role, you will oversee technical customer support, aftermarket activities, service deliveries, and the continuous improvement of service processes.  This is a great opportunity for a hands-on service leader who enjoys developing people, solving complex customer issues, and working across engineering, production, and sales to deliver professional and efficient support. If this resonates with you, this could be an exciting opportunity to help strengthen a customer-oriented service culture and contribute to growth within aftermarket and service.    Your New Role   Reporting to the Site Support Director, you will have overall responsibility for the company's technical support and service function. You will lead the technical support and service team, ensure the right competence and capacity, and establish clear goals, KPIs, and development plans.  You will be responsible for high-quality technical support and service agreements, while contributing to aftermarket development, spare parts-related processes, and coordination with field service activities. Working closely with customers, partners, engineering, production, and sales, you will coordinate complex cases, handle escalations, and contribute to develop service concepts that increase customer value and profitability.  The role is well suited for a clear and motivating leader who combines strong technical understanding with a customer-focused, structured, and continuous-improvement mindset.   Your Responsibilities   In this role, you will:    Lead, support, and develop the technical support and service team.  Ensure professional and efficient handling of technical customer inquiries.  Prioritize and coordinate complex technical cases and escalations.  Ensure high quality in service agreements and contribute to spare parts-related processes and coordination with field service activities.  Develop and improve service concepts that increase customer value and profitability.  Standardize service processes and working methods, and drive continuous improvement.  Monitor key performance measures, including response time, resolution rate, and customer satisfaction.  Ensure effective use of CRM, service, and support systems.  Identify new business opportunities within aftermarket and service.      What We Are Looking For   We are looking for a customer-oriented and solution-focused leader with strong technical understanding and experience from technical support, service, or aftermarket operations. You should enjoy developing people, improving processes, and working across functions to deliver strong customer outcomes.  You'll bring:    Relevant higher education in a technical field, engineering, or equivalent experience.

title: Call Center Manager
description: Job Purpose:   To provide overall leadership and strategic direction for all call center operations, ensuring the highest standards of customer service for all sectors (Individuals, Business, and Internal Staff), while enhancing operational efficiency across all communication channels.   Key Responsibilities:     Operational Leadership & Management:   Fully lead and manage daily call center operations across all engagement channels (Inbound/Outbound Calls, Email, SMS, and Interactive Messaging).  Provide comprehensive oversight covering all service streams (Individuals, Business, and Internal Employees).  Develop operational plans and strategies to ensure prompt resolution of inquiries and complaints.   Performance & Team Management:   Monitor and evaluate the performance of call center teams and agents, providing guidance and coaching to elevate service standards.  Ensure strict adherence to quality assurance standards and customer service best practices.  Optimize workforce planning and shift scheduling to ensure seamless coverage.   Reporting & Analytics:   Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) such as response times, average handle times, and customer satisfaction levels, presenting regular insights to senior management.  Analyze data trends to identify operational bottlenecks and implement long-term solutions.    Requirements & Qualifications:     Experience:  Minimum of  10 years  of experience in call center operations and customer service management.   Skills & Competencies:   Demonstrated ability to lead and manage multi-channel contact center operations (Calls, Email, SMS, Interactive Messaging).  Strong leadership and management capability across diverse customer domains (Individuals, Business, Employees).  Exceptional communication, problem-solving, and crisis management skills.  Proficiency in modern call center software and CRM systems.

title: Manager Call Center
description: En Ona Hotels & Apartments estamos en constante crecimiento, por ello, buscamos un/a   Manager   para unirse a nuestro departamento de   Call Center en las Oficinas Centrales de Barcelona.      🧭 Tu misión:   Liderar el desarrollo y evolución de nuestro  Ona Vacation Club , coordinando las áreas operativa, comercial y analítica para maximizar el valor de nuestra cartera de socios, impulsar la fidelización y garantizar el cumplimiento de los objetivos de negocio. Impulsar el cobro y la fidelización:  analizar cuotas, morosidad y comportamiento de los socios, desarrollando acciones para mejorar la recaudación y reducir la desvinculación.   Conocer al socio:  utilizar datos, CRM y herramientas de reporting para segmentar la cartera, identificar oportunidades y detectar perfiles de alto valor o riesgo. Liderar y coordinar equipos:  alinear a los responsables funcionales, facilitando la colaboración entre las áreas operativa, tecnológica, comercial y analítica.   Trabajar de forma transversal:  actuar como interlocutor entre el Club, Marketing, Finanzas, Revenue, Sistemas y Dirección, impulsando proyectos de transformación y mejora continua.       ¿Qué necesitamos de ti?        Formación:  Grado en ADE, Marketing, Economía, Turismo o similar. Se valorará formación especializada en CRM, analítica, BI, dirección comercial o fidelización.   Experiencia:  5-10 años en negocio, CRM, fidelización, marketing relacional, customer experience o gestión de clientes, con experiencia coordinando equipos o proyectos transversales. Se valorará experiencia en modelos de suscripción, membership, fidelización, turismo, hospitality, retail o ecommerce. Dominio de Excel y valorable experiencia con Power BI u otras herramientas de reporting.   Idiomas:  Inglés profesional. Se valorarán otros idiomas.   Otros:  Disponibilidad para viajar puntualmente y capacidad para trabajar con datos e información confidencial.   Soft Skills:  Persona proactiva, resolutiva, analítica, orientada a resultados y con capacidad para trabajar de forma transversal.       ✨ ¿Qué podemos ofrecerte?      🤝 Contratación Indefinida.  📍Ubicación: Oficinas en el centro de Barcelona (Modalidad 100% presencial).  💰Salario: Entre 35.000€ y 38.000€ brutos anuales, según la valía y experiencia que aportes al perfil.  ⏱️ Flexibilidad Hora

title: Account Manager (m/f/d)
description: Job Description   As an  Account Manager (AM)  within Emerson's  Test & Measurement (T&M)  Business Unit (formerly NI), you will join a high-performance sales organization that represents a trusted, industry-leading brand known for innovative products, robust platform solutions, and exceptional technical depth.  This role focuses on  customer ownership  supporting customers across  multiple business units like Transportation, Aero Space and Defence, Semiconductor and Portfolio . You will drive growth, shape customer relationships, and work across a cross-functional team to execute account plans that expand Emerson’s footprint in key customers.  You will collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, distribution and integration partners, and business unit leaders and act as a key contributor to Emerson T&M’s go-to-market strategy. Your leadership, strategic mindset, high execution drive and relationship-building skills will influence not only customer outcomes but also internal alignment across EMEA.  This role is an excellent opportunity to accelerate your professional development, expand your leadership reach, and directly impact the growth trajectory of Emerson T&M.   In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:   Drive Customer Growth & Strategic Execution     Develop and execute creative, high-impact account strategies and plans that consistently generate strong (double-digit) growth.    Identify and articulate Emerson T&M’s differentiated value to influence technical and business decision‑makers at multiple levels.    Lead customer engagements through platform discussions, strategic consulting, and technical conversations on innovative test technologies.     Own Customer Relationships     Build, deepen, and maintain trusted senior-level relationships across accounts.    Align executives between Emerson T&M and customer organizations, ensuring open communication and long-term strategic alignment.    Orchestrate internal and external stakeholders to deliver cohesive, value-driven outcomes.     Lead Account Team Collaboration     Drive a coordinated, company-wide strategy through collaboration with:    Engineering & Technical Consultants    Business Development Managers    Marketing teams    Partners and Channel Ecosystem     Coach and influence cross-functional teams, celebrating shared wins and developing team capabilities.     Partner & Ecosystem Engagement     Work proactively with Emerson’s Portfolio Business Unit to expand broad‑based opportunities    Engage partners to drive additional value, enable scaling, and ensure sustained customer success.      Who You Are:      You establish and maintain effective customer relationships.    You build strong formal and informal networks.    You attentively listen to others.    You persist in accomplishing objectives despite obstacles and setbacks.      For This Role, You Will Need:      Bachelor’s degree preferred in Electrical, Mechanical, Computer Engine

title: Key Account Manager | Mecenat
description: Flera av världens starkaste varumärken använder Mecenat som samarbetspartner för att erbjuda rabatter till våra medlemmar. Vi är en direkt försäljningskanal som kommunicerar till över 2,4 miljoner medlemmar i Sverige - fördelat på 1 miljon studenter, 1,2 miljoner alumner och 250 000 seniorer. Vi hjälper våra partners att driva försäljning, bygga varumärkeskännedom och skapa engagemang genom relevanta kommunikationsvägar.     Idag samarbetar vi med en mängd välkända varumärken inom olika branscher - däribland Lidl, Comviq, Apple, Google, ICA, Zalando, TV4, Adidas och Bokus. Läs mer på www.mecenat.com eller partner.mecenat.com för att se hur vi arbetar med våra partners.      Vi söker nu en affärsdriven Key Account Manager till vårt team på Lindholmen. Läs mer och ansök nedan.        Om rollen   I rollen kommer du att vara Mecenats ansikte utåt och arbeta med både etablerade B2B-kunder och nykundsbearbetning. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med större kundkonton och komplexa kundrelationer. Du ansvarar för inkommande förfrågningar samt för försäljnings- och kundutveckling, med målet att skapa långsiktiga, lönsamma och hållbara samarbeten.     Du har ett starkt affärsdriv och strävar kontinuerligt efter att utveckla kunden genom att proaktivt supporta och stötta utifrån deras behov. Rollen ger dig möjlighet att arbeta mot en ung och attraktiv målgrupp samt tillsammans med partners som har starka och välkända varumärken.  Tjänsten innebär 1–2 resor per månad, främst till Stockholm. Du blir en del av ett engagerat och resultatinriktat försäljningsteam bestående av 12 säljare och rapporterar direkt till Sales Team Lead. Du utgår ifrån vårt kontor på Lindholmen, Göteborg.       Vem söker vi?   Vi söker dig som är en driven och kreativ B2B-säljare med stark relationsbyggande förmåga och ett analytiskt affärstänk. Du har flera års erfarenhet av försäljning och affärsutveckling inom B2B, där kundfokus alltid är centralt i ditt arbete.     Som person har du en positiv framåtanda och trivs både med att utveckla befintliga kundrelationer och att identifiera och etablera nya kundsamarbeten. Du är förtroendeingivande, engagerad och trygg i din roll, vilket gör att kunder upplever dig som en långsiktig och pålitlig partner.     Du är självgående och affärsdriven samt motiveras av att driva affärer hela vägen i mål. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med digitala lösningar, e‑handel, mediebyråer eller affiliate-marknadsföring.      Eftergymnasial utbildning inom försäljning, ekonomi, marknadsföring eller motsvarande är meriterande. Du kommunicerar obehindrat i tal och skrift på både svenska och engelska samt har god systemvana, framför allt inom Officepaketet och affärssystem generellt.      Vad kan Mecenat erbjuda dig?   Hos oss får du en nyckelroll i ett växande bolag med ett starkt erbjudande och möjlighet att arbeta med välkända varumärken som vill nå en ung och attraktiv målgrupp. Vår kultur präglas av delaktighet, transpare

description: Localisation : Lyon, France    Rémunération : 50-75 k€ + BSPCE (Stock Options)       À propos de nous   Chez Wavo, nous construisons le futur du financement de stocks. Pour les PME, le stock est à la fois une opportunité et une contrainte. Il immobilise de la trésorerie, freine la croissance et crée du risque. Les solutions de financement traditionnelles sont lentes, rigides et basées sur l’historique financier plutôt que sur le potentiel business en temps réel.  Nous adoptons une approche différente. Wavo achète et finance les stocks en amont, sans dette ni garantie personnelle. Les entreprises peuvent ainsi accélérer leur croissance, améliorer leur trésorerie et se concentrer sur leur développement, sans friction financière.  Nous avons levé 3,5M€ pour accélérer notre expansion et déployer notre modèle auprès de plus d’entreprises. Nous sommes soutenus par des investisseurs et des leaders du secteur qui nous donnent les moyens d’aller vite. Notre objectif est clair : devenir la référence du financement de stocks intégré en Europe.  Dans ce contexte, nous recrutons un Strategic Account Manager, pour accompagner nos clients de bout en bout et jouer un rôle central dans l’exécution et la qualité de notre modèle.      Ce que tu feras   En tant que Strategic Account Manager chez Wavo, tu prendras en charge la relation client dans la durée, depuis les premiers échanges jusqu’au suivi des financements dans le temps. Il s’agit d’un rôle central, au croisement du commercial, de l’analyse et de l’opérationnel.     Tu interviendras en amont sur la qualification des prospects, principalement issus de l’inbound. À travers des échanges structurés, tu chercheras à comprendre le business des entreprises, la nature de leurs produits, leur modèle économique et leur capacité à s’inscrire dans notre solution. Ton rôle sera d’évaluer si Wavo est pertinent pour eux, et dans quelles conditions.     Lorsque le dossier avance, tu travailleras sur l’analyse des données mises à disposition par le prospect afin de définir un périmètre finançable cohérent. Cela implique de comprendre la typologie des produits, leur rotation, leur valorisation et leur liquidité, afin de proposer un financement adapté et maîtrisé. Ce volet analytique est central dans le poste : il conditionne la qualité des décisions et la performance du modèle dans la durée.     Tu piloteras ensuite toute la phase d’onboarding et de contractualisation, en lien avec les équipes internes, jusqu’à la mise en place effective du financement. Une fois le financement activé, tu assureras un suivi régulier des clients : monitoring des ventes, ajustements éventuels du périmètre financé, anticipation des prochaines étapes et identification d’opportunités de refinancement.     Au quotidien, tu seras en contact avec des entreprises très différentes, issues de secteurs variés, avec des business models et des contraintes propres. title: Strategic Account Manager
description: About PLM Group   PLM Group is the largest Dassault Systemes Solidworks reseller in the Nordics and Baltics.  We have been a value adding partner and reseller of Dassault Systèmes SolidWorks for over 25 years.     We are a company in constant development, to continue offering the best technology and expertise in Software and 3D Printing. Our main goal is to make our customers innovate, to help them get the best success opportunities with their SolidWorks and Dassault products and 3D Printing.     We are more than 180 employees in Nordics and the Baltics. Our organization structure provides efficient communication and knowledge sharing between colleagues all over PLM Group and enables the individual employee to both create and improve their own work environment and career in PLM Group. PLM Group Norway consist of 25 colleagues, located in our different norwegian offices; Lillestrøm and Skien.     PLM Group is a part of Pronect, a group of independent companies with over 7000 industrial customers. Pronect has its headquarter in Värnamo, Sweden, and have offices in seven countries in the Nordics and Baltics. Pronect is a part of the family owned Liljedahl Group.      About the role   This is a full-time on-site role located in either of our Norwegian offices for a Strategic Account Manager.     As a Strategic Account Manager, you are responsible for managing and growing key client accounts, developing and executing strategic account plans, and driving customer satisfaction and retention. Daily tasks include identifying client needs, providing tailored solutions, negotiating contracts, and collaborating with internal teams to ensure client success and achieve business objectives.      About you    Strong skills in business development and strategic planning       Proven experience with client relationship management and sales presentations       We expect you to be passionate about value-added selling and keen on learning and exploring new technology and software.       You have experience in selling software and/or value-added service. Experience in selling SaaS (Software as a service) is an advantage.       You have a proven track record of successful sales project management       You need to speak Norwegian fluently and have good english skills, as the corporate language is English in PLM Group.       You have experience in outbound sales roles       You are customer- oriented and have a good business understanding. As you will be leading your own sales projects and be the main customer contact, it´s important that you are structured and used to problem solving with the customer needs in focus.       You are a team player, sharing your ideas and help to develop the team and by doing so, contributing making PLM Group a great place to work       Apply for the role, we would love to hear from you!    In this recruitment, PLM Group is cooperating with our recruitment partner: Connect Talents      Do not hesitate to send your application via Linke

title: Account Manager - Tredit Credit Insurance
description: En Coface, cada día, nuestros equipos facilitan las transacciones comerciales.  Nuestros 5.200 expertos, con más 80 nacionalidades y presentes en 58 países, trabajan juntos por un objetivo común: facilitar el comercio en todo el mundo, ayudando a las empresas a tomar las mejores decisiones y a desarrollarse de forma más inteligente.  Con casi 80 años de experiencia internacional, ofrecemos a las empresas una gama completa de soluciones: Seguro de Crédito, Información Comercial y Recobro de deudas, todo ello impulsado por una base de datos única, tecnología de vanguardia, innovación y un profundo conocimiento de la economía global.  Unirse a Coface significa formar parte de una organización internacional muy unida, donde tus ideas importan. Fomentamos una cultura de aprendizaje, colaboración e inclusión en la que asumirás responsabilidades y podrás ver el impacto de tus acciones.  Da forma al futuro del comercio internacional con nosotros. ¡Únete a nuestros Happeners!   Descripción del empleo   ¿Te apasiona construir relaciones sólidas con clientes y ayudarles a alcanzar sus objetivos?  ¿Tienes experiencia B2B en el sector financiero y buscas un nuevo reto profesional?  ¡Esta puede ser tu oportunidad!  Como  Account Manager , serás responsable de gestionar una cartera de clientes, asegurando su satisfacción, fidelización y crecimiento.  Tus principales funciones incluirán:    Implementar la estrategia y los estándares de gestión de las relaciones con clientes según las directrices del grupo, teniendo en cuenta las especificidades locales, y proponiendo las adaptaciones más adecuadas a la necesidad de incrementar eficiencia, flexibilidad y equilibrar el nivel de servicio a la rentabilidad esperada por cliente.   Velar porque los requerimientos de los clientes sean atendidos oportunamente, negociando y definiendo alternativas de solución, en equilibrio con los recursos a proporcionar según el segmento al que pertenecen.   Realizar los actos de atención diaria a los clientes: explicaciones de decisiones de riesgos, aclaraciones respecto a la facturación, funcionamiento del contrato en general, y mantenimiento del mismo.   Llevar a cabo diversas acciones de seguimiento de los contratos.   Controlar la implementación, información y correcta ejecución de la estrategia y estándares definidos por el Customer Journey.   Revisar periódicamente los expedientes de cada cliente según el calendario de mantenimiento.   Realizar el control y seguimiento de los informes correspondientes en el CRM.   Preparar y negociar las renovaciones de contratos.      Requisitos     Formación: preferentemente Administración de Empresas – Económicas o similar.   Experiencia mínima de 4 años en gestión de clientes, desarrollo de negocio o Account Management en entornos B2B. Se valorará especialmente la experiencia en el sector del seguro de crédito y en posiciones relacionadas con la gestión del riesgo comercial.   Orientación al cliente: Te motiva ofrecer un servicio

Angebotsentwicklung: Du stellst die kunden- und marktorientierte Angebotsentwicklung im P&C-Privatkundensegment sicher.  Projektlead: Du übernimmst den Lead in Projekten und Arbeitsgruppen zu Angeboten, Kundenprozessen und Marktbearbeitung.     Das bringst du mit     Ausbildung: Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Fach- oder Hochschulstudium in BWL, VWL, Marketing, Natur- oder Sozialwissenschaften.  Erfahrung: Du bringst mehrjährige Berufs- und Führungserfahrung mit und hast damit ein möglichst breites Verständnis in mehreren der folgenden Bereiche:   P&C-Privatkunden-Geschäft (Produkte, Systeme, Prozesse)  Marktbearbeitungsinstrumente und -kanäle  Customer Centric Design (in Angebots-, Service- oder Prozessentwicklung)  Sales Funnel / Vertrieb (AD- und Online-Verständnis)  Unternehmergeist: Du hast einen hohen unternehmerischen Drive, eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität und übernimmst Verantwortung über deinen eigenen Bereich hinaus. Ci prendiamo cura del benessere di collaboratori e ospiti, creando spazi in cui ognuno possa esprimersi, crescere e sentirsi valorizzato. A guidarci sono valori concreti: passione, creatività, cura, coraggio e responsabilità. Valori che orientano le nostre scelte e rendono ogni progetto vivo, condiviso e capace di generare valore. Develop strong relationships with clients, stakeholders, and supply chain partners.  Ensure compliance with QHSE requirements and applicable Qatar standards. QCDD certification preferred.  Grade A classification by Kahramaa / competent authority preferred.

title: HEAD OF CUSTOMER SUCCESS
description: À propos   L'ambition.  Fabriq fait rayonner l'industrie européenne en rendant l'usine plus compétitive et l'ouvrier plus autonome. Au-delà du logiciel, l'entreprise construit le projet de société de la relocalisation industrielle.   L'activité.  Fabriq est l'Operating System des ateliers de production. Sa plateforme SaaS digitalise les rituels de Lean Daily Management (AIC, SQCDP, QRQC, Hoshin Kanri, Gemba) pour résoudre les problèmes terrain 3 fois plus vite que le papier ou Excel. Devenu le leader européen de la digitalisation du Lean, Fabriq construit aujourd'hui la couche agentique de cette discipline.   Les preuves.     26 M€ levés au total, dont 22 M€ en juin 2025 menés par Expedition Capital.  Plus de 1000 sites équipés dans 60 pays, pour des leaders comme Safran, Airbus, Renault et LVMH.  Une équipe de 110 personnes qui joue collectif.    Descriptif du poste   Contexte :  Tu rejoins Thibaud (VP Customer) pour prendre la tête d'une équipe CS d'une dizaine de personnes, sur un portefeuille qui bascule du mid-market vers l'enterprise multi-sites et international.   L'Objectif :  Sécuriser le GRR (Gross Revenue Retention) et maintenir le churn sous 5 % sur le portefeuille enterprise, tout en industrialisant le CS.   Les Enjeux     Industrialiser le CS enterprise : Construire et déployer les playbooks d'adoption et de rétention, les cadences QBR, le health scoring et le capacity planning, en semaines et non en quarters.  Hisser les grands comptes au standard enterprise : Installer une discipline solide sur des clients multi-sites et internationaux, où la relation ne peut plus reposer sur un seul sponsor.  Faire progresser l'équipe : Amener le collectif vers le standard enterprise et faire grandir chaque CS, en coachant par l'exemple sur 1-2 comptes stratégiques.  Créer les conditions d'expansion : Démontrer la valeur au niveau ComEx et détecter les signaux d'upsell, en relais avec l'équipe AM.    Profil recherché   Les OBLIGATOIRES     Expérience : 6 à 10 ans en CS B2B SaaS, dont au moins 3 ans de management d'équipe CS.  Enterprise : 3 à 5 ans d'exposition à des comptes enterprise multi-sites dans un contexte de land & expand.  Track-record : Réduction de churn ou amélioration de GRR démontrée, chiffres à l'appui.  Structuration : A construit des playbooks d'adoption et de rétention from scratch, pas hérités.  Posture : Attrait fort pour la mission et le monde industriel. Envie d’aller se confronter au terrain, pas peur de se déplacer.  Langues : Français et anglais courants.     Les "PLUS" (optionnels) :     Usage avancé de l'IA dans les workflows CS.  Passage en scale-up en forte croissance ayant vécu une phase de structuration.  Appétence pour l'expansion et l'upsell.    Process de recrutement    Un premier échange avec Edouard, Talent Acquisition.  Un entretien avec Thibaud, VP Customer.  Un business case à traiter avec François, Co-founder et Thibaud.  Une étape culturelle et de fit avec François et Victoria (VP People).

title: Servicechef – Brandlarm och säkerhet
description: Consilium Safety Group är en global ledare inom brand- och gassäkerhetsteknologi med över 100 års erfarenhet. Våra innovativa lösningar skyddar liv, tillgångar och miljö inom marin-, energi-, fastighets- och New Energy-sektorerna. Med huvudkontor i Göteborg och över 55 kontor världen över utvecklar vi morgondagens Safety-Tech genom innovation, kvalitet och teknisk expertis.  Consilium Safety Sweden är koncernens marknads- och försäljningsbolag och erbjuder avancerade brand- och säkerhetssystem – från enskilda komponenter till kompletta integrerade säkerhetslösningar. Vi ansvarar för hela kedjan; projektering, försäljning, installation, driftsättning, service och underhåll. Våra system skyddar människor och verksamheter i allt från skolor och vårdinrättningar till industrier, kontor och andra samhällsviktiga fastigheter.   Vill du leda och utveckla en serviceorganisation där teknik, kundrelationer och engagerade medarbetare står i centrum?   Vi söker nu en  Servicechef till vår verksamhet i Malmö.  Du får en central roll i att leda och utveckla vår serviceavdelning, som består av cirka 20 medarbetare.  Vi är ett företag som utvecklar och säljer lösningar inom brandlarm och säkerhet, och vår serviceverksamhet är en viktig del av vårt erbjudande. Nu söker vi dig som vill ta ett helhetsansvar för verksamheten och samtidigt vara en närvarande och engagerad ledare för våra medarbetare.   Om rollen   Som Servicechef har du det övergripande ansvaret för vår serviceavdelning och dess fortsatta utveckling. Du arbetar både strategiskt och operativt och blir en viktig länk mellan våra kunder, tekniker och företagets övriga organisation.   Ditt Ansvar Omfattar Bland Annat     Personalansvar för cirka 20 medarbetare.  Ansvar för avdelningens ekonomi, budget och resultat.  Planering och uppföljning av serviceverksamheten.  Kundansvar och utveckling av långsiktiga kundrelationer.  Säkerställa hög kvalitet och god service i våra uppdrag.  Arbetsmiljöansvar och ett aktivt arbete för en säker och trivsam arbetsplats.  Leda, coacha och utveckla medarbetarna i deras dagliga arbete.  Utveckla arbetssätt och rutiner för en effektiv och lönsam serviceorganisation.  Uppföljning av serviceprojekt, serviceavtal, arbetstider och resursplanering.  Samverkan med andra delar av organisationen för att skapa en bra helhet för våra kunder.    Du kommer att ha ett nära samarbete med både ledning, kunder och våra tekniker. Rollen innebär därför många kontaktytor och kräver att du trivs med att växla mellan strategiska frågor och den dagliga verksamheten.   Vem söker vi?   Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av serviceledning, gärna från brandlarm, säkerhet, el, installation, fastighetsteknik eller annan teknisk verksamhet.  Du behöver inte kunna allt från början. Det viktigaste är att du har teknisk förståelse, ledarerfarenhet och ett genuint intresse för att utveckla både människor och verksamhet.   Vi Ser Gärna Att Du Har     Erfarenhet av personal- och verksamhetsansvar.

description: Wer wir sind   Als führende Schweizer E-Commerce-Plattform, mit einem Team von über 4’000 Mitarbeitenden in der Schweiz, Deutschland und Serbien, sind wir auf dem Weg in neue Märkte. Bei uns findest du die Freiheit und das Vertrauen, eigenverantwortlich zu handeln, mit uns zu wachsen und dabei ganz du selbst zu sein.  Handle galaktisch. Und bleib du . zentrale Quality & Coaching für alle Customer Operations-Abteilungen und koordinierst die zentrale Definition von Standard Operating Procedures, deren Training in den operativen Bereichen und die Überwachung der Prozess-Compliance für einen konsistent exzellenten menschlichen Service  Auch das zentrale Management aller Reparatur- und Service-Center unserer Lieferanten und Partner an der Schnittstelle zwischen Aftersales und Category Management fällt in Deinen Verantwortungsbereich  Ausserdem hast Du P&L Verantwortung für Mehrwert-Dienstleistungen wie Garantie-Erweiterungen, title: Training And Quality Manager
description: Role Description   This is a full-time, on-site Training and Quality Manager role based at Wooden Coffee in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.  The role is responsible for designing, delivering, and continuously updating training programs for baristas, supervisors, and support staff, while ensuring consistent service standards and product quality across all locations.  Day-to-day responsibilities include assessing training needs, developing training materials and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), leading workshops and on-the-job coaching, and monitoring employee performance against defined quality standards and KPIs.  The Training and Quality Manager will conduct regular store audits, review customer feedback, and collaborate with Operations leadership to implement process improvements and corrective actions.  The role will also be responsible for maintaining training records, preparing reports on training effectiveness and quality trends, and supporting new store openings and onboarding initiatives to ensure teams are aligned with Wooden Coffee’s brand standards, safety requirements, and hygiene practices.         Qualifications    Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, Education, or a related field is preferred.  Minimum of 3 years of experience in the Food & Beverage (F&B) sector, preferably within the coffee or café industry.  Experience in developing, delivering, and evaluating training programs, ideally within hospitality, retail, or food and beverage environments.  Strong background in quality assurance, including developing standards, conducting audits, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives.  Proficient in preparing training content, manuals, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), with the ability to facilitate workshops and coach team members at different levels.  Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to motivate employees, provide constructive feedback, and build strong cross-functional relationships.  Strong organizational and time-management skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple training and quality projects simultaneously.  Familiarity with health, safety, food hygiene, and operational standards relevant to coffee shops and food service operations.  Ability to analyze performance data and customer feedback to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for improvement, and recommend practical, data-informed solutions.  Ability to work on-site in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with flexibility to visit different branches and support new store openings as needed.  Prior experience in a supervisory or managerial role within a coffee shop, café, or restaurant environment is highly beneficial.  Relevant professional certifications in training, quality management, or related fields are considered an advantage.

Rust Engineer

Location: Remote or Berlin (Office available)

At Deepslate, we are building Speech to Speech Voice AI models that sound and act indistinguishably from a human. And we believe everyone should be able to use them.

With its endless languages, dialects, accents, subtle intonations, and speech melodies, voice remains a highly complex unsolved frontier.

That is exactly why we started Deepslate.

Backed by top-tier investors from the Tech and AI sectors, as well as a major German VC fund, we are incredibly well-funded and moving fast.

We are building the future of communication.

We aren't trying to build another standalone platform; instead, we are the intelligence engine powering countless other applications. Whether it's integrated as a module by a CRM provider, plugged into another Voice AI platform, or directly embedded into an enterprise system by our integration partners, our model is built to work wherever it is needed.

Your Role

Many core parts of our model stack are written in Rust. At the heart of it is our inference engine, written entirely in Rust.

Your mission is to build and improve these systems. You will work on the inference engine, take ownership of other Rust projects, and help decide how everything fits together. We need someone who enjoys writing good Rust code and can design software that stays understandable and maintainable as it grows.

Our models need to respond in real time. The software you build will directly influence how fast and reliable they are in an actual conversation.

What You'll Do

title: Fullstack Software Engineer (m/w/d)

Wer wir sind

  

RNA Digital Solutions wurde 2016 als Industrial Tech Startup gegründet. Unsere Expertise liegt im Digitalen Maschinenbau und wir beschäftigen uns insbesondere mit der digitalen Auslegung und Herstellung automatisierter Zuführlösungen. In 2021 erfolgte der Anschluss des Startups an den Weltmarktführer in der Zuführtechnik, der Rhein-Nadel-Automation GmbH. Unser Fokus liegt zu 100% auf der Softwareentwicklung. Unsere Software-Teams verteilen sich auf die Standorte München und Aachen. In München entwickeln wir unsere Dienste für Künstliche Intelligenz und Simulation. In Aachen nutzen wir die Nähe zum Shop Floor für Sonder-Digitalisierungsprojekte und Shop Floor-bezogene Software. 

Die Kombination von jahrzehntelanger Erfahrung im Bereich Zuführtechnik gepaart mit modernsten Technologien im Bereich der künstlichen Intelligenz ermöglicht es uns, die Zuführtechnik von Morgen zu entwickeln. 

Zur Verstärkung unseres Entwicklungsteams suchen wir einen erfahrenen Fullstack Software Engineer (m/w/d) mit Sitz im Raum München. Die Arbeit erfolgt größtenteils mobil, jedoch ist eine regelmäßige Anwesenheit im Office in München vorgesehen (ca. 1 Mal pro Woche).

  • Entwicklung: Du treibst zusammen mit dem Team den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung interner Apps zur Prozessdigitalisierung und -automatisierung voran. Die containerbasierte Architektur umfasst auch KI-/ML-Module sowie automatisierte Physik-Simulationen.
  • Aufgabenspektrum: Du wirkst von der Anforderungsaufnahme über die Implementierung bis zur Auslieferung mit.
  • Schnittstellen: Du arbeitest in einem dynamischen Umfeld und stehst im engen Kontakt mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen, um Nutzeranforderungen zu verstehen und umzusetzen.

The Role

Black Semiconductor is seeking a hands-on and flexible Equipment & Process Development Technician to support the installation, qualification, operation, maintenance, process development, and ramp-up of our FabONE semiconductor manufacturing facility.

You will work across CMP, wet cleaning, plating, and Graphene processes and equipment, supporting both R&D and manufacturing activities.

This is a flexible, multi-functional role where responsibilities will adapt to business priorities and FabONE needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support equipment installation, commissioning, qualification, startup, operation, and maintenance.

  • Perform preventive/corrective maintenance, calibration, troubleshooting, and equipment recovery.

  • Act as a first responder for equipment alarms, abnormal conditions, and OOC events.

  • Monitor tool health, equipment performance, and process conditions to maintain high uptime and reliability.

  • Support CMP, wet cleaning, plating, Graphene and Chemical supply systems.

  • Manage critical consumables such as CMP pads, diamond disks, filters, PVA brushes, plating consumables, and chemicals.

  • Support process development, engineering experiments, process qualification, characterization, and optimization.

description:
About Kestra

Kestra is the universal orchestration platform: open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems.

Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide, including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole, Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars, hundreds of contributors, and a fast-growing global community.

About the role

Kestra runs arbitrary, user-defined code at scale. Our users write workflows that execute scripts, containers, and queries against their own production systems, through hundreds of community-built plugins, on a platform whose entire source code is public. That is an unusually rich attack surface, and securing it is a genuinely hard engineering problem rather than a checklist exercise.
You would be our first dedicated security hire. We're looking for a Senior Security Engineer to own and elevate the end-to-end security posture of our platform, infrastructure, and open-source ecosystem.
This is a unique, hybrid role for someone who excels at both sides of security: actively breaking systems to find vulnerabilities (hands-on penetration testing) and actively fixing them (opening PRs, patching infrastructure, and managing supply chain risks). If you want to build a world-class security foundation for a fast-growing open-source and SaaS platform, this role is for you.
This is a hands-on engineering role, not a GRC or compliance one.

What you would do

Your first six months would focus on the first three points below. The rest is where the role grows.

title: Customer Evidence Manager
description:
Role Description

Dropbox is hiring a Customer Evidence Manager to own and drive the customer-proof infrastructure that powers our managed sales motion. This is a senior individual-contributor role for a commercially minded, creatively grounded customer marketer who understands that the value of a customer story is not that it gets published — it is that it protects customer trust, gives buyers credible, accurate proof and moves a deal forward. You are the editorial authority on what good looks like, not the person writing every script: execution (writing, video, design) is delivered through agency partners you brief and direct.

Enterprise buyers do not decide on brand claims. They decide on credible proof from organizations like theirs: customer stories, ROI evidence, video testimonials, peer reviews, and competitive validation. In this role, you will produce that evidence and ensure it reaches sellers and customers at the moments it can have the greatest commercial impact.

You will own the program outcomes and operational rigor — setting the creative and editorial bar for what makes a great customer story, directing the agency partners who produce the work, and deploying that proof into active deals — and measuring evidence's impact on pipeline, win rates, and sales-cycle velocity. You will partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Campaign Enablement, and product teams to prioritize proof for the full suite of Dropbox products and solutions, including AI capabilities, multi-product platform adoption, and priority vertical workflows. You will get substantial senior Sales and Marketing leadership exposure and a direct, measurable line to revenue during a pivotal shift in how Dropbox goes to market.

Responsibilities

  • Identify advocates, coordinate outreach with account teams, manage consent and approvals, record participation preferences, and avoid customer fatigue.
  • Set the creative and editorial direction and maintain the evidence taxonomy, freshness, and discoverability of the asset library — case studies, ROI studies, video testimonials, peer/G2 reviews, customer voice, and competitive proof.
  • Manage the sales content library (Highspot, Deeto, or comparable) — organize assets by deal stage, customer profile, vertical, and product; set and enforce freshness standards; and proactively surface content gaps.
  • Run a recurring Sales–Marketing feedback session to understand seller needs, assess content performance in live deals, and prioritize new evidence.
  • Ensure the right proof reaches the right seller for the right deal stage proactively, and track evidence utilization by account executive and deal stage to close adoption gaps.
  • Partner with Marketing Operations to build campaign attribution and reporting in Salesforce, measuring evidence's influence on pipeline, win rate, and sales-cycle velocity.
  • Provide monthly reporting to Sales and Marketing

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

Our largest fleet clients are hugely important to Flock: they have more vehicles, more data and more opportunity to benefit from everything our connected proposition can offer, and we want to give them an even better experience as we grow. We’re looking for a Strategic Client Manager to become the primary face of Flock for our largest customers, owning the relationship and making sure they get the very best from us.

Nearly all of our business comes through brokers, and that remains central to how we work: you’ll sit at the heart of the client, broker and Flock relationship, working closely with our Broker Development Managers and teams across the business to deliver a brilliant joined-up service. You’ll report to our Head of Distribution, and use AI day to day to prepare for meetings, understand accounts, manage client queries and improve reporting, freeing up more time for relationships and problem-solving.
