title: AI scientist for Quantum Computing (Massy)
description:
About Quandela:

Quandela is a European deeptech company building modular, scalable and energy-efficient spin-photonic quantum computers.

We develop the full quantum computing stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic processors to control systems, software and applications. Our platforms are available through the cloud and as on-premises systems.

Our ambition is to build fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation.

The role:

We are looking for an AI Scientist to join Quandela’s AI and Quantum Machine Learning team in Massy (near Paris)

You will develop and evaluate machine-learning approaches for quantum computing, covering both:

  • AI for quantum systems, including calibration, control, decoding for quantum error correction;
  • quantum and hybrid machine learning, including rigorous comparisons with state-of-the-art classical methods, using MerLin, Quandela's framework for quantum machine learning.

You will work on research with colleagues across AI, quantum algorithms, software, product and hardware.

The Massy team is a central part of Quandela’s AI activities. This role therefore offers significant ownership and the opportunity to help shape and grow the team over time.

What You'll Do:

  • Design, implement and train machine-learning and quantum machine-learning models.
  • Develop AI methods to improve the calibration, control and performance of quantum systems.
  • Benchmark classical, quantum and hybrid methods using meaningful baselines and evaluation metrics.
  • Contribute actively to the development of the MerLin framework.
  • Contribute to publications and collaborations with academic partners, including research ecosystem.
  • Present your work internally and at scientific conferences and tech

In einer Zeit, in der viele technologiebasierte Produkte immer leistungsfähiger, zuverlässiger und gleichzeitig kostengünstiger werden, ist der Wohnungsbau in Deutschland in seinen Grundstrukturen seit Jahrzehnten nahezu unverändert geblieben. Wir setzen uns zum Ziel, dieses Paradigma grundlegend zu verändern: Durch die Entwicklung eines standardisierten, hochgradig optimierten Ansatzes wollen wir die Baukosten drastisch senken und gleichzeitig die Qualität und Verlässlichkeit des Wohnraums deutlich erhöhen. Kombiniert mit der zunehmenden Nachfrage nach bezahlbarem Wohnraum, wird dieses neue Modell den Weg für eine effizientere, nachhaltigere und sozialere Stadtentwicklung ebnen.

Unser Unternehmen basiert auf der Überzeugung, dass Schlichtheit, Kosteneffizienz und Qualität Hand in Hand gehen können.

title: Kommunikationsstrateg:in (m/w/d)
description:
Zur Verstärkung unseres strategischen Teams suchen wir eine erfahrene Kommunikationsstrategin oder einen erfahrenen Kommunikationsstrategen (m/w/d) mit Fokus auf Gesamtstrategie.

Du entwickelst Kommunikations- und Kampagnenstrategien über alle Kanäle hinweg – von der Analyse der Ausgangslage über Positionierung und Kernbotschaften bis zum Maßnahmenplan. title: Head of Finance & Data (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Zahlen sind deine Leidenschaft, und du willst die Datenbasis dahinter nicht nur nutzen, sondern selbst gestalten? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Als Head of Finance & Data (m/w/d) bist du das strategische und technische Fundament für unser weiteres Wachstum.

In dieser vielseitigen Doppelrolle verbindest du messerscharfe Zahlenkompetenz mit einem echten Gespür für Datenarchitektur und Reporting-Infrastruktur. Du baust nicht nur ein stabiles Controlling auf, sondern gestaltest parallel die technische Grundlage, auf der unser gesamtes Unternehmen datenbasierte Entscheidungen trifft. Kurz: Du hältst uns den Rücken frei und lenkst aktiv unseren Erfolgskurs mit.

  • Strukturen schaffen: Du baust belastbare Controlling-Strukturen und Reportings mit einer klaren, zukunftsorientierten Steuerungslogik auf.

  • Data-Infrastruktur gestalten: Du treibst den Aufbau unserer automatisierten Datenpipelines voran (u. a. BigQuery, angebunden an Shopify, Klaviyo und weitere Quellen) und sorgst dafür, dass Kennzahlen zuverlässig, aktuell und zentral verfügbar sind.
  • BI & Controlling verzahnen: Du entwickelst unsere Dashboards und Reporting-Tools (z. B. Looker Studio) so weiter, dass Finance-Kennzahlen und operative Daten in einem konsistenten Bild zusammenlaufen.
  • Prozesse skalieren: Du etablierst effiziente, smarte Prozesse im Finance- und Data-Bereich, die mit uns mitwachsen.
  • Sparring auf Augenhöhe: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem CEO zusammen und berätst ihn als geschätzter Sparringspartnerin in allen strategischen Finanz- und Datenfragen.


Das steckt in deiner Haut

Duties & Responsibilities    •     Client Coordination and Communication:     - Serve as the primary contact for foreign clients, establishing and maintaining professional relationships.    - Facilitate effective communication between the operations and sales departments and foreign clients.    - Act as a liaison to ensure timely and accurate exchange of information, addressing client inquiries, concerns, and requests promptly.   •     Client Onboarding and Account Management:     - Assist in the onboarding process of new foreign clients, coordinating with internal teams to ensure a smooth transition.    - Maintain accurate client records, including contact details, services provided, and any special requirements.   •     Client Support and Issue Resolution:     - Provide ongoing support to foreign clients, addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring client satisfaction.    - Troubleshoot problems or complaints, escalating complex issues to the appropriate internal departments for resolution.    - Proactively identify potential service improvements or areas where client expectations are not being met.   •     Collaboration and Coordination:     - Collaborate with the operations and sales departments to ensure seamless service delivery and client satisfaction.    - Work closely with cross-functional teams to streamline processes, resolve client issues, and enhance service quality.    - Participate in regular meetings to share client feedback, discuss challenges, and propose solutions.       Vacancy Highlight

title: Client Success Lead

Vi bygger en sikker, datadrevet og skybasert plattform som skal gjøre det enklere for helsepersonell å utøve sitt virke, forbedre pasientopplevelsen, og åpne for nye muligheter innen analyse, kunstig intelligens og automatisering. Vi er på jakt etter en strukturert og tydelig profil som trives i skjæringspunktet mellom mennesker, prosesser og leveranser. Du blir den som sørger for at brukerne våre opplever én sammenhengende IT-  tjeneste, uavhengig av hvem som leverer de enkelte komponentene.      Om rollen      Aleris opererer som service integrator med flere spesialiserte leverandører. Som IT Service Manager har du ansvaret for tjenestekvaliteten på tvers. Du følger opp SLA-er og OLA-er, koordinerer ved hendelser og eskaleringer, driver forbedringsarbeid i service management-prosessene, og sørger for at leverandørene jobber som ett lag. Du leder driftsmøter, service reviews og Change Advisory Board.     Du rapporterer til IT-sjefen og er en del av et sammensveiset team med høy kompetanse og flat struktur, der alle bidrar bredt og jobben varierer fra strategiske valg til praktisk problemløsning. Som del av teamet vil du også utøve direkte drifts- og brukerstøtte der det behøves. Arbeidssted er på Frogner i Oslo.      Dette blir din hverdag       Følge opp at IT-tjenester leveres i tråd med avtalt kvalitet, responstid og ansvarsfordeling  Koordinere hendelser, større feil og eskaleringer på tvers av leverandører  Drive forbedringsarbeid innen service management, samhandling og tjenestekvalitet  Lede og forberede driftsmøter, service reviews og governance-fora med leverandører  Sikre tydelige grenseflater, roller og ansvar mellom interne og eksterne aktører  Bygge og vedlikeholde god praksis for change-, incident- og problem management  Utarbeide rapportering til IT-ledelsen om driftstilstand, risiko, avvik og forbedringstiltak  Sikre at sikkerhet og etterlevelse ivaretas i drifts- og supportprosessene  Ved behov bistå med å besvare og følge opp interne IT-henvendelser       Vi er etter deg som har       Krav:  Erfaring med tjenestestyring, leverandøroppfølging eller service delivery. IT-avdelingen er delt i utvikling, nettverk og drift & support, og leverer tjenestene som gjester, arrangementer og ansatte er avhengige av hver eneste dag. Nå trenger vi noen som kan lede dette arbeidet og gjøre den tekniske jobben.   Om stillingen   Dette er ikke en ren IT prosjektlederrolle, og ikke en ren IT driftsrolle. Som IT Project & Application Manager hører du til IT drift & support avdelingen og eier løpet fra et definert behov, via anskaffelse/utvikling og implementering, til applikasjonen er i produksjon.  Det betyr at du sammen med systemeierne i organisasjonen utarbeider kravene, er med på å velge leverandør eller beslutning om egenutvikling, styrer prosjektet – og at du selv, eller sammen med andre ressurser i organisasjonen, setter opp systemet, konfigurerer det, bygger integrasjonene og feilsøker når noe ikke virker. Mellom prosjektene – og i periodene der ballen ligger hos leverandør eller andre avdelinger – jobber du med definerte oppgaver innen applikasjonsforvaltning, Microsoft 365, sikkerhet og overvåking sammen med resten av avdelingen. title: Software Engineer - Simulation Platform
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Shape the future of Proxima’s simulation platform: imagine and build with us

Das Produkt steht. Jetzt entscheidet sich, wie wir darüber sprechen.

title: Finance & AI Automation Intern (Remote Part-time)
description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. The category is growing rapidly because AI doesn't work on bad data. Behind the product sits a group of three companies in two currencies, and a small finance team that keeps all of it correct. We're hiring a Finance & AI Automation Intern to run core finance processes and automate the manual work out of them.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll join the Finance team that covers Soda Data NV (Belgium), Soda Data Inc. (US) and NannyML NV, the Belgian company we acquired in 2025. The work is real from week one: invoice processing, month-end reporting, payroll data preparation, expense management, and intercompany recharges across three entities, two currencies and three accounting systems.

The second half of the job is making that work disappear. Finance at Soda builds agentically: Claude and other AI tools are part of the daily workflow, not an experiment on the side. You'll learn a process, run it until you know it cold, and then automate it. Sometimes that means an AI agent on GitHub, sometimes a well-designed formula - you pick the right tool and defend the choice.

description:
About Genesis AI

Genesis AI builds the simulation platform powering the next generation of robotics and embodied AI. Our flagship product, Genesis World, is a unified multi-physics simulation engine paired with Nyx, our in-house GPU-accelerated, path-traced photorealistic renderer. Together they provide a platform for training robotics and embodied AI at scale; letting teams simulate complex physical worlds with high fidelity and speed, from a laptop to datacenter-grade GPUs, and close the gap between simulation and the real world.

About the Role

A simulator is only as useful as the content that runs inside it. Training embodied agents at scale means large volumes of assets that are simultaneously physically valid and visually convincing and that is a pipeline problem before it is an art problem.

We're hiring a Senior Engineer to build the path from raw input to sim-ready asset: geometry from a range of sources going in; clean meshes, correct collision proxies, plausible physical properties, materials that hold up under a path tracer, and reliable metadata coming out.

The bar is throughput and repeatability. An asset that needs a human pass to be usable doesn't scale, so the pipeline has to make good decisions on its own and flag the cases where it can't.

Part of that autonomy comes from agents embedded in the graph itself. Nodes can call models to produce input content, drive generation, pick parameters, interpret a mesh before deciding how to treat it, or judge whether a result is acceptable. Making that reliable is its own engineering problem: agents are non-deterministic, they fail in ways a mesh operator doesn't, and they need guardrails, structured outputs, retries and verification around them. We're looking for an IT Manager to own the day-to-day IT that keeps the company running smoothly and securely as we grow. This covers our people's devices, the office network, the tools everyone uses, and the support they rely on. title: Data Annotator
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Data Annotator within the Visual Navigation team, you work at the foundation of how our autonomous systems interpret their environment. You review large volumes of image datasets and apply precise, consistent annotations that directly feed the training and validation of our computer vision and machine learning models. You collaborate closely with our Computer Vision, Data Architecture, and Machine Learning teams to ensure the data you deliver meets the rigor required for real-world deployment.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze, label, and annotate diverse image datasets to support the training and validation of our AI models.

  • Follow detailed annotation guidelines precisely, maintaining consistency across large batches of work.

  • Review AI model outputs for accuracy and contextual relevance, flagging discrepancies against expected results.

  • Perform annotation peer-review with other members of the Annotation team to ensure consistency and quality.

title: Automated Testing Module Lead
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As Automated Testing Module Lead, you take ownership of how Harmattan validates its autonomy and flight-software stack. Today, our software is validated mostly against real hardware, a process that consumes airframes, range time, and crew while sampling only a handful of nominal trajectories. The cases we actually build for, such as degraded GNSS, sensor dropout, electronic warfare, and multi-agent situations, are rarely reached economically that way. Your mission is to establish the scenario library, execution strategy, and interface bricks to turn our existing simulation platform into a fast, reliable, and continuous validation engine.

This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership role. You inherit an active team of four engineers across Paris and Lausanne, with a target of around eight by mid-2027. Beyond leading the team, you become the technical authority on our scenario-based testing: defining what runs across SITL, HITL, and CI, holding critical technical boundaries with adjacent teams, and bridging the gap between simulation fidelity and real flight data.

What You Will Do

Du bearbeitest bei uns nicht einfach Tickets nach Schema F.

title: Channel Account Manager
description:
This is a field position. 

About the Position

The Channel Account Manager (CAM) responsibilities include working within the sales team to promote and sell network security products within a geographic territory. The CAM is responsible for supporting assigned WatchGuard partners in the assigned territory and will be responsible for active channel partners. The CAM will be responsible for quoting, training, lead generation and follow-up, event support, and the forecasting and tracking for their assigned partners. The CAM will keep up-to-date knowledge of the industry and the competitive posture of the company, as well as prepare activity and forecast reports as requested.

· Strive towards the territory quota attainment, retention, and growth/development of active partners

· Maintain regular contact with partners to ensure satisfaction and continued success

· Partner with Territory Channel Account Manager to generate new business and develop current customers through the partner network

title: STAGE - ASSISTANT(E) VISUAL DESIGN CREATION (H/F) - NOVEMBRE 2026 (6 MOIS)
description:
LA MAISON
 
Jacquemus a été fondé par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l’art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l’appartement parisien d’Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d’ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street) et Dubai.
 
Pour accompagner la forte croissance de la Maison, nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) Assistant(e) en VISUAL DESIGN CREAT

title: Cdi - Knitwear Designer - Menswear & Womenswear
description:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS

Jacquemus was founded by Simon Porte Jacquemus in 2009 in Paris, France.

Dedicated to the memory of the designer’s late mother, the brand draws inspiration from a passion for culture. The Jacquemus ready-to-wear and accessories collections for men and women reference the French way of life and universal gestures of beauty, encompassing influences from fine art photography to decorative arts, cinema, painting, and sculpture.

Throughout the years, Jacquemus has staged runway productions in unique and unexpected locations, including a Parisian swimming pool, the Musée Picasso, a lavender field in Provence, a wheat field outside Paris, a salt marsh in the Camargue, and a beach in Hawaii. More recently, the brand has embraced settings such as the canal of the Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), the Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), Casa Malaparte (La Casa) and Auguste Perret’s Parisian apartment (La Croisière).

Based in the 8th arrondissement of Paris, Jacquemus is an independent fashion house with over 300 employees. Renowned for its fast-growing digital presence and its worldwide business spread, the brand has created innovative retail experiences around the world before opening its first permanent flagship store at 58 Avenue Montaigne in Paris in 2022. Following this milestone, international boutiques have opened in New York (SoHo), London (New Bond Street), Los Angeles (Melrose Avenue) and Dubai.

YOUR ROLE 

Within the Jacquemus Knitwear Design team, you will work across both Womenswear and Menswear collections.

Working closely with the Head of Knitwear Design, you will contribute to the creative development of the collections, from initial research and concept through to fittings and final product.

title: B2B Marketing Specialist (France)

Ajax Systems is an international tech company and the largest manufacturer of security systems in Europe, with over 4.5 million end users and 330K PRO users in more than 180 countries worldwide. title: Customer Success Manager
description: Fast ansettelse  By  Buskerud,Drammen  Søknadsfrist  2026-10-04  Søk på stillingen   Customer Success Manager   Våre kunder investerer betydelige ressurser i teknologi og digitale tjenester for å skape bedre, mer effektive og mer bærekraftige tjenester. title: Bliv Kundedirektør i Private Banking Syddanmark og stå i spidsen for et vigtigt vækstområde
location: Odense, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
description: Vil du stå i spidsen for et ambitiøst Private Banking-team og være med til at udvikle et af Nykredits vigtigste vækstområder? Som Kundedirektør i Syddanmark får du ansvaret for at drive udviklingen af både medarbejdere, kunderelationer og forretning i et område med stort potentiale.   Du bliver en del af et strategisk vigtigt vækstområde i Nykredit, hvor du får ansvaret for at lede og udvikle et dygtigt team af Private Bankere. Sammen arbejder vi for at levere den bedste rådgivning og skabe de bedste kundeoplevelser.  Vi søger dig, der ikke kun har evnerne, men også interessen for at opbygge og vedligeholde relationer, så vi i fællesskab skaber et godt samarbejde og gode relationer, både i teamet og på tværs i organisationen.   Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver bliver at:     sikre, at strategien bliver omsat til konkrete handlinger i teamet  fremme medarbejdertilfredsheden, hvor samarbejde og personlig såvel som faglig udvikling er i fokus  være med til at sikre, at Private Banking er forankret i sunde værdier og faglig ekspertise  skabe et engageret team, der arbejder målrettet på at optimere kundeoplevelserne  formidle tryghed og tillid, så både kunder og kolleger oplever dig som en tillidsskabende og troværdig leder.       Er det dig, vi leder efter?   Vi søger dig, som er motiveret, resultatorienteret og har en solid faglig og relevant baggrund.  Din praktiske erfaring med at yde kvalificeret rådgivning til formuende kunder kombineret med din ambition om at tage kundeoplevelsen til næste niveau er vigtigt for os.  Du har et godt analytisk blik og en struktureret tilgang, og med dine kommunikative evner og din oprigtige nysgerrighed er du i stand til at identificere dine medarbejderes færdigheder og bidrage til deres udvikling.  Med din handleevne, medmenneskelighed og engagement skaber du resultater, der forandrer, nytænker og forbedrer vores relationer til kunderne, samtidig med at du bidrager til at realisere vores fælles mål om at skabe værdi, overblik og tryghed for vores kunder.  Til gengæld lover vi både udvikling og muligheder til dig, der vil og kan.   Dit nye team   Du bliver en del af et team bestående af 21 Private Bankere, fire formuerådgivere samt et team af investeringsrådgivere. Vi samarbejder bredt med kolleger i Nykredit, herunder både med Lokalbanker, International og Private Banking Elite.  Hos os betyder godt humør, højt aktivitetsniveau og gode resultater meget, og du skal være indstillet på en afvekslende hverdag, hvor du sjældent sidder på den samme plads to dage i træk.  Vi har en frisk og uformel omgangstone - og lægger vægt på et positivt mindset.  Du har primært base i Odense, men får også mulighed for at arbejde fra forskellige lokationer i Regionalbank Syddanmark gennem vores lokalbanker.   Vil du vide mere?   Du er velkommen til at kontakte mig, Direktør Private Banking, Bjarne Claussen, på mobil 25 27 03 76 eller mail BCL@nykredit.dk, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen. title: Procurement Manager
description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials for energy, infrastructure, and construction in wholesale and beyond.

We trade with global suppliers and distribute to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade and distribution end-to-end: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, and embedded financing. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier; for our partners, it is the most convenient and safe way to do business across borders. Behind it, our software and agentic AI do the heavy lifting that used to take an asset-intensive supply chain with four or five intermediaries and weeks of manual coordination.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover

  • Seven European markets live

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), offices in London, Mumbai, and Shanghai

$40M Series B just closed, $75M raised to date from Atomico, Project A, and Inven Capital, institutional financing from international banks.

We are building the world's first and last industrial-grade AI operating system for materials, redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

What You Will Do

  • Identify, engage, and acquire suppliers across Europe and worldwide.

  • Lead negotiations for pricing, payment terms, and contracts of €1M+ procurement spend.

  • Build strong commercial relationships that fuel company growth and ensure reliable supply.

title: Senior Finance Manager (f/m/x)
description:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

Your Mission

Your mission is to be an integral part of building and scaling the Finance function within lemon.markets. As Senior Finance Manager you develop processes and policies as well as support the Product Development team and other functions - becoming the go-to person for external stakeholders and auditors. You will play an important role in establishing lemon.markets as the go-to-provider for launching investment products in Europe.

At lemon.markets we value ownership a lot. Meaning you have a lot of autonomy in shaping your area of responsibility.

title: Expansion Manager, EU Airport transfers (all genders)
description:
About us

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Expansion Manager to focus on market expansion and build and scale Distribusion’s airport transfer operator network across Europe. This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants to build a business within a company. Working within Distribusion’s broader airport commercial strategy, you will own a clearly defined sub-segment end to end - from identifying attractive markets and securing operator partnerships to launching them and delivering measurable commercial growth.
You will have the opportunity to build the approach from scratch, deliver highly visible results and take on broader responsibility as the segment scales.


What you will do

  • Translate the broader airport strategy into a prioritised expansion plan, based on market potential, coverage gaps and clear business cases

  • Build a repeatable market-entry playbook, incorporating market feedback and lessons from execution

title: Service Techniker:in Photovoltaik (f/m/x)

Über uns

Otovo ist ein führendes Unternehmen im Bereich erneuerbarer Energien, spezialisiert auf die Installation von Photovoltaik-Anlagen für Privathaushalte. Gegründet 2016 in Norwegen, sind wir heute in mehreren europäischen Ländern aktiv und seit 2021 auch in Deutschland tätig. Unser Ziel: Solarenergie für alle zugänglich, kosteneffizient und unkompliziert zu machen.

Otovo wurde gegründet, um ein einfaches, aber wichtiges Problem zu lösen: Hausenergiesysteme zuverlässig und sorgenfrei zu gestalten. Unser Team legt Wert auf Sicherheit, technische Exzellenz und exzellenten Kundenservice. Wir glauben, dass verlässliche Energie keine komplizierten Prozesse erfordern sollte.

title: Founder Associate (gn) @ AI Venture, Berlin
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

AI is being built into more products every month, and every interaction consumes tokens. As usage grows, the costs add up quickly. The first race was adoption. The next one is efficiency, because inference costs increasingly decide what companies can afford to build and ship. We are building the efficiency layer for production AI. Our systems make AI dramatically leaner, cutting token usage and lowering the cost of every interaction without giving up the quality standards that matter. We work with enterprise software companies, and we want to become a core part of the global AI ecosystem.

You will work directly with our founder and CEO on whatever matters most that week. A lot of it is commercial: working out who needs us, getting into conversations with them, understanding what they run and what it costs them. The rest is everything else that needs doing when a company is this young. We closed our pre-seed in 3 weeks and are now preparing our first customer pilots, so there is a lot of ground to cover and very few people to cover it. This is a rare seat for someone early in their career / you will see how a company gets built and you will build a good part of it yourself.

title: CENTRALE LYON - PhD Silicon Photonics for Scalable Energy-Efficient AI Hardware Accelerators
description:
The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) applications across cloud and edge environments is driving the need for highly efficient hardware capable of supporting increasingly demanding workloads. Among these, matrix multiplication – particularly General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) – remains the dominant computational kernel in modern AI models, including deep neural networks and transformer architectures. Conventional electronic accelerators, while highly optimized, face growing challenges related to energy consumption, data movement, and scalability.

Silicon photonics has emerged as a promising technology to address these limitations by enabling highbandwidth, low-latency, and potentially energy-efficient computation through optical signal processing. In particular, recent advances in photonic computing leveraging phase-change materials (PCM) offer new opportunities for implementing reconfigurable and non-volatile computational primitives directly in the optical domain.

This PhD is part of the CAMELIA program (ASIC and Numérique agencies) within the targeted project LEAF, and aims to explore a hybrid photonic–electronic computing paradigm for AI acceleration. The central objective is to design and evaluate silicon photonics-based architectures for efficient GEMM operations, building on recent work demonstrating a reconfigurable photonic GEMM architecture based on PCM and stochastic computing.

The proposed research will focus on extending this tile-based photonic GEMM approach toward large-scale matrix operations under realistic conditions. Key challenges include managing PCM-related constraints such as limited precision and quantization effects, mitigating noise and variability, and addressing interface latency between photonic and electronic domains.

title: Finance & AI Automation Intern (Remote Part-time)
description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. The category is growing rapidly because AI doesn't work on bad data. Behind the product sits a group of three companies in two currencies, and a small finance team that keeps all of it correct. We're hiring a Finance & AI Automation Intern to run core finance processes and automate the manual work out of them.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll join the Finance team that covers Soda Data NV (Belgium), Soda Data Inc. (US) and NannyML NV, the Belgian company we acquired in 2025. The work is real from week one: invoice processing, month-end reporting, payroll data preparation, expense management, and intercompany recharges across three entities, two currencies and three accounting systems.

The second half of the job is making that work disappear. Finance at Soda builds agentically: Claude and other AI tools are part of the daily workflow, not an experiment on the side. You'll learn a process, run it until you know it cold, and then automate it. Sometimes that means an AI agent on GitHub, sometimes a well-designed formula - you pick the right tool and defend the choice.

This position offers a base salary of $145,000 - $185,000. (Total on-target earnings of $290,000 to $370,000)

Role Description:

Defense Unicorns is seeking a mission-driven Account Executive to spearhead full-lifecycle capture efforts across the Defense Industrial Base. In this high-impact role, you will shape and lead strategic pursuits that align Defense Unicorns’ unique strengths—secure software delivery, DevSecOps, tactical edge enablement, and cybersecurity—with emerging government needs.

You will own the acquisition of new Mission Heroes (what we call our customers) from early qualification through proposal, driving win strategies, forming key partnerships, and aligning technical solutions to mission outcomes. This is a pivotal role within our growth team that directly influences the company’s pipeline, revenue targets, and national security impact.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive new Mission Hero acquisition across the DIB ecosystem, ensuring alignment with Defense Unicorn’s strategic growth objectives and solution capabilities.
  • Develop and execute capture plans, win strategies, and competitive positioning to secure new business.
  • Engage early with government stakeholders, primes, and ecosystem partners to shape opportunities ahead of solicitation.
  • Understand customer pain points, acquisition timelines, and funding paths across multiple branches of the DoD.
  • Identify and lead teaming arrangements that enhance technical capabilities, socio-economic positioning, or incumbent advantage.
  • Translate technical capabilities—such as the Unicorn Delivery Service (UDS), cATO acceleration, and edge deployments—into persuasive win themes.
  • Support RFI/RFP responses with market intelligence, SWOT analysis, and pricing strategy input.
  • Prepare regular reports on business development activities, track key performance indicators (KPIs), and analyze the effectiveness of various strategies. Use data-driven insights to refine approaches and achieve better results.

You are measured by:

  • Number and quality of qualified DIB opportunities identified and advanced
  • Maturity of pipeline supporting growth goals
  • Development and execution of capture strategies, including capture plans, customer shaping, and teaming
  • Achievement of annual bookings target
  • Contribution to overall proposal win rate and contract awards
  • Success in building lasting relationships that lead to competitive advantage

title: Growth Marketing
description:
Who We Are

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more.

Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over $63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

What You’ll Do

You are building the machinery that powers our growth engine. You’ll be the intersection of engineering, marketing, and product, using AI to accelerate everything we do and building systems that scale our reach to the next 10 million developers. This is a high-impact, high-agency position to build a world-class growth function.

  • Lifecycle Marketing: Design the end-to-end user journey. You’ll use email flows, in-app triggers, and retention loops to turn a first-time user into a power user and advocate.

  • Analytics & Integration: You’ll ensure we have a clear view of our funnel from first touch to closed-won and find opportunities across all channels to increase leads, pipeline, and revenue. You have a track record of stitching together a Marketing stack and managing data pipelines.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
Technical Recruiter

Who We Are

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more.

Our team is small relative to our impact, and we believe our users’ success is our success (not the inverse). A team member summarized: “Roboflow is a company full of giant brains and tiny egos.” We find software has a multiplier effect on all roles (not only product and engineering), so Roboflow employs developers across the company in design, sales, customer support, marketing, and beyond.

We’re supported by great customers and investors, having raised over $63 million from Google Ventures, Y Combinator, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, and other leading software investors.

What We're Looking For

Primarily, you like making great things with passionate colleagues. You prefer owning outcomes to completing tasks, and you're motivated by helping exceptional people find work where they can have outsized impact.

You're fascinated by how strong technical organizations are built. You enjoy understanding what makes great engineers, product managers, designers, and researchers effective—and helping hiring teams identify those signals early.

We are less concerned with the number of years you've spent recruiting than with the impact you've had. You know recruiting is not simply about filling open positions. Exceptional hiring compounds across an organization for years. You approach recruiting as a strategic function that helps shape the future of a company.

You are constantly asking, “How can this be better?” Whether improving sourcing approaches, candidate experience, interview design, or recruiting systems, you look for opportunities to raise the bar.

You understand how strong product and technical teams operate. You can distinguish genuine technical depth from interview performance and help hiring managers identify candidates who raise the bar rather than merely fill a role.

What You'll Do

As a Technical Recruiter, you'll own hiring across Product, Engineering, Design, and Research.

Success in this role means consistently identifying and hiring exceptional builders, creating candidate experiences that reflect Roboflow’s values, and improving the systems that help us scale hiring without sacrificing quality

Ajax Systems ist ein internationales Technologieunternehmen und der größte Hersteller von Sicherheitssystemen in Europa mit über 4,5 Millionen Endnutzern und 330.000 PRO-Nutzern in mehr als 180 Ländern weltweit. Das Unternehmen bietet End-to-End-Lösungen zum Schutz von Wohn- und Geschäftsobjekten jeder Größenordnung. Bis heute umfasst das Produktportfolio von Ajax 280 Geräte für Einbruchschutz, Videoüberwachung, Brand- und Lebenssicherheit sowie Komfort- und Automatisierungslösungen. Das Unternehmen beschäftigt 5.000 Spezialisten.

Wir bauen lokale Teams auf, weil wir davon überzeugt sind, dass lokale Experten die Besonderheiten ihres Marktes am besten verstehen. Ajax Systems ist weltweit mit Vertriebsmitarbeitern vertreten, unter anderem in Norwegen, Schweden, Dänemark, Finnland, Italien, Spanien, Deutschland, Frankreich, dem Vereinigten Königreich, den USA, Australien, Südafrika und weiteren Regionen. Das globale Business-Development-Team vereint Gleichgesinnte, die die ambitionierten Ziele von Ajax Systems teilen.

Die Kombination aus erstklassiger Software und leistungsstarker Hardware hat die Wahrnehmung von Sicherheitssystemen für Anwender und Branchenexperten nachhaltig verändert. Durch Anerkennungen auf den größten Fachmessen wie IFSEC, Expoprotection und Intersec sowie durch den Gewinn renommierter Auszeichnungen führender Branchenmedien wie dem PSI Magazine und GIT SECURITY zählt Ajax heute zu den meistausgezeichneten Sicherheitssystemen Europas.

Die Auswahl der Komponenten für die Herstellung der Ajax-Geräte basiert auf Herstellererklärungen, die die Einhaltung der RoHS-Richtlinien bestätigen.

Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und arbeiten Sie an Europas Sicherheitssystem mit den meisten Auszeichnungen mit!

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich elektronischer Sicherheitssysteme (z. B. Intrusion, Video, Zutritt, Brand)
  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb oder in der Unternehmensentwicklung in einem vertikalen B2B-Markt.
  • Deutschkenntnisse auf Muttersprachniveau (in Wort und Schrift).
  • Ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise mit Eigeninitiative und Verantwortung für die eigenen Ergebnisse.
  • Verhandlungsgeschick: starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sowohl am Telefon als auch im persönlichen Gespräch.
  • Hoch motiviert mit der Fähigkeit, Dinge zu verwirklichen.
  • Professionelles Auftreten, zuverlässiges und ethisches Verhalten.

title: Demo Engineering Business Analyst
description:
About Ping Identity:

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

About The Role

We are seeking an enthusiastic, growth-minded Business Analyst to join our Sales Engineering Operations team within the Identity & Access Management (IAM) sector of cybersecurity. Our team is process-driven but agile in execution. We don't work in rigid waterfall methods and long sign-off cycles; instead, we operate like a rapid prototyping squad. We engage early during New Product Introductions (NPIs) and changing GTM motions, building and iterating on functional prototypes in parallel with evolving requirements to quickly deliver production-grade software demos for late-stage sales conversations, live demos, and Proof of Concepts (POCs).

This role is heavily weighted toward Business Analysis, with a critical focus on technical validation. You will take early-stage sales stories, sales plays, and GTM requirements from stakeholders, synthesize them into developer-ready user stories, and personally act as the "last-mile" validator to ensure the final prototype successfully hits the mark.

Note on Career Path: This role is a dedicated career path as a Business Analyst in Cyber Security and Identity & Access Management (IAM). It is not a software engineering or developer-track position.

You Will

  • Translate Sales Logic into Developer Stories: Partner with sales engineering stakeholders, product teams, and GTM teams to capture loose, early-stage feature ideas. You will translate these sales stories and plays into clear, functional user stories and workflows in Jira.

 Systems and SOP architecture from scratch

 AI and automation as daily operational tools 
 Structured hiring and team design

description: Unternehmen : Vaillant GmbH  Standort : Dietikon-CHE  Land : Schweiz (CH)  Marke : Vaillant   Vertragstyp : Unbefristet  Arbeitszeit : Teilzeit / Vollzeit  Kurzbeschreibung  In deiner Funktion verantwortest du den Innendienst an unserem Hauptsitz in Dietikon und führst dabei ein Team von 10 Mitarbeitenden. Dabei berichtest du direkt an den Leiter Verkauf, Marketing und Innendienst. Mit deinem Gespür für Kundenbedürfnisse sorgst du für eine serviceorientierte und effiziente Abwicklung im Innendienst, von der Offerte bis zur Fakturierung sowie der Disponierung unserer Kundendiensttechniker  Du unterstützt deine Mitarbeitenden bei komplexen Kundenanliegen und sorgst für eine lösungsorientierte Betreuung unserer Kundschaft.  Als verbindende Persönlichkeit bringst du Vertrieb, Service, Logistik und weitere Schnittstellen effizient zusammen, um eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit sicherzustellen.  Mit einem wachen Auge für Optimierungen treibst du Prozessverbesserungen sowie Digitalisierungsprojekte aktiv voran.  Du übernimmst Verantwortung, setzt strategische und operative Ziele konsequent um und entwickelst deinen Bereich nachhaltig weiter.  Dank deiner betriebswirtschaftlichen Kenntnisse behältst du Kennzahlen, Budgets und Reportings im Blick und leitest daraus zielführende Massnahmen ab.     Was uns gemeinsam erfolgreich macht     Dein Fundament ist eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Grundausbildung mit Weiterbildung im Bereich Betriebswirtschaft, Verkauf oder Führung, die dir das nötige Rüstzeug für diese anspruchsvolle Rolle mitgibt.  Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung im Innendienst oder in einer vergleichbaren Funktion, idealerweise in der Haustechnikbranche oder einem verwandten Umfeld, macht dich zur gefragten Fachperson.  Mit MS Office arbeitest du sicher, und auch ERP-/CRM-Systeme nutzt du souverän – idealerweise SAP und/oder Salesforce.  Du denkst unternehmerisch, erkennst Zusammenhänge und bringst neue Impulse ein.  Deine ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung und Kommunikationsstärke helfen dir überzeugend aufzutreten.  Belastbarkeit, Flexibilität und eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise gehören zu deinen Stärken.  Stilsicheres Deutsch bringst du mit und gute Englischkenntnisse setzen wir voraus und Französischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil. Die Mehrsprachigkeit ermöglicht dir eine souveräne Kommunikation in unserem dynamischen Umfeld.     Worauf Sie zählen können   Wir alle verbringen viel Zeit auf Arbeit und dein persönliches Wohlbefinden liegt uns am Herzen. Daher bieten wir dir:    Ein stabiles, zukunftsorientiertes Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs mit langfristiger Perspektive.  Ein motiviertes Team in einem familiären Umfeld, das Herausforderungen gemeinsam meistert und für eine positive Arbeitsatmosphäre sorgt.  Raum für Eigengestaltung und die aktive Mitgestaltung deiner Aufgaben und Prozes

We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

We are looking for a Graphene Device Physics Modeling Expert, to develop and refine physics based models for graphene photonic devices. description:
Deine Aufgaben

Wir bauen die Software, mit der Mieterstromprojekte laufen: Zählerdaten rein, Abrechnung raus, und alles dazwischen. Das Core Team verantwortet das Betreiberportal, das Produkt, auf dem der laufende Betrieb unserer Kunden steht. Es ist unser fachlich tiefstes Team, und es wächst.

Es bildet die Energiewirtschaft ab: Messstellenbetrieb, Marktkommunikation, Netzentgelte, Umlagen, Abrechnung nach Regeln, die der Gesetzgeber schreibt und regelmäßig ändert. Dafür suchen wir eine Person, die das Team führt und das Geschäft dahinter versteht. The company

It's still difficult for business owners to sell their business, or buy others, in the sub-£10m enterprise value market. Information asymmetry, lack of knowledge and low transaction values make it hard, and most M&A firms shy away from the segment because they can't serve it profitably. A generation of owner-managers is approaching retirement, and most of them have no realistic route to a sale.

manda exists to fix that. We match buyers with sellers in the part of the market everyone else ignores, and we finance acquisitions ourselves so buyers arrive pre-qualified and often pre-financed. We've sold the first businesses, funded the first acquisition loans, and we're now opening the platform up beyond the businesses that already bank with us.

manda is part of iwoca, one of Europe's leading fintech lenders. Since 2012 iwoca has provided more than £4 billion in funding and its mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments. That backing is why we can serve this market where others can't: a deep footprint in the SME economy with 150,000+ UK customers, the data and infrastructure of an established lender, and the ability to build clean, automated processes instead of running an advisory firm on spreadsheets.

We're looking for a Marketing Manager to own how business owners find manda, iwoca's M&A platform. You'll be our first marketing hire, joining as we open the platform to business owners who don't yet bank with iwoca. Almost everything about how we reach them is still to be decided, and you'll be the one deciding it.

title: CENTRALE LYON - Post Doctoral Open and Flexible System-Level Evaluation Framework for Emerging AI Computing Architectures
description:
Emerging computing technologies – non-volatile and ferroelectric memories, analog and digital in-memory computing, silicon photonics, 3D integration, and heterogeneous chiplets – offer major gains in energy efficiency, latency, bandwidth, and functionality. Their potential cannot, however, be established from device or circuit results alone: it requires a rigorous link between technology characteristics, architectural choices, workload mapping, and application-level figures of merit.

The Electronics group at the Lyon Institute of Nanotechnology (INL) is seeking a (m/f) postdoctoral researcher to develop an open, modular and extensible system-level evaluation framework for design space exploration (DSE) and system-design-technology co-optimization (SDTCO) of emerging computing architectures. The focus is at the interface of computer architecture, accelerator design, performance modelling and hardware-software codesign, while making systematic use of lower-level device, circuit and array results so that architectural conclusions remain physically credible.

The objective is to convert low-level results – compact models, measured or simulated KPIs, variability and reliability constraints, and multi-objective Pareto fronts – into parameterized architectural models supporting efficient exploration of accelerators for emerging AI workloads. The framework must enable both bottom-up projection, from device/circuit/array choices toward system performance, and top-down constraint propagation, from targets for energy, latency, throughput, accuracy, robustness and area toward technology and circuit requirements. It will consolidate ongoing INL activities in predictive system assessment, DTCO, emerging memories, compute-in-memory and photonic computing, integrating or extending existing components with emphasis on openness, reproducibility and reusability.

About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

  • Probenverarbeitung (Stuhl, Urin, Trinkwasser, Varia)

title: Auszubildender (m/w/d) zum Kaufmann für Büromanagement in Plaidt
description:
Hall Tabakwaren ist bundesweit in aller Munde. 1903 als Ladengeschäft für Zigarren, Rauchtabak und Zigaretten gegründet, sind wir heute einer der führenden Tabakwarengroßhändler in Deutschland. In unserem in 5. title: Junior Complaints & Compliance Specialist
description:
Complaints and Compliance Specialist

Location: Berlin (office first)

The team

The Complaints team sits within Operations and works every day to make sure merchants who run their businesses on SumUp get fair, fast, and compliant resolutions whenever something goes wrong with a payment. As payment volumes grow, so does the complexity of the cases the team handles, from delayed payouts to disputed chargebacks, and this role exists to build the specialist skills needed to resolve these cases with precision and care. Joining now means learning the mechanics of payment processing from the ground up, working closely with Risk, Engineering, and Finance, and helping shape how SumUp responds to some of its most sensitive merchant and regulatory moments.

What you'll do

  • Investigate and resolve merchant complaints tied to payment processing, including authorisations, settlements, payouts, and chargebacks
  • Dig into processor logs, payment gateways, and payout systems to find the root cause of each issue and document the findings clearly
  • Draft clear, compliant final responses to merchants that meet regulatory timelines and internal SLAs
  • Work closely with Payment Operations, Risk, Engineering, and Finance to unblock complex cases
  • Keep case documentation audit ready and flag emerging patterns or recurring issues to the wider team
  • Contribute to playbooks and knowledge base articles that help the team resolve future cases faster

You'll be great for this role if...

  • Foundational understanding of payment processing, covering authorisations, settlements, payouts, and basic chargebacks
  • Comfort working with a CRM or ticketing system, following SOPs, and keeping precise, audit ready documentation
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to draft clear, customer friendly responses under regulatory constraints</

title: Engineering Manager | Applied AI
description:
We're looking for an Engineering Manager to own AI at one of the fastest-growing AI legal tech companies in Europe. Over 2,000 lawyers use JUPUS every day, and the AI behind it is already in production and already in front of customers. You'd own the team, the technical roadmap, and the standard everything gets built to.

You'll report to our Head of Engineering and lead our AI team. This is a leadership role, not a senior engineering seat with a lead title. You won't be shipping features yourself, and that's deliberate- we want someone whose leverage comes from the team they build and the calls they make.

Your Challenge and Opportunity in This Role

Legal work is document-heavy, judgement-heavy, and almost untouched by AI. We've trained on over a million German court rulings and handled over a million cases, so the hard part isn't proving AI belongs here. The hard part is doing it well enough that a lawyer will put their professional judgement behind the output.

Your job is to make that repeatable. The field throws up something new every week and most of it is noise. We need someone who can tell the difference, turn that judgement into a roadmap, and build a team that can actually deliver it.

Tasks

Leading the team

  • Make the team better than you found it: hire, mentor, and raise the bar on what good looks like here. Your impact shows up in what they ship when you're not in the room.

  • Set the engineering standard for AI work: evaluation, testing and observability, and a delivery rhythm that holds up when the pressure is on.

title: Integrations Engineer (SDK)
description:
Voice is becoming the primary interface for technology. For the first time in history, we can use natural language to control and interact with our devices, services, and applications, and we're only at the beginning of the adoption of Voice and Physical AI across industries. Current voice interactions, however, still lack a fundamental human skill: nuanced understanding of audio scenes and environments. Navigating complex auditory scenes, distinguishing between multiple voices, or focusing on a main speaker are all part of the challenge of "teaching machines to hear like human beings."

At ai-coustics, we're building the audio intelligence layer and developer tooling to enable more robust and intelligent voice agents and Physical AI applications. Today, Voice AI companies like Perplexity, PolyAI, LiveKit, AssemblyAI or Telli use our SDK to prepare their agents for real-world acoustic challenges. Our models power thousands of agents worldwide and process millions of hours each month.

We are backed by leading early-stage investors including Connect Ventures, Partech, Inovia Capital, as well as angel investors from HuggingFace, DeepMind and Amazon with deep expertise in AI and developer infrastructure. These partners share our vision and are helping us build a world-class team operating with high levels of responsibility and velocity. We look for people who take ownership, think systemically, and want to solve challenging real-world problems in close collaboration with our customers.

Role overview

We're looking for an Integrations Engineer to make our SDK easy to adopt on the platforms voice agent developers actually build on. Our core SDK is native and ships with wrappers for Python, Node.js, C, C++, Rust and WebAssembly, plus plugins for LiveKit Agents and Pipecat. You will own the plugins and the public surface of the language wrappers, keep them released in lockstep with the core SDK and work with upstream open-sour

title: Praktikum Social Media, Content & Community bei Try It (m/w/d)
description:
100 % remote · Teilzeit möglich · Start nach Absprache

Die Jacke, die du ständig trägst. Das Secondhand-Teil, für das dir noch eine Kombination fehlt. Ein Blick in einen anderen Kleiderschrank – und plötzlich eine Idee für deinen eigenen.

Your wardrobe has more in it.

Ich bin Christopher, Gründer von Try It. Ich entwickle eine App, mit der du deine Kleidung erfassen, Outfits zusammenstellen und neue Möglichkeiten in deiner eigenen Garderobe entdecken kannst. Was du davon trägst, entscheidest du.

Jetzt suche ich jemanden, der Lust hat, Try It mit mir sichtbar zu machen und eine Community mit aufzubauen. Jemanden mit eigenen Ideen, einem Gespür für Mode und Menschen und Freude daran, selbst Inhalte zu gestalten – gerne auch vor der Kamera.

Vielleicht kennst du eine kleine Fashion-Community, deren Humor du sofort verstehst. Du kannst erklären, warum du bei bestimmten Creatorn hängen bleibst. Oder du hast schon selbst etwas veröffentlicht, das Menschen miteinander ins Gespräch gebracht hat.

Diese Perspektive möchte ich kennenlernen.

Ich bringe die App, die Geschichte dahinter und mich selbst ein. Du bringst deinen Blick mit. Ich möchte mit dir Ideen entwickeln, filmen, ausprobieren und herausfinden, was Menschen an Try It begeistert. Wenn du sagst: „Christopher, zeig das mal“ oder „Ich würde das anders erzählen“, bin ich dabei.

Aufgaben

Was du mitgestalten kannst

Deine Schwerpunkte vereinbare ich mit dir passend zu deinen Erfahrungen, deinen Lernzielen und deiner verfügbaren Zeit.

  • Eigene Inhalte entwickeln und umsetzen. Ein Lieblingsteil anders kombinieren, beim Zusammenlegen Kleidung aufnehmen oder zeigen, was tatsächlich im Reisekoffer landet: Du erkennst solche Momente und machst daraus Reels, TikToks oder Storys. Try It wird dabei in echter Nutzung sichtbar.
  • Vor und hinter der Kamera mitwirken.</

title: (Senior) DevOps Engineer - Infrastructure & Security (m/f/d)
description:
Du willst Infrastruktur nicht nur betreiben, sondern verantworten? Bei uns gehört dir der komplette Stack – vom Proxmox-Cluster im eigenen Rechenzentrum über Firewalls und VPNs bis zu AWS und den Deployment-Pipelines.

Testsieger ist eines der größten Vergleichsportale Deutschlands: 4,2 Millionen Produkte, Testberichte, Kundenbewertungen und ein integrierter Preisvergleich, der Millionen Nutzer zum richtigen Kauf führt. Ein 20-köpfiges Team mit direkten Wegen und ohne Konzern-Overhead.

Du übernimmst die Rolle des technischen Owners für unsere Infrastruktur – mit einem Team an deiner Seite, und einem Engineering-Team, das auf dich zählt.

Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest den Betrieb unserer Linux-Serverlandschaft: On-Premise-Cluster (Proxmox, ZFS) und AWS
  • Du betreibst und härtest Netzwerk und Security: Firewalls, VPN, Zugriffskontrolle, Zertifikate, Hardening – inklusive der Netzanbindung an unseren größten Partner
  • Du automatisierst mit Ansible und hältst Infrastruktur versioniert, reproduzierbar und dokumentiert
  • Du betreust unsere Container-Plattform (Docker, Nomad, Traefik) und die CI/CD-Pipelines (GitHub Actions), damit die Teams sicher und schnell shippen
  • Du administrierst MySQL in Produktion: Backups, Performance, Recovery
  • Du baust Monitoring, Logging und Alerting aus (Grafana, New Relic) und führst Incidents zur Ursache
  • Du bist Sparringspartner für Engineering, Data und Product – und erklärst, warum Dinge so gebaut sind, wie sie gebaut sind

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb von Linux-Serverumgebungen (Debian/Ubuntu) – du weißt, wie man Systeme auch ohne Assistenz von A nach B bringt
  • Fundierte Netzwerkkenntnisse: TCP/IP, Routing, DNS, Load Balancing, Firewall- und VPN-Administration
  • Nachweisbare Praxis in Infrastructure Security: Hardening, Access Control, Security Best Practices
  • Ansible in Produktion, Container

title: IT Delivery Manager
description: Experis è la società IT & Technology del Gruppo Manpower. Le persone e le loro competenze sono il nostro successo e insieme ci poniamo come partner tecnologici dei nostri clienti attraverso servizi e soluzioni. Vogliamo essere artefici, proprio insieme a te, di un ambiente di lavoro innovativo, stimolante e flessibile, attraverso i nostri Valori: People, Knowledge e Innovation.  Per azienda marchigiana specializzata da quasi trent'anni in soluzioni software gestionali per realtà di diversi settori siamo alla ricerca di un/una:      IT Delivery Manager      La persona gestirà i rapporti con i clienti attivi e coordinerà il team interno di consulenti gestionali affiancandoli nell'erogazione delle soluzioni software con attenzione a qualità, coerenza e tempi. Pianificare e condurre review periodiche con i clienti, suggerendo upgrade, nuove funzionalità o servizi aggiuntivi, in ottica di customer success e up-selling.  Coordinare le attività del team di delivery/consulenti, assicurando un'erogazione coerente, efficace e allineata agli standard aziendali.  Assegnare risorse ai progetti, supervisionare i carichi di lavoro e affiancare i consulenti nei momenti critici.  Fare da interfaccia tra cliente, team tecnico e product owner in caso di nuove esigenze, escalation o opportunità.  Monitorare la customer satisfaction e proporre azioni di miglioramento continuo.
