title: Consumer Marketing Manager
description: Vil du lede og utvikle fremtidens Consumer Marketing i Coloplast Norge?   I Coloplast Norge søker vi en ambisiøs, kommersielt orientert og strategisk sterk Consumer Marketing Manager som ønsker å være med på å forme neste fase av vår Consumer & Direct-satsing i samspillet mellom digitale og fysiske kontaktpunkter.  Dette er en nøkkelrolle for deg som brenner for å skape vekst gjennom innsikt, datadrevet markedsføring og sterke kundeopplevelser. Du vil ha et bredt ansvar for å utvikle og gjennomføre markedsstrategier som tiltrekker nye brukere, styrker konverteringer og skaper langsiktige relasjoner gjennom hele brukerreisen.  Som Consumer Marketing Manager blir du en sentral del av Consumer & Direct-lederteamet og får stor innflytelse på både strategiske prioriteringer og kommersielle resultater.   Om rollen   Som Consumer Marketing Manager i Norge vil du sikre at markedsføringen understøtter våre vekstambisjoner på tvers av produkter, kanaler og brukergrupper. Rollen kombinerer strategisk ledelse med operativ gjennomføring, og du vil samarbeide tett med salg, digitale funksjoner, nordiske og globale team samt eksterne partnere. Du vil være en viktig drivkraft i arbeidet med å skape sømløse brukerreiser fra første kontaktpunkt til langsiktig bruk av våre produkter og tjenester, en nøkkelspiller for å skape fremtidens Consumer & Direct forretning i Coloplast Norge.   Dine ansvarsområder    Strategi og vekst     Utvikle og drive den årlige Consumer & Direct-markedsstrategien i samarbeid med C&D lederteamet.  Identifisere vekstmuligheter basert på markedsinnsikt, brukerbehov og kommersielle mål.  Sikre at markedsaktiviteter direkte bidrar til økt brukervekst, konvertering og lojalitet.       Kampanjer og kundeopplevelse     Lede planlegging og gjennomføring av kampanjer, produktlanseringer og markedsaktiviteter på tvers av digitale og fysiske kanaler.  Videreutvikle brukerreiser og sikre en sømløs opplevelse gjennom hele kundelivssyklusen.  Styrke samspillet mellom Consumer- og HCP-kanaler for å skape en helhetlig kundeopplevelse.       Data og kommersiell effekt     Analysere markeds- og CRM-data for å identifisere innsikt og omsette denne til konkrete tiltak.  Måle, evaluere og optimalisere effekten av markedsaktiviteter basert på definerte KPI-er.  Sikre lønnsom og effektiv bruk av markedsbudsjettet.       Samarbeid og prosjektledelse     Drive tverrfaglige prosjekter på tvers av organisasjonen.  Samarbeide tett med salgsteam, nordiske og globale funksjoner samt eksterne byråer og leverandører.  Skape engasjement og resultater gjennom tydelig kommunikasjon og godt samarbeid.       Hvem ser vi etter?   Vi ser etter en markedsfører som kombinerer strategisk forståelse med sterk gjennomføringsevne.  Du er analytisk, kommersielt orientert og motiveres av å skape målbare resultater. Samtidig har du evnen til å se helheten, bygge relasjoner og samle mennesker rundt felles mål.  Du trives i et miljø med høyt tempo og mange interes

title: Support Lead
description: Support Lead till Carla   Vill du vara en del av ett supportteam som gör skillnad i ett av kundens största köp? Vi söker en trygg, engagerad och strukturerad Support Lead som är delaktig i att utveckla teamet och verksamheten och sätter standarden för riktigt bra kundservice.   Om Carla   Vi på Carla vill sätta en ny standard för hur man köper bil. Vårt mål är att göra det lika enkelt och tryggt att köpa eller leasa en laddbar bil online som att handla annat på nätet. Supportteamet har en avgörande roll i att skapa den tryggheten, från den första frågan efter leverans till situationer där något inte blivit som kunden förväntat sig.   Om rollen   I den här rollen arbetar du primärt med operativt supportarbete och visar vägen i hur vi bemöter kunder, bedömer komplexa ärenden och hittar hållbara lösningar. Tillsammans med teamet balanserar du hög kundnöjdhet med effektiva processer och god kostnadskontroll.  Du är inte formellt personalansvarig för teamet, men leder och samordnar det dagliga arbetet i Carlas supportteam. Du säkerställer att teamet prioriterar rätt, ger kunderna tydlig återkoppling och driver ärenden hela vägen till lösning. Du skapar förutsättningar för kollegorna att lyckas genom ett närvarande ledarskap, tydliga arbetssätt och stöd i svåra kunddialoger.  Du rapporterar till Support & Logistikchef och arbetar nära interna avdelningar likväl externa samarbetspartners och intressenter.   Ditt uppdrag     Hantera supportärenden genom att ge våra kunder en exeptionell kundupplevelse  Leda den dagliga driften. Samordna och prioritera teamets arbete, följa upp kortsiktig bemanningsplanering och tillgänglighet samt säkerställa att kunder får återkoppling i tid.  Coacha och stötta teamet. Ge löpande feedback, vara ett bollplank i svåra ärenden och hjälpa teamet att utvecklas i kundbemötande, problemlösning och exekvering.  Säkerställa kvalitet och framdrift. Följa upp att ärenden dokumenteras, att överenskommelser hålls och att reklamationer, returer och återbetalningar hanteras enligt våra processer.  Leda i komplexa kundärenden. Stötta teamet i bedömningar utifrån kundunderlag, verkstadsutlåtanden, garantivillkor och försäkringsfrågor samt till fullo äga och ta ansvar i ärenden som kräver extra erfarenhet och omdöme.  Hantera eskaleringar. Följa upp negativa kundomdömen och vara ägare och drivande i ARN-ärenden med ett professionellt och lösningsorienterat mindset.  Ge nya kollegor en bra start. Stötta introduktionen och säkerställa att nya medarbetare blir trygga i våra system, rutiner och kunddialoger.  Utveckla arbetssätten. Identifiera återkommande problem och driva förbättringar som stärker kundupplevelsen och gör teamets arbete mer effektivt.  Säkra kontinuitet. Anpassa telefonväxelns öppettider inför helgdagar och täcka upp för Support & Logistikchef vid semester och frånvaro.     Vem är du?   Du är en trygg ledare som skapar förtroende genom tydlighet, engagemang och handling. Du ser när en kollega behöver stöd, vågar

title: Laskutuksen palvelupäällikkö, LähiTapiola Palvelut
description: Haluatko johtaa osaavaa asiantuntijatiimiä ja olla mukana kehittämässä laskutuksen tulevaisuutta?      Etsimme nyt laskutuksen palveluihin palvelupäällikköä määräaikaiseen perhevapaan sijaisuuteen. Tehtävä tarjoaa mahdollisuuden päästä vaikuttamaan tärkeään liiketoiminnan tukifunktioon, johtamaan osaavaa asiantuntijatiimiä sekä osallistumaan aktiivisesti kehityshankkeisiin ja muutosten läpivientiin.     Määräaikaisuus alkaa mahdollisimman pian ja jatkuu alustavasti 31.12.2027 saakka. Tehtävän palkka on riippuen valittavan henkilön kokemuksesta 4500 - 5000 euroa.     Lähiesihenkilönä toimimisen lisäksi vastaat palvelupäällikkönä prosessien kehittämisestä ja tavoitteiden toteutumisesta. Toimit asiantuntijatukena tiimille. Tärkeä tehtäväsi on myös tukea tiimisi työhyvinvointia. Kannustamme esihenkilöä aktiiviseen, osallistavaan ja valmentavaan johtamiseen. Sinulla on halu toimia muuttuvassa ympäristössä sekä taitoa johtaa omaa ja muiden toimintaa tuloksekkaasti.     Tehtävässäsi:   johdat tiimiä ja tuet sen onnistumista arjessa  vastaat työn organisoinnista, resurssienhallinnasta ja priorisoinnista  osallistut kehityshankkeisiin ja johdat muutosta yhdessä asiantuntijoiden kanssa  seuraat toimintaa, raportoit tuloksista ja hyödynnät tietoa päätöksenteossa  kehität laskutuksen prosesseja ja työskentelytapoja yhdessä eri sidosryhmien kanssa  teet yhteistyötä kumppaneiden ja järjestelmätoimittajien kanssa  huolehdit esihenkilön vuosikellon mukaisista henkilöstöjohtamisen tehtävistä  osallistut tarvittaessa myös operatiivisiin tehtäviin, kuten laskujen hyväksyntään ja työvuorosuunnitteluun.       Odotamme sinulta    kokemusta esihenkilö- tai johtamistehtävistä  kykyä johtaa ja valmentaa asiantuntijatiimiä  rohkeutta käydä myös haastavia keskusteluja rakentavasti  vahvoja organisointi- ja priorisointitaitoja  kykyä hahmottaa kokonaisuuksia ja pitää useita asioita yhtä aikaa hallinnassa.      Lisäksi arvostamme:   ymmärrystä laskutuksesta ja laskutusprosessien logiikasta  kokemusta muutos- ja kehittämishankkeista  kykyä hahmottaa järjestelmien välisiä riippuvuuksia  liiketoiminnan ymmärrystä ja yhtiöympäristön tuntemusta  kaupallista tai talousalan koulutusta  juridisen toimintaympäristön tuntemusta       Millainen kollega olet?   Toivomme, että olet ihmislähtöinen ja helposti lähestyttävä esihenkilö, joka pystyy luomaan selkeyttä muuttuvissa tilanteissa.     Arvostamme erityisesti sitä, että:   suhtaudut muutoksiin myönteisesti  opit uusia asioita nopeasti  näet ympärillä mahdollisuuksia uhkien sijaan  toimit luontevasti useiden samanaikaisten kokonaisuuksien keskellä  osaat innostaa myös muita muutoksen aikana  sinulla on sopivasti auktoriteettia ja uskottavuutta esihenkilönä  johdat valmentavalla otteella ja annat asiantuntijoille tilaa onnistua  tuot työyhteisöön hyvää energiaa ja huumoria.       Tarjoamme   Saat johdettavaksi tiimin, jonka kanssa pääset työskentelemään erittäin mielenkiintoisella ja uudistuvalla tehtäväkentällä. Tiimisi elämänturv

title: Päällikkö, konsultointi ja käyttöönotot
description: Oscar Software hakee  konsultoinnin ja käyttöönottojen päällikköä johtamaan konsultointitiimin toimintaa  ja rakentamaan kannattavaa, skaalautuvaa palveluliiketoimintaa yhdessä palvelujohtajan ja osaavan organisaation kanssa.     Tehtävä tarjoaa mahdollisuuden ottaa laaja vastuu suomalaisen ohjelmistoyhtiön konsultoinnin kehittämisestä tilanteessa, jossa siirrytään räätälöidyistä toimituksista kohti tuotteistettua SaaS-liiketoimintaa. Vahva asiakaspohja, oma tuotekehitys ja uuden sukupolven Oscar P1 -tuoteperhe luovat perustan käyttöönottomallien uudistamiselle ja nykyasiakkaille tarjottavien palvelujen kehittämiselle.      Oscar Software yrityksenä      Oscar Software on yli 20-vuotias suomalainen ohjelmistoyhtiö, joka tarjoaa toiminnanohjauksen, talouden, verkkokaupan ja digitaalisen liiketoiminnan ratkaisuja erityisesti teollisuuden ja tukkukaupan yrityksille.     Oscarilla on yli 700 asiakasta, noin 120 ammattilaista ja vahva, lähes 50 henkilön tuotekehitysorganisaatio. Yhtiön liikevaihto oli vuonna 2025 noin 14,1 miljoonaa euroa. Oscar toimii Tampereella, Espoossa ja Raisiossa. Kotimaisuus on Oscarille tärkeää, ja tuotekehitys tehdään kokonaan Suomessa.      Tehtävänkuva ja keskeiset vastuut      Tehtävässä vastaat noin 20 asiantuntijan konsultointitiimin johtamisesta, tuloksellisuudesta ja jatkuvasta kehittämisestä. Vastuualueeseesi kuuluvat ERP-käyttöönotot sekä uusille että nykyisille asiakkaille ja asiakkaiden liiketoimintaa tukevien konsultointipalvelujen kehittäminen.      Keskeisiä vastuitasi ovat:      • Johdat konsultointitiimin arkea ja varmistat, että yhteiset tavoitteet muuttuvat käytännön tekemiseksi.  • Vastaat konsultoinnin tuloksesta, resursoinnista, toimitusmalleista ja laadusta.  • Kehität käyttöönottojen kannattavuutta, ennustettavuutta ja yhteisiä toimintatapoja.  • Rakennat nykyasiakkaille palveluja, jotka auttavat hyödyntämään järjestelmää ja kehittämään asiakkaan liiketoimintaa.  • Vahvistat konsultointikyvykkyyttä ja tuet osaamisen jakamista yli tuotelinjojen.  • Kehität mittareita ja tiedon hyödyntämistä työn suunnittelussa, seurannassa ja päätöksenteossa.  • Vahvistat tiimin omaa vastuunottoa ja kykyä ratkaista arjen tilanteita.  • Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä myynnin, asiakaspalvelun, tuotehallinnan ja tuotekehityksen kanssa.     Tehtävässä odotetaan läsnäoloa konsulttien arjessa sekä kykyä muuttaa suunnitelmat konkreettisiksi toimintatavoiksi ja mitattaviksi tuloksiksi.     Kuulut Oscarin operatiiviseen johtoryhmään ja raportoit palvelujohtaja Jenna Tuomiselle. Johtamisvastuut on jaettu: sinä vastaat toiminnan ja tuloksen johtamisesta, palvelujohtajalla on hallinnollinen esihenkilövastuu ja kaksi kasvunvalmentajaa tukee konsulttien kehittymistä ja hyvinvointia.      Odotukset ensimmäisten kuukausien aikana      Ensimmäisten 1–6 kuukauden aikana tärkeintä on ottaa konsultointitiimin toiminta haltuun, rakentaa luottamus ihmisiin ja muodostaa selkeä kokonaiskuva asiakkaista, käyttöönotoista ja toiminnan nykytilasta.

description: Job Description Summary   Project Management/ Planning/ Coordinating activities typically in the context of a production or services project to fulfill a customer order or need according to financial/commercial parameters and ensuring customer satisfaction. title: Team Manager & Service Deliver Manager
description: Formål med stillingen   Stillingen har det overordnede ansvaret for leveranse, lønnsomhet, kundetilfredshet og ressursstyring innen egen kundeportefølje. title: Service Delivery Manager
description: Cerchiamo un/una  Service Delivery Manager  da inserire nel team dedicato alla gestione dei servizi IT Infrastructure & Cloud per clienti Enterprise.  La persona sarà il  punto di riferimento operativo del cliente  e coordinerà i team specialistici ESG Services per garantire continuità, qualità e corretta evoluzione dei servizi.     Il ruolo prevede inizialmente un focus rilevante su uno dei nostri principali clienti Enterprise, mantenendo però una collocazione trasversale all’interno dell’organizzazione. Nel tempo, la responsabilità sarà estesa a più clienti, contribuendo allo sviluppo del modello ESG Services di  Service Delivery, Customer Success e Service Excellence .      Cosa farai       Agirai come  Single Point of Contact operativo  per i clienti assegnati.  Raccoglierai, qualificherai e coordinerai richieste ed esigenze.  Gestirai backlog, priorità, scadenze e follow-up.  Coordinerai i team specialistici di Infrastructure, Cloud, Networking, Systems e Cybersecurity.  Monitorerai l’avanzamento delle attività, il rispetto degli SLA e le eventuali criticità.  Gestirai Incident, Change ed escalation operative, assicurandone la presa in carico e la risoluzione.  Garantirai al cliente una comunicazione chiara, costante e strutturata.  Parteciperai a Operational Review, Service Review e riunioni di coordinamento.  Analizzerai problematiche ricorrenti ed esigenze emergenti, proponendo azioni di miglioramento.  Contribuirai alla diffusione di processi e standard comuni di Service Delivery e Customer Success.       Chi cerchiamo      Cerchiamo una persona con  2-5 anni di esperienza  in uno o più dei seguenti ambiti:      Service Delivery o Service Coordination;  IT Service Management;  Technical Account Management;  coordinamento di Service Desk;  Infrastructure o Cloud Operations con responsabilità di coordinamento.      Valutiamo anche profili provenienti dal Project Management IT che abbiano maturato esperienza concreta nella gestione continuativa di servizi, Incident, Change, escalation e team tecnici.      Competenze richieste       Capacità di organizzare attività, priorità e interlocutori diversi.  Forte orientamento al cliente e senso di responsabilità sul risultato.  Ottime capacità comunicative e relazionali.  Capacità di interagire efficacemente con referenti tecnici e manageriali.  Attitudine a comprendere il contesto e le esigenze del cliente oltre la singola richiesta operativa.  Conoscenza generale di infrastrutture IT, networking, sistemi, backup, cybersecurity e Cloud.  Conoscenza di base di AWS e/o Microsoft Azure.  Familiarità con i principali processi ITSM: Incident, Change, Problem, Service Request e SLA Management.  Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, scritta e parlata, almeno di livello  B2 .       Competenze preferenziali       Certificazione ITIL Foundation.  Certificazioni AWS o Microsoft Azure.  Esperienza in organizzazioni Enterprise, strutturate o internazionali.  Conoscenza di metodologie di Project Managem

RESPONSABILITÀ    Coordinamento e organizzazione del team tecnico e degli interventi di assistenza  Supporto nella gestione delle problematiche tecniche più complesse, anche direttamente sul campo  Sviluppo delle competenze del team e affiancamento delle risorse più junior  Monitoraggio della qualità del servizio e dei principali KPI  Individuazione e implementazione di interventi di miglioramento di processi e modalità operative  Interfaccia con clienti e funzioni interne per la gestione delle principali problematiche tecniche       REQUISITI     8-10 anni di esperienza  in ambito assistenza tecnica, con un solido percorso iniziale come tecnico field/trasfertista  Successiva esperienza nel  coordinamento di squadre tecniche   Provenienza dal settore  UPS o da ambiti affini : elettronica di potenza, inverter, azionamenti, automazione industriale o impiantistica elettrica  Solide competenze tecniche e disponibilità a mantenere un ruolo operativo sul campo  Approccio  pragmatico, proattivo e orientato al miglioramento   Buone capacità di coordinamento e gestione delle persone   Inglese tecnico  e disponibilità a trasferte in Italia e all’estero       COSA OFFRE L’AZIENDA    Un ruolo di responsabilità con possibilità di  contribuire concretamente allo sviluppo dell’area Service   Un contesto dinamico, nel quale il Responsabile avrà un ruolo operativo e non esclusivamente gestionale  Riporto diretto alla Direzione  Inserimento in una realtà  solida, in crescita e con presenza internazionale    Contratto a tempo indeterminato con Inquadramento  in funzione dell’esperienza   Componente variabile  legata al raggiungimento degli obiettivi

description: About the Opportunity  Our client is a well-established global consumer technology brand with a strong international presence. This role offers a unique opportunity to drive customer experience strategy, oversee outsourced service operations, influence product improvements through Voice of Customer (VOC) insights, and partner with cross-functional stakeholders on a regional scale. Manage and optimize BPO vendor performance against key operational metrics such as CSAT, FCR, SLA, AHT, backlog and resolution rates.  Conduct service quality audits, interaction sampling, and calibration activities to ensure consistent customer experience standards.  Analyze VOC trends and customer feedback to identify improvement opportunities and influence product and process enhancements.  Lead resolution of complex customer escalations and major service incidents through root cause analysis and corrective action planning.  Ensure compliance with GDPR and relevant European customer protection regulations.  Prepare regional operational reviews and performance reports for global leadership.   What We're Looking For   3+ years of customer service, customer experience, or contact center operations management within Europe.  Strong hands-on experience managing BPO or outsourced customer service vendors.  Deep understanding of contact center KPIs including CSAT, FCR, SLA, AHT, and quality metrics.  Experience building QA frameworks, performing audits, and handling high-severity escalations.  Familiarity with CRM platforms; Salesforce experience is highly desirable.  Business-level English; additional European languages are a significant advantage.  Ability to work independently across multiple time zones and stakeholders.   Location   Europe-based (Remote within Europe)  Candidates must currently reside in Europe and possess valid work authorization within the region.   Why Join   Regional ownership across diverse European markets.  High visibility with global leadership teams.  Opportunity to shape customer experience strategy and service excellence.  Strong cross-functional exposure across Operations, Product, Supply Chain and Engineering teams.   How to Apply  If you are interested in exploring this confidential opportunity, please apply directly or contact us for a private discussion. All applications will be handled with strict confidentiality.

title: Service Specialist / Project Specialist, Asiakaspalvelu (2 paikkaa)
description: Työsopimuksen tyyppi:  vakituinen / määräaikainen (12-18kk)    Sijainti:  Hermiankatu 6-8, 33720 Tampere / Palokunnankatu 26, 13100 Hämeenlinna   Hakuaika päättyy:  4.10.2026     Innostaako sinua erinomaisen asiakaskokemuksen luominen energia-alalla? Tule Service Specialistiksi VENI Energialle! Haemme kahta uutta osaajaa, yhtä vakituiseen ja toista määräaikaiseen (12-18kk) työsuhteeseen.       Tehtävänkuvaus:       Vakituisena Service Specialistina  työskentelet VENI Energian sähkönhankinnan yritysasiakkaiden parissa. Vastaat asiakkaiden kysymyksiin sekä selvität erilaisia palvelupyyntöjä puhelimitse ja sähköpostitse esimerkiksi käyttöpaikkoihin, sähkömarkkinatilanteeseen ja laskutukseen liittyen. Asiakkaat vaihtelevat yksityisyrittäjistä suuriin konserneihin, joten pääset työskentelemään monipuolisten asiakaspalvelutilanteiden parissa. Työssäsi ratkot itsenäisesti asiakkaiden kysymyksiä ja hoidat myös haastavampia asiakastilanteita, kuten reklamaatioita.       Määräaikaisessa tehtävässä   Project Specialistina  työskentelet Datahub-valtuutusten parissa ja autat VENI Energian yritysasiakkaita valtuutusten uusimisessa. Lainsäädännön muutoksen myötä vanhat Datahub-valtuutukset tulee uusia vahvaan tunnistautumiseen perustuviksi, ja olet tässä projektissa tärkeässä roolissa varmistamassa muutoksen sujuvaa etenemistä. Kontaktoit nykyasiakkaita aktiivisesti puhelimitse ja sähköpostitse, opastat heitä valtuutusten antamisessa sekä seuraat valtuutusten etenemistä. Asiakaskontaktoinnin lisäksi tehtävääsi kuuluu myös projektia tukevia taustatehtäviä yhteistyössä Back Office -tiimin kanssa.       Millaista osaajaa etsimme?   Tehtävissä menestyminen edellyttää ennen kaikkea kykyä kuunnella asiakkaita sekä toimia ratkaisukeskeisesti erilaisissa asiakaspalvelutilanteissa. Työskentely niin puhelimitse kuin sähköpostitse on sinulle tuttua ja luontevaa, etkä pelkää olla rohkeasti yhteydessä asiakkaisiin tai muihin sidosryhmiin. VENI Energialla avoin ja oma-aloitteinen työkulttuuri on tärkeää, joten toivomme, että haluat kehittyä yksilönä sekä kehittää myös työyhteisön toimintaa yhdessä tiimin kanssa.      Vakituisessa Service Specialistin tehtävässä toivomme sinulta vähintään muutaman vuoden kokemusta asiakaspalvelutyöstä sekä valmiutta käsitellä itsenäisesti myös vaativampia asiakastilanteita ja reklamaatioita. Määräaikainen tehtävä sopii myös uransa alkuvaiheessa olevalle osaajalle, jolla on jo hieman kokemusta asiakaspalvelusta sekä rohkeutta tarttua puhelimeen ja kontaktoida asiakkaita aktiivisesti. title: Client and Delivery Manager - Major Engagements
description: Are you the person a client trusts within the first hour, even though they've never met you and someone else made the promise you now have to keep?      You might currently be a Research Director, Client Service Director or Client Director in a research or insights agency, or an Engagement Manager, Delivery Manager, Delivery Lead or Engagement Lead in software or product delivery. If you're properly embedded in that role, keep reading.      Datamine has championed data, analytics and AI for over 30 years. As organisations across Australia and New Zealand increasingly invest in AI and data-driven decisions, we’re seeking a Client & Delivery Manager to join our Client Services team to deliver projects and solutions to our clients.     If you want a role where your judgement is needed rather than just useful, this is it.     This is a full-time role based in our Parnell office.        About the role  An engagement lands on your desk the moment it's won, sold on a promise you didn't personally make, and it's yours from there: on scope, on margin, with the client's confidence intact. Getting the first big one right is what earns the second.     In this role, you’ll stand between a client’s ambiguous want and a technical team’s reality and make calls that stick with both sides, ultimately translating technical outputs into a compelling story to present back. You don't need analytics or data science depth; we have specialists for that.     You’ll build trust with a client who doesn’t know us yet, often under delivery pressure, and resolve disagreements between the client and the delivery team rather than passing them up the chain. You’ll talk about money without flinching, and you’ll carry the ongoing advisory relationship with the clients you hold: sitting with a senior stakeholder, asking what they're really facing, and shaping the next piece of work out of what you hear.     This isn't pre-sales or business development. It isn't day-to-day retainer or product delivery, and it isn't people management.        No two days look exactly the same, but your work will typically involve:      Taking handover of a newly won engagement from Sales, and testing the promise against reality before the client hears otherwise  Setting firm deliverables, acceptance criteria and a delivery plan before work starts, not after  Leading multi-workstream engagements end to end, on quality, timeliness and margin  Having the hard commercial conversation when scope or margin needs pulling back on track  Briefing the Owls and technical team on an engagement, then trusting them to run it  Catching a wrong number or a data inconsistency before it reaches the client  Sitting with senior stakeholders, unscripted, to shape the next piece of work  Converting a first engagement into a second, and building the relationship that gets you there  Updating core project management systems and reporting project progress to the wider team         What you'll bring      8-15 years of co

title: Customer Success Manager
description: At Mercell, we're on a mission to revolutionize public procurement, making it accessible and effortless for everyone involved. Imagine a world where public buyers and visionary suppliers come together seamlessly to make a great deal easier and shape the future. That's what we're all about.  With a dynamic culture built on continuous growth, trust, and collaboration, Mercell offers an environment where your talents can thrive. You will be part of an international environment with ambitious and dedicated colleagues who are passionate about what they do and supported to be themselves.  Together, let's shape the future and create real value for society, one innovative solution at a time.      Your Mission   As a Customer Success Manager at Mercell, you'll own a portfolio of supplier customers across Europe with a focus on the Swedish market, the businesses who rely on our platform to discover, access, and win public tenders. Your mission is to make sure they get real, measurable value from Mercell every single day.  That means building genuine relationships and becoming a trusted partner your customers turn to; spotting the early signals of churn and acting before it happens; and uncovering the moments where customers are ready to grow, so you can open the door to new opportunities. Above all, you'll be the person who ensures every customer in your portfolio realises the full potential of what Mercell can do for them helping them win more, work smarter, and see us as essential to their success.  If you're energised by ownership, thrive on building lasting relationships, and love turning satisfied customers into genuine advocates, this is a role where you'll see the impact of your work directly in retention, in growth, and in the success of the customers you champion.      Core Responsibilities    Own a portfolio of supplier customers across your markets, acting as their primary point of contact and trusted advisor throughout the customer lifecycle  Proactively identify customer friction points by leveraging HubSpot data and channel actionable feedback to Product team to directly shape the roadmap and service experience.  Drive retention and growth by identifying expansion opportunities within your portfolio and collaborating with Sales to act on them  Build and maintain strong relationships with key customer stakeholders, ensuring they see consistent value from the Mercell platform  Own and resolve defined categories of customer issues raised via HubSpot, Jira, or similar systems (e.g. onboarding, billing questions, contract terms, access issues, product transitions).       Required Qualifications    Experience (ideally 2-3 years) in Customer Success, Account Management, Customer Support, Operations, or another client-facing SaaS role.  Strong ability to build deep knowledge within defined functional or product areas.  Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics clearly and concisely. title: Technical Account Manager
description: Own Every Moment at NetApp   At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.  Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.   Job Summary   As a Technical Account Manager (TAM) at NetApp, you will blend deep technical expertise with exceptional customer success skills to deliver outstanding customer experiences and drive significant business outcomes. Your role will involve leveraging your sales engineering skills to provide technical guidance, support product adoption, and provide consultancy to help ensure the successful implementation and integration of NetApp solutions. By combining technical acumen with customer success strategies, you will establish NetApp as a trusted partner in our customers' success.  Key Responsibilities    Technical Consultation: Consult with customers to provide technical advice on NetApp products and services, focusing on key areas to enhance their technical environment and achieve business goals.   Technical Relationship Building: Develop and nurture strong technical relationships with customers, becoming a trusted technical advisor and advocate throughout their journey with NetApp.  Onboarding and Adoption: Facilitate smooth onboarding and integration activities, collaborating with customers to co-create technical success plans tailored to their specific needs and goals. Conduct guided demos tailored to customer environment   Technical Health Checks: Conduct technical health checks with customers to assess product adoption, address technical challenges, suggest possible solutions, and identify areas for improvement.  Proactive Technical Engagement: Use advanced data insights and technical knowledge to monitor adoption and/or utilization, guiding customers to recognize greater value from NetApp solutions.  Technical Asset Management: Provide technical assessments consulting with the customer & the CSM to maintain and optimize the customer inventory of technical assets and services while identifying and qualifying opportunities to expand, replace, or optimize their environments.  Technical Renewal and Expansion: Collaborate with Renewal Specialists and Field Sales to design and implement technical health plans with the goal of value realization, ensuring successful renewal of customer workloads on NetApp’s portfolio. title: Client Success Manager
description: Weezevent  ofrece servicios tecnológicos a los  organizadores de eventos , con el fin de contribuir al éxito de sus proyectos.  En todo el mundo, más de 300.000 organizadores de eventos utilizan nuestros servicios tecnológicos, que son intuitivos e innovadores: desde la  venta de entradas y gestión de inscripciones online  pasando por el  control de acceso , el  cashless…  hasta un  CRM  y una  herramienta sencilla de gestión del personal y acreditados .  Nuestros clientes operan en todos los sectores de la industria de los eventos, en Europa y Canadá: Hellfest, Lollapalooza, Tomorrowland, PSG, Fórmula 1, conferencias TED X, etc.  Gracias a la inversión y la pasión de nuestros equipos, somos el líder europeo en Cashless y el segundo operador de venta de entradas en Francia. Hoy, Weezevent España está buscando a un  Client Success Manager Junior  (H/M); puesto de trabajo que ha de desempeñarse en Madrid capital.  En colaboración con tu referente directo, un Senior Client Success Manager, gestionarás una  cartera de clientes considerados grandes cuentas . También tendrás la  oportunidad de interactuar con todos los departamentos de Weezevent : facturación, producto, ventas, marketing, etc. Este enfoque interfuncional te convertirá en el experto que necesitan nuestros clientes:    Asesoramiento y fidelización de los clientes;  Alto conocimiento de los servicios Weezevent: venta de entradas y gestión de inscripciones online, control de acceso, cashless, CRM y herramienta de gestión de personal y acreditados;  Análisis de implementación de los servicios Weezevent en los proyectos asignados;  Tiempo corto de reacción y proactividad en contestar a las solicitudes de los organizadores;  Acompañamiento del despliegue de los servicios Weezevent: sobre el terreno y a distancia;  Creación de informes y mejoras de cara a la siguiente edición una vez transcurrido el evento.     Se requiere un alto nivel en inglés, y además se valorará positivamente que tengas una formación relacionada con la gestión de proyectos y/o una primera experiencia notable en la industria de los eventos musicales.   Las palabras clave para este puesto son:  compromiso ,  ingenio ,  curiosidad  y  humor . Buscamos a una  persona apasionada e ilusionada por dar una gran atención al cliente . Como actor clave en el éxito de los proyectos asignados, Weezevent te permite estar en contacto con una gran variedad de interlocutores de alto nivel. Además, nuestro entorno de trabajo combina  tecnología y eventos , por lo que participarás en  proyectos innovadores, ambiciosos y estimulantes .  También te ofrecemos cierta autonomía, sobre todo a la hora de tomar decisiones para el buen desarrollo de los eventos. ¡Así que revestir un cargo con responsabilidad ha de motivarte!  Más que un trabajo, este entorno desafiante es un entorno de aprendizaje. Sin duda te conocerás mejor y, en particular, sobre tu capacidad para reinventarte y superar todo tipo de retos. title: Enterprise Project Manager

To strengthen our team in this area, we are now looking for an Enterprise Project Manager to help manage all parts of onboarding larger customers onto our platform and interfacing with them as they evolve their technology stack with Famly. This includes a lot of project management, stakeholder management, a good deal of technical knowledge and a lot of drive. title: Systems Integration Manager | EMEA
description: Who We Are Is What We Do.   Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.  Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.   Why should you be part of our success story?   As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.  Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google. About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. title: Director of Product Marketing

  • Build and scale the product marketing function. We intend to build the company that changes it and to become the system every advice firm in the world runs on.  In under a year we have onboarded more than 1,000 paying firms across eight countries with almost zero churn. Revenue is growing 37% month on month on average. In May we raised a $10m seed led by Blackbird Ventures. Blackbird was the first and largest investor in Canva.  We are at an inflection point. Join now and you will help shape the future of advice.   The role   Customer experience is not just a function, it is part of why advisers choose us. Advisers have spent years with software that made them wait, so we answer in minutes, we go further than we need to, and we fix the root problem rather than the ticket. That is how we win firms, it is why churn is close to zero, and it is one of the reasons our best customers know the team by name.  You own CX globally. Today that is a team across London, New York, Sydney and Wellington answering for their own market, and your first job is to make it one function rather than four separate teams. Same standard, same answers, same view of what customers are telling us, wherever the question comes from.  Inbox zero is the baseline, not the goal. The goal is that the volume reaching the inbox falls, the answers get faster, and the reasons people raise tickets get fixed at source. That means building the system the team triages inside, scoping the internal tooling that removes the repetitive work, and working with engineering to get it built.  You are also the voice of the customer inside the business. We ship constantly, and you are the person who tells us how it landed: what came in on day one, what the tickets said by the end of the week, and what is still coming up a month later   What You Will Do     Own the global inbox. Set the standard for speed, accuracy and tone, and hold it across every market as the team grows  Lead and coach the CX team. Own their performance, development and targets, review real conversations, and make the average response as good as the best one  Build the triage system. How work is sorted, routed, escalated and closed, written down, taught and used, so the answer does not depend on who picked it up  Scope the internal tooling. You will not be building it, but you will decide what we need, make the case for it and work with engineering until it ships  Reduce the volume. Find the recurring causes behind the tickets and get them fixed at source rather than answered faster  Be the voice of the customer. Bring product and engineering the evidence on what launched well, what did not and what customers keep asking for  Measure everything. Volume, response and resolution times, reopen rates and what

title: Operations Manager

Identify recurring issues, eliminate bottlenecks and introduce improvements that make everyday work easier.   Explore automation and AI tools to reduce manual work and improve efficiency. Our technology protects millions of users every day by detecting fraud, malware, and emerging attack techniques before damage is done. We do this by combining 15 years of extensive research with our own smart software.  At ThreatFabric, we're not just shaping the future of cybersecurity - we're defining it. With our headquarters in the vibrant city of Amsterdam, ThreatFabric stands at the forefront of combating online fraud, mobile malware, and threat intelligence.     Your mission   Position: Full-time | 40 hours per week  Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands | Hybrid (2–3 days in the office)  Salary Range: 85,000-105,000  Reports to: VP, Global Sales      About The Job   As Strategic Account Manager at ThreatFabric, you are responsible for the relationship, retention, and growth of our most strategic financial institution customers. These include leading banks and payment companies whose fraud prevention programmes depend on our platform every day.  This is a senior, revenue-accountable role in which you will use value-selling and consultative-based selling approaches to defend and expand our largest accounts. You will meet with the key sponsors, business leaders, champions and users of our technology on a regular basis to measure the value of our technology and build ROI cases.  You will own the end-to-end renewal and upsell process, including account planning, pricing, contract negotiations and closing.  You will work closely with Product, Data Science, and Solution Engineering to ensure customers achieve measurable fraud-loss reduction and a clear return on investment. You will also identify and develop expansion opportunities across new products, use cases, and business lines. Building the value measurement framework from scratch, including how we measure tangible quantitative success with our clients. Conducting regular executve business reviews and clearly communicating progress, risks, and opportunities.  Working closely with Sales, Product, Data Science, Solution Engineering, and other internal teams to deliver successful customer outcomes. title: Key Account Manager
description: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact – on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we’re pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.     As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.    About The Job   Ready to make a positive impact? We are glad to present this opportunity to join a great team at a highly innovative company as we are looking for a Key Account Manager. This is a role where you will be responsible for driving profitable growth and strengthening long-term partnerships with some of Alfa Laval's most important customers across Denmark and Sweden within the food and pharmaceutical industries.  You will serve as the customer's trusted advisor and main point of contact, coordinating closely with technical specialists, service teams, inside sales, and other stakeholders across the organization, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction. The customers that you will serve are mainly pharma customers.   Your Primary Focus Will Be     Proactive sales - developing existing strategic accounts by understanding customer needs.  Identifying new business opportunities and following up leads.  Coordination/meeting optimization with internal and external stakeholders.     Success in this role requires a strong commercial mindset, excellent relationship-building skills, and the ability to navigate complex customer organizations and decision-making processes.  You will be part of a team of ten and have a key role in further contributing to our customers' and Alfa Lavals growth. You report to Tina Masini Tarp, a manager who aims to create a collaborative environment where people feel trusted, take ownership, and contribute to shared success.   Who Are You   You are a commercially driven and customer-focused professional who enjoys building long-term relationships and creating value for customers. You actively engage and network with stakeholders, understand business challenges, and translate customer needs into opportunities. You are proactive, structured, and comfortable taking ownership while collaborating across functions and cultures. Most importantly, you are motivated by developing strategic partnerships and delivering sustainable business growth.   What You Know   We are looking for you with experience within Key Account Management, Technical Sales, Business Development and/or Strategic Sales. You need the ability to understand technical solutions and connect them to customer value as well as being able to work independently while collaborating effectively across functions and countries.

title: Relationship Manager
description: Ready to take your career global?   Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a proven Relationship Manager to join our ever-evolving EMEA Commercial team to help us unleash the potential of every business. Sell products and/or services and manage relationships with existing named accounts to ensure satisfaction, alignment of client technology strategies with Global Payments Corporate Strategy, account retention and continued revenue growth.   What You’ll Own     To manage the Italian Government and other European based clients.  Acts as primary liaison between client and Global Payments and understands client needs including financial expectations and restrictions.  Within client organizations, builds network of both operational and executive C-level users and maintains knowledge of products and services utilized.  Works directly with relevant teams to plan, coordinate and facilitate client meetings at Global Payments offices and Executive and/or Sales Executive visits and presentations at client on-site facilities.  Sell products and services  Manage relationships  Ensure alignment of client technology and business strategies  Focus on account retention and continued revenue growth  Coach and mentor junior team members.     What You Bring     Experience as a Relationship or Account Manager in the payments and/or Fintech space.  Fluent Italian speaker is essential based in Milan  Experience interacting with Merchants and/or partners.  Requires expert negotiation and communication skills, both written and verbal  Understanding of global payment requirements and needs.     About The Team   Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections  – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.   What makes a Globalpayer?   Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.  Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.  Worldpay is dedicated to offering individuals rewarding career opportunities and competitive compensation. For this full-time position, the good faith estimated annual salary range upon hire is €48,200.00 - €74,700.00. This range reflects what we reasonably expect to offer based on the role’s responsibilities, level, and geographic location. The actual starting salary will be determined by a candidate’s experience, job-related skills, and relevant education or training. title: Leader Expérience Client vivier
description: M comme METRO France :  Nous avons tous un rôle à jouer dans le développement de notre entreprise. Nous croyons fermement que la diversité de nos équipes est une richesse qui nous permet de grandir et de nous challenger chaque jour !      Venez révéler le M qui est en vous !        1er fournisseur omnicanal de la restauration commerciale indépendante en France, avec 400 000 clients professionnels, 99 points de vente (Halles), 20 plateformes logistiques et notre tout premier dépôt de livraison. Nous sommes 9 300 collaborateurs au service des entrepreneurs du goût !   Ce qui nous tient à cœur ?   La qualité de nos produits, la relation de confiance avec les producteurs et le conseil que nous apportons à nos clients professionnels, en toute proximité.   NOTRE RAISON D’ETRE :  Donner aux restaurateurs les moyens de faire les bons choix pour que chacun se retrouve autour du bien-manger.   NOTRE PROMESSE RH :  Rejoindre METRO France, c’est l’opportunité de monter en compétences, s’épanouir et grandir au sein d’une entreprise engagée. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement bienveillant et stimulant où vous contribuerez à la performance collective.  Prêt à relever les challenges avec nous ! Postulez !      Description du poste      En tant que Leader Expérience Client F/H, vous jouez un rôle clé dans la transformation de l’expérience client au sein des Halles METRO France. Vos missions s’articulent autour de quatre axes majeurs :      Développer la relation client :        Déployer des plans d’action commerciaux innovants pour valoriser le parcours client, en lien avec les services Experts.  Proposer des initiatives omnicanales centrées sur les besoins clients, du recueil à la concrétisation.       Piloter la performance commerciale :        Analyser les indicateurs de performance et mettre en œuvre des plans d’action pour améliorer le parcours client.  Veiller à la bonne organisation du périmètre pour garantir la meilleure expérience commerciale des clients.  Assurer le développement du chiffre d’affaires et la réalisation des objectifs économiques.       Développer les équipes :        Accompagner la montée en compétences sur les postures commerciales et les expertises solutions METRO.  Enrichir ses équipes en s’appuyant sur les dispositifs managériaux (entretiens mensuels…).       Manager une équipe pluridisciplinaire :        Fédérer les collaborateurs autour d’une performance collective et d’une culture client forte.  Adopter une posture de coach tout en assurant une gestion efficace des relations individuelles.       Ce que vous allez vivre chez nous :        L’opportunité de réinventer la restauration de demain.  L’engagement d’un groupe Leader.  Une ambiance motivante et challengeante dans un esprit de bienveillance.  La passion du produit et la proximité avec nos clients, nos partenaires locaux et nos autres points de vente.       Nous allons aimer chez vous  :      Votre expérience managériale et commerciale dans un univers B to B ou B to C.

title: Senior Consultant/Manager i CX Transformation-teamet - frog
description: I frog, part of Capgemini Invent, tror vi at de beste virksomhetene skapes gjennom ekstraordinære opplevelser. Vi hjelper organisasjoner med å forstå mennesker bedre, tenke nytt om hvordan de skaper verdi, og bygge løsningene som trengs for å lykkes i en verden i stadig endring. Vi kombinerer strategi, design, teknologi, data og AI for å hjelpe virksomheter med å skape sømløse og meningsfulle opplevelser på tvers av digitale og fysiske kontaktpunkter. Sammen med kundene våre utvikler vi nye tjenester, kundeopplevelser, arbeidsmåter og kapabiliteter som skaper varig verdi.   Om rollen   Som Senior Consultant/Manager i CX Transformation vil du bidra til å forme fremtidens kundeopplevelser gjennom å utvikle strategier, designe nye opplevelser og realisere transformasjon i skjæringspunktet mellom mennesker, teknologi og forretning.   I Denne Rollen Vil Du     Lede eller bidra til transformasjonsprogrammer innen kundeopplevelse, markedsføring, salg og kundeservice.  Utvikle kunde- og forretningsstrategier basert på innsikt, analyse og kundebehov.  Designe fremtidige kunde- og medarbeiderreiser, prosesser og driftsmodeller.  Hjelpe kunder med å ta i bruk ny teknologi, AI og data-drevne arbeidsmåter for å forbedre kundeopplevelser og operasjonell ytelse.  Drive workshops, fasilitere beslutningsprosesser og samarbeide med ledere og fagspesialister på alle nivåer.  Bidra til forretningsutvikling, tilbudsarbeid og videreutvikling av våre fagområder innen CX Transformation     Din profil     Du har 3+ års erfaring fra management consulting eller byrå, med prosjekter innenfor kundeopplevelse, markedsføring, salg og/eller kundeservice  Mastergrad med sterke akademiske resultater  Sterk strategisk og analytisk forståelse, med evne til å strukturere komplekse problemstillinger  Du trives med å jobbe i tverrfaglige team og evner å bygge tillit hos kunder og kolleger.  Du har erfaring med å lede eller bidra til komplekse endrings- og transformasjonsinitiativ  Du har sterke kommunikasjonsevner (på norks og engelsk, minimum B2-nivå) og er komfortabel med fasilitering, presentasjoner og stakeholder management.  Du har en forståelse for hvordan teknologi, data og KI påvirker CX. Erfaring med CRM/MarTech plattformer (Salesforce/Adobe) er en fordel.     Hvorfor Vil Du Trives Hos Oss   Hos oss er det rom for å skape din egen rolle og karriere. Initiativ, samarbeid og utvikling er nøkkelaspekter når vi beskriver vårt arbeidsmiljø. Det finnes uendelige muligheter for å akselerere din karriere og utvikling. Vi har et sterkt fokus på menneskene i selskapet og ønsker å sikre at våre konsulenter har de beste mulighetene til å prestere og utvikle seg selv.    Spennende og utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver i ett av verdens største konsulenthus. Du vil ha leveranseansvar, lede og/eller delta i tverrfaglige team for å skape varige resultater for våre kunder.  Tverrfaglig ekspertise, der du får samarbeide med markedsledende kunder og et globalt nettverk av erfarne konsulente

title: Teamleder
description: Stillingsannonse:   Fair Collection er et spennende og nytenkende selskap innen inkassobransjen i Norge. Vi er kjent for å levere løsninger som sikrer rettferdig behandling av både kunder og oppdragsgivere. Fair består av dyktige fagfolk med fokus på høy kvalitet, effektivitet og gode kundeopplevelser. Vi er et innovativt selskap med et solid omdømme, og hos oss verdsettes trivsel og utvikling på arbeidsplassen.  Vi er nå på jakt etter en dyktig Teamleder for vårt kundesenter inkasso. Dette er en spennende mulighet for deg som har erfaring innen inkasso og kundeservice, og som ønsker å bidra til en mer ansvarlig og etisk innkrevingsprosess. Er du ansvarsfull, løsningsorientert, strukturert og god på kommunikasjon – så kan dette være den rette stillingen for deg.   Om arbeidsplassen   Vi holder til i moderne og trivelige lokaler på Løren i Oslo med god kantineordning. Hos oss er vi opptatt av å skape et inkluderende og sosialt arbeidsmiljø der alle skal trives og føle seg verdsatt.   Arbeidsoppgaver:   Teamleder Kundeservice Inkasso er en sentral stilling i virksomheten, og skal sikre god og effektiv leveranse fra de ansatte på Kundeservice Inkasso dag i Fair Collection. Stillingen er delvis operativ og innebærer både personal- og bemanningsansvar, samt kunne bistå inn i den daglige driften. Teamleder inngår som en del av lederteamet på inkasso. Dine viktigste arbeidsoppgaver vil være:    Personalansvar for medarbeiderne i Kundeservice Inkasso, hvor du blant annet vil ha ansvar for å sikre riktig bemanning, medarbeideroppfølging, og rekruttering.  Ansvar for opplæring og kompetanseutvikling.  Følge opp KPI-er, kvalitet og effektivitet.  Optimalisere arbeidsprosesser, ressursfordeling og drift.  Identifisere og gjennomføre forbedrings- og automatiseringstiltak.  Delta aktivt i den operative driften og holde deg tett på den daglige driften.  Utarbeide og følge opp rapporter og nøkkeltall  Samarbeide tett med Head of Collection og viktige samarbeidspartnere internt og eksternt.     Kvalifikasjoner:     Høyere relevant utdanning innen økonomi, administrasjon, juss eller annen relevant fagretning.  Solid og relevant erfaring fra inkassovirksomhet er en forutsetning for stillingen. Samt erfaring fra leder-, fagansvarlig- eller koordinatorrolle innen inkasso.  God og praktisk anvendbar kunnskap om inkassofaget, herunder gjeldende regelverk, retningslinjer, prosesser og rutiner innen inkasso.  Dokumentert erfaring med å lede team, følge opp KPI-er og sikre effektiv og god drift.  Strukturert og analytisk, med god forståelse for bemanningsplanlegging, prioritering og effektiv arbeidsflyt.  Gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig.  Evne til å motivere og utvikle medarbeidere og skape psykologisk trygghet i teamet.     Ønskede kvalifikasjoner:     Erfaring fra kundesenter.  Utdanning og/eller kurs innen ledelse, coaching eller personaladministrasjon er en fordel.  Tydelig, tilgjengelig og beslutningsdyktig lederstil.  Trives i en hver

title: Operations Service Manager (ICN)
description: How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)   The Operations Service Manager (OSM) is responsible for providing leadership to front-line teams and the operation. Additionally, this role oversees and coordinates operational performance including, but not limited to, on-time departure, safety, security, customer service delivery and other key performance indicators.  As an OSM, you will serve as an operational liaison between Delta and all contracted business partners within a station. In this Delta leader role, you will also monitor at-risk behaviors through daily safety observations and provide coaching, training and corrective action as needed. In addition, you participate in incident analysis reports, safety action reports and applicable station safety meetings.  The OSM ensures adherence to the station’s Safety Business Plan in addition to assuring compliance to divisional performance and safety standards. Moreover, in this role, you will ensure distinctive customer service is delivered by demonstrating a high level of customer focus and sensitivity. You will be responsible for being a key communicator of timely and accurate information and be required to set performance standards and ensure employee accountability. As a Delta leader it is paramount that you will provide support, guidance, coaching and motivation based on individual needs and be champion leading others through change.  The qualified candidate must also have the capability to measure and analyze employee performance through the use of performance management tools, available customer service and operational metrics, job shadowing and direct observation. Must champion recognition and rewards.  As part of the station leadership team, the successful candidate will be responsible and accountable for the timely completion and delivery of performance appraisals, quality assurance observations, performance discussions, coaching and counseling and administrative action. The successful candidate must be a strong advocate of employee recognition. Continued training and development in building leadership capabilities is expected. As a Delta leader, the Operations Service Manager will be required to develop both strategic and tactical plans that create a safety-conscious environment resulting in employee safety and well-being.   Responsibilities Include     Monitors and supports all employee activities, both ACS above and ACS below wing, including, but not limited to, safety, security and local/technical compliances.  Responsible for the leadership and implementation of safety initiatives, on-time operational performance, customer service initiatives and programs, baggage services initiatives, IROP management and recovery plans along with other strategic initiatives.  May also be responsible for maintaining relationships with the local government agencies and other contract services that support the successful execution of the operational performance.  Addition

description: En Natulim mejoramos los productos clásicos de limpieza. Hacemos productos sin residuos, prácticos de utilizar y con ingredientes buenos para la piel y el planeta.   Nuestro producto estrella es un detergente para la ropa en un formato de tiras biodegradables que se disuelven en la lavadora.   Buscamos a un profesional apasionado y responsable con espíritu emprendedor, habilidades de aprendizaje rápido y voluntad de desarrollar nuevas habilidades. title: Consumer Protection Manager (정책/기획)
description: 합류하게 될 팀에 대해 알려드려요     Consumer Protection Manager는 토스뱅크 소비자보호팀에 속해있어요.  토스뱅크 금융소비자보호팀은 은행의 혁신적인 상품과 서비스가 금융소비자보호법령 하에서 만들어지고 판매될 수 있게 하는 팀이에요.  금융소비자의 불편 사항을 담당 팀과 협의해 상품과 서비스의 고객 편의성을 배가하는 것에 앞장서요.       합류하면 함께할 업무예요     금융상품 개발, 상품정보제공, 상품설명서, 마케팅 활동, 광고물 등에 대한 금융소비자보호 사전협의 업무를 수행해요.  은행이 금융소비자보호 관련 법령 및 내부규정을 준수하여 금융상품을 판매하는지, 금융소비자보호 활동을 적절히 수행하는지 등을 모니터링해요.  모니터링 결과, 소비자의견 수렴 등 다양한 채널에서 금융상품 판매절차 등에 대한 개선점을 도출하고 담당팀과 협의해 개선해 나가요.  금융소비자보호 실태평가 대응업무를 수행해요.  그 밖에 실효성 있는 금융소비자보호 내부통제를 위한 다양한 활동들을 팀원들과 협력하여 수행해요.       이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요     금융업권에서의 커리어 경험을 통해 은행 및 금융 상품에 대한 전반적인 이해도를 가지고 계신 분이 필요해요. 특히 은행업에 대한 이해가 있으신 분이라면 더 좋아요.  금융소비자보호법 및 금융소비자보호 내부통제에 대한 전반적인 이해도를 가지고 계신 분이 필요해요.  금융소비자보호 내부통제 점검, 금융소비자보호 사전협의, 제도개선 업무 등 금융소비자보호 내부통제 업무를 직접 수행해 보신 분이 필요해요.  상품부서 등 다양한 분야의 동료들과 원활하게 협업이 가능한 역량을 갖추신 분이라면 더 좋아요.  금융소비자보호 내부통제 활동 보고 및 기록유지 등을 원활하게 수행하기 위한 정도의 문서작성 역량이 필요해요.       이력서는 이렇게 작성하시는 걸 추천해요     기존 회사에서 해왔던 업무를 시계열로 작성하기보다는, 지원한 팀의 JD 기준으로 경험에 관한 내용을 구체적으로 기술해주시면 도움이 돼요.  해왔던 업무의 나열 및 성과도 중요하지만, 그 업무를 시작하게 된 배경 및 궁극적인 목적이 무엇이었는지 궁금해요.  금융소비자보호 내부통제 업무 수행 경험을 실무사례를 중심으로 구체적으로 알려주세요.  본인의 직무에서 금융소비자보호법 준수를 위해 업무를 개선하였거나 새로운 제도를 적용했던 사례를 소개해주시면 더 좋아요. 있어요.  장애인 및 국가보훈대상자는 지원 시 관련법에 따라 우대하고 있어요.       합류하게 될 팀에 대해 알려드려요     Consumer Protection Manager는 토스뱅크 소비자보호팀에 속해있어요.  토스뱅크 소비자보호팀은 은행의 혁신적인 상품과 서비스가 금융소비자보호법령 하에서 만들어지고 판매될 수 있게 하는 팀이에요.  금융소비자의 불편 사항을 담당 팀과 협의해 상품과 서비스의 고객 편의성을 배가하는 것에 앞장서요.       합류하면 함께 할 업무예요     소비자 민원을 직접 응대하며, 민원 내용에 관한 분석 수행과 개선점을 도출해요.  고객의 문제에 대한 적절한 대응 방향을 수립하고, 문제를 해결하기 위해 필요한 의사소통을 주도적으로 수행해요.  고객 상담 간 인지한 잠재적인 공식 문서를 정확하고 논리적으로 작성할 수 있는 문서 작성 역량이 필요해요.  리스크 상황에 대응하여 적절한 조치를 취할 수 있는 위기 대응 능력이 필요해요.  문제를 해결함에 있어 유관부서와의 의사결정 과정을 주도적으로 이끌어갈 수 있는 협업 능력이 필요해요.  민원 응대에 대한 교육 등 도급사 운영/관리에 관한 업무 경험을 가지고 계신다면 더 좋아요. title: Enhetschef VA Distribution
description: Om arbetsplatsen   I Mölndals stad är vi stolta över att ha Sveriges viktigaste jobb där vi tillsammans skapar bästa möjliga vardag för våra medborgare. Med kunskap, mod och kreativitet utvecklar vi våra verksamheter och bidrar till att Mölndal blir en ännu bättre plats att leva och jobba i. Välkommen att göra skillnad i människors vardag varje dag!  Stadsserviceförvaltningen har ett viktigt och spännande uppdrag i att leverera, samordna och utveckla servicen för invånare och förvaltningar i Mölndals stad. Förvaltningen har cirka 550 medarbetare och är organiserad i fyra verksamhetsområden; måltid och lokalvård, vatten och återvinning, stadsunderhåll samt stab och kund.  Verksamhetsområdet Vatten och Återvinning arbetar för en hållbar framtid genom att säkerställa rent vatten i både kran och vattendrag samt främja en mer hållbar konsumtion med minskat avfall. Vi gör detta genom att utveckla, underhålla och förbättra våra verksamheter. Ditt uppdrag innefattar ansvar för budget, arbetsmiljö och personal, och du driver det strategiska och operativa arbetet framåt i linje med stadens mål och vision.  I rollen ansvarar du för att leda enhetens verksamhet inom VA-distribution med ett team på cirka 15 medarbetare, däribland driftledare, rörläggare, drifttekniker och mätningstekniker. Du ingår i ledningsgruppen för Vatten och Återvinning och rapporterar till verksamhetschefen för området. title: RESPONSABILE SERVICE
description: Alti Profili , divisione del gruppo Umana specializzata nella Ricerca e Selezione di personale di middle management nel mercato italiano e internazionale, per realtà metalmeccanica in forte espansione, con oltre 40 milioni di fatturato, caratterizzata da una forte componente engineering e da un’elevatissima vocazione internazionale, seleziona un      RESPONSABILE SERVICE      La risorsa, rispondendo direttamente al Direttore Operativo, avrà la responsabilità diretta di coordinare il dipartimento Assistenza e Post-Vendita, garantendo il raggiungimento degli obiettivi aziendali di installazione di nuovi impianti, manutenzione ordinaria e straordinaria. Il ruolo ha una forte impronta gestionale, organizzativa e coordinativa: è richiesta la capacità di guidare, indirizzare e supportare le squadre interne ed esterne per garantire standard elevati di qualità, sicurezza e redditività. La risorsa coordinerà infatti un team composto da circa 20 persone.   Nello specifico si occuperà di:   Gestione e Coordinamento del Team: Organizzare, pianificare e monitorare le attività dei Project Manager di reparto e del Back Office; Indirizzare e supportare le squadre operative e i tecnici sul campo nella risoluzione delle problematiche di cantiere e di manutenzione.  Pianificazione ed Esecuzione Operativa: Pianificare e supervisionare le attività di installazione di nuovi impianti e gli interventi di manutenzione ordinaria e straordinaria; Assicurare il rispetto delle tempistiche, dei canoni qualitativi e delle normative di sicurezza (interne ed esterne) durante tutte le fasi operative. At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor?

Multiple drives, gear trains, tendons, tactile sensors and electronics have to fit into a human-sized envelope while surviving hundreds of thousands of cycles. Every millimetre matters, and almost every design decision affects another discipline.

You work hands-on between CAD, test rig and workshop, and report to the CTO.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

title: Infrastructure Software Engineer, Metadata Core
description:
Role Description

As a Software Engineer on the Metadata team, you’ll build and operate the large-scale distributed databases that every Dropbox service depends on. Metadata systems are mission-critical, in the live path for all user operations and must meet stringent requirements for latency, durability, and transactional consistency.

You’ll design and evolve the core infrastructure that manages Dropbox’s databases at scale, enabling fast, reliable access to data for millions of users and hundreds of internal services. This work spans distributed systems, replication, caching, and transactional database systems.

You’ll collaborate closely with engineers across Infrastructure and Product teams to ensure the metadata layer meets business needs and continues to scale with Dropbox’s growth. This is an opportunity to leverage your expertise in distributed systems and grow into broader technical leadership.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain distributed database systems providing low-latency, strongly consistent data access
  • Implement and optimize replication, consensus, and caching mechanisms to meet availability and performance goals
  • Operate production systems, including participating in the on-call rotation, ensuring high availability and data durability
  • Collaborate with infrastructure and product teams to assess current and future use cases and requirements, supporting the development of a mid- to long-term roadmap that reflects these needs
  • Contribute to system design reviews, postmortems, and reliability improvements
  • Write high-quality, efficient code in Go and Rust for performance-critical systems

On-call work may be necessary occasionally to help address bugs, outages, or other operational issues, with the goal of maintaining a stable and high-quality experience for our customers.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong expertise in distributed systems fundamentals including replication, consistency, partitioning, and fault tolerance
  • Experience building database platforms, distributed databases, storage systems, or large-scale database infrastructure
  • Proficiency in Go, Rust, C++ or similar systems languages
  • Familiarity with consensus and coordination systems (e.g. Raft, Paxos, ZooKeeper, etcd)
  • Experience operating production services and participating in on-call rotations

  • Contribute to the reliability of the quantum control and quantum program execution stack

  • Support the definition and refinement of SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and operational guardrails

  • Implement and maintain observability across software, infrastructure, and hardware-adjacent layers
